topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Access to clean drinking water is ----- for preventing the spread of infectious diseases in rural communities.
option_a: careless
option_b: temporary
option_c: artificial
option_d: hostile
option_e: essential
explanation: "Essential" (hayati, elzem, son derece önemli) kelimesi bağlama tam uymaktadır. Temiz içme suyuna erişim bulaşıcı hastalıkları önlemek için elzemdir. Diğer seçenekler: artificial (yapay), hostile (düşmanca), careless (dikkatsiz), temporary (geçici).

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Regular physical exercise not only strengthens muscles but also helps to ----- stress and mental fatigue.
option_a: invent
option_b: predict
option_c: admire
option_d: reduce
option_e: expand
explanation: "Reduce" (azaltmak) fiili stres ve zihinsel yorgunluğu azaltmayı ifade eder. Diğer seçenekler: invent (icat etmek), expand (genişletmek), admire (hayran olmak), predict (tahmin etmek).

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Due to heavy snowfall and adverse weather conditions, the school administration decided to ----- all outdoor sports activities.
option_a: call off
option_b: give up
option_c: turn into
option_d: carry on
option_e: look after
explanation: "Call off" iptal etmek (cancel) anlamına gelir. Ağır kar yağışı nedeniyle açık hava spor etkinliklerinin iptal edilmesi doğru ifadedir. Diğerleri: look after (bakmak, ilgilenmek), give up (vazgeçmek/bırakmak), carry on (sürdürmek), turn into (dönüşmek).

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: The introduction of automated manufacturing techniques has ----- increased production speed while lowering operational expenses.
option_a: scarcely
option_b: reluctantly
option_c: vaguely
option_d: substantially
option_e: suspiciously
explanation: "Substantially" (önemli ölçüde, kayda değer derecede) zarfı üretim hızının belirgin biçimde arttığını nitelemektedir. Diğerleri: reluctantly (isteksizce), scarcely (neredeyse hiç), vaguely (belli belirsiz), suspiciously (şüpheyle).

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Renewable energy technologies, such as wind and solar power, currently ----- nearly thirty percent of the nation's total electricity generation.
option_a: run out of
option_b: put out
option_c: bring about
option_d: account for
option_e: break down
explanation: "Account for" bir bütünü oluşturmak, oranını teşkil etmek ("account for nearly thirty percent") anlamına gelir. Diğerleri: break down (bozulmak/çökmek), bring about (yol açmak/neden olmak), put out (söndürmek), run out of (tüketmek).

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Rapid industrial expansion must not be achieved ----- the expense of environmental sustainability and public health.
option_a: at
option_b: by
option_c: with
option_d: in
option_e: under
explanation: "At the expense of" kalıplaşmış bir edat öbeği olup "... pahasına" (çevresel sürdürülebilirlik pahasına) anlamına gelir. Doğru edat "at"tir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Unregulated offshore drilling and toxic chemical spills can severely ----- marine ecosystems, leading to the collapse of fragile food chains.
option_a: duplicate
option_b: compensate
option_c: stimulate
option_d: undermine
option_e: reconcile
explanation: "Undermine" temelini sarsmak, zayıflatmak, baltalamak demektir. Kimyasal sızıntılar deniz ekosistemlerini derinden zayıflatır. Diğerleri: stimulate (uyarmak, canlandırmak), reconcile (uzlaştırmak), compensate (telafi etmek), duplicate (kopyalamak/çoğaltmak).

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Low-lying agricultural deltas and small island communities are exceptionally ----- to the catastrophic impacts of rising sea levels.
option_a: resilient
option_b: vulnerable
option_c: indifferent
option_d: negligible
option_e: resistant
explanation: "Vulnerable to" savunmasız, açık, hassas anlamına gelen bir sıfattır ("vulnerable to the impacts of rising sea levels"). Diğerleri: indifferent (kayıtsız), resilient (dayanıklı/çabuk toparlanan), resistant (dirençli), negligible (göz ardı edilebilir/önemsiz).

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: A specialized interdisciplinary team was commissioned by the international agency to ----- comprehensive geological surveys prior to dam construction.
option_a: take after
option_b: turn down
option_c: carry out
option_d: make up for
option_e: wipe out
explanation: "Carry out" araştırma, anket, deney veya inceleme yürütmek, uygulamak anlamına gelir ("carry out comprehensive geological surveys"). Diğerleri: make up for (telafi etmek), take after (benzemek), turn down (reddetmek), wipe out (kökünü kazımak/yok etmek).

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: When archaeologists ----- the ancient royal tomb in 1922, they ----- that most of the gold artifacts were remarkably intact.
option_a: discover / are finding
option_b: had discovered / will find
option_c: discovered / found
option_d: discover / had found
option_e: have discovered / were finding
explanation: Geçmişte belirli bir tarihte (in 1922) art arda gerçekleşen iki eylem anlatılmaktadır. "When" zaman bağlacının her iki tarafı da Simple Past Tense ("discovered / found") ile zaman uyumu içinde olmalıdır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ----- the heavy rainstorm flooded the main mountain roads, the search and rescue team successfully reached the stranded climbers.
option_a: Since
option_b: Although
option_c: In order that
option_d: Because
option_e: As long as
explanation: Yolların sular altında kalması olumsuz (-), ekibin dağcılara ulaşması olumlu (+) bir durumdur. Cümle alan ve zıtlık bildiren doğru bağlaç "Although" (-e rağmen) bağlacıdır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: The historic stone bridge, which was constructed over four centuries ago, ----- by skilled municipal craftsmen every decade to ensure public safety.
option_a: has restored
option_b: was restoring
option_c: will have restored
option_d: is restored
option_e: restored
explanation: "Every decade" (her on yılda bir) rutin bir zaman dilimidir (Geniş Zaman). Köprü eylemi yapan değil eylemden etkilenen nesne konumunda olduğundan Present Simple Passive ("is restored") doğru seçenektir.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: The research facility was locked securely from the inside and the alarm remained active, so the intruder ----- through the broken skylight.
option_a: should enter
option_b: needn't have entered
option_c: must have entered
option_d: would rather enter
option_e: might not enter
explanation: "Must have V3", geçmişe yönelik eldeki güçlü kanıtlara dayanan kesin/kuvvetli çıkarım ifade eder ("girmiş olmalı"). Kapının kilitli ve alarmın devrede olması çatının kırık penceresinden girildiğine güçlü kanıttır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Ever since the new digital learning platform ----- two years ago, students' academic test scores ----- significantly.
option_a: had introduced / improve
option_b: introduces / will improve
option_c: is introduced / improved
option_d: was introduced / have improved
option_e: has been introduced / had improved
explanation: "Ever since" kuralı gereği, since'li yan cümlede geçmişte tamamlanan eylem için Simple Past Passive ("was introduced"), ana cümlede ise günümüze kadar gelen etki için Present Perfect Tense ("have improved") kullanılır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ----- possessing vast natural gas reserves and fertile agricultural plains, the developing nation struggled with widespread poverty for several decades.
option_a: Because of
option_b: As a result of
option_c: In addition to
option_d: Despite
option_e: Therefore
explanation: Zengin doğal gaz ve tarım arazilerine sahip olmak olumlu (+), yoksullukla mücadele etmek olumsuzdur (-). Boşluktan sonra tam cümle değil isim öbeği ("possessing vast...") geldiği için zıtlık bildiren edat "Despite" (-e rağmen) kullanılır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Not only ----- valuable insights into cellular longevity, but the genetic experiment also provided crucial clues about cancer prevention.
option_a: has the study offered
option_b: does the study offer
option_c: the study offered
option_d: the study had offered
option_e: did the study offer
explanation: Cümle başında yer alan kısıtlayıcı "Not only" ifadesi devrik yapı (inversion: Yardımcı fiil + Özne + Fiil) gerektirir. İkinci kısımdaki "provided" geçmiş zamanda olduğundan ilk kısım "did the study offer" olmalıdır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ----- from ancient papyrus fragments found near the Dead Sea, the delicate manuscripts were carefully translated by philologists.
option_a: Restoring
option_b: To be restored
option_c: Having been restored
option_d: Being restoring
option_e: Having restored
explanation: Cümlenin öznesi olan "the delicate manuscripts" (narin el yazmaları) tercüme edilmeden önce onarılmıştır (öncelik) ve onarılma eylemini kendisi yapmayıp eylemden etkilenmiştir (edilgenlik). Hem öncelik hem pasiflik bildiren "Having been restored" kısaltması doğrudur.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: The ancient royal library of Alexandria is believed ----- hundreds of thousands of irreplaceable scrolls before it was consumed by fire.
option_a: having contained
option_b: containing
option_c: to contain
option_d: to have contained
option_e: to be contained
explanation: "Is believed" (günümüzde inanılıyor) raporlama fiilinden daha önceki bir geçmiş zaman eylemini (yangından önce yüz binlerce parşömen içeriyordu) ifade etmek için "to have V3" (to have contained) kalıbı kullanılır.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Because solar and wind installations generate electricity without releasing toxic greenhouse gases, -----.
option_a: many progressive nations are investing heavily in these sustainable alternatives
option_b: international organizations have banned all renewable research programs
option_c: atmospheric carbon dioxide levels will inevitably surge out of control
option_d: they are considered the most hazardous energy forms ever created
option_e: fossil fuels remain the only viable power source in modern cities
explanation: Sebep cümlesi rüzgar ve güneşin sera gazı salmadan temiz elektrik ürettiğini (+) belirttiği için ana cümle ülkelerin bu sürdürülebilir alternatiflere yoğun yatırım yaptığını (+) mantıksal bir sonuç olarak tamamlamalıdır.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Unless national environmental agencies enforce strict limits on industrial waste dumping, -----.
option_a: environmental activist groups will no longer need public support
option_b: aquatic ecosystems in freshwater rivers will continue to deteriorate
option_c: local communities will enjoy crystal clear and pristine drinking water
option_d: manufacturing plants will stop discharging chemical toxins voluntarily
option_e: water pollution will be entirely eradicated within a few months
explanation: "Unless" (-medikçe / -mezse) olumsuz şart bildirir. Sanayi atıklarına sıkı kısıtlamalar getirilmedikçe nehirlerdeki su ekosistemleri bozulmaya devam edecektir.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: While electric vehicles produce zero tailpipe emissions during city driving, -----.
option_a: major metropolitan areas have decided to dismantle all public transport networks
option_b: gasoline automobiles have become significantly cheaper for young buyers
option_c: their overall environmental impact depends heavily on how the electricity is generated
option_d: drivers will never need to recharge their batteries on long interstate journeys
option_e: they will immediately eliminate all global environmental problems overnight
explanation: "While" zıtlık kurar. Elektrikli araçların egzoz emisyonu üretmemesi olumlu (+) bir özellikken, genel çevresel etkilerinin elektriğin nasıl üretildiğine bağlı olması dengeleyici bir zıtlık oluşturur.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Even though genetic predispositions play an indisputable role in cardiovascular disorders, -----.
option_a: lifestyle choices such as balanced nutrition and daily exercise have an equally profound impact
option_b: all heart diseases are caused exclusively by sudden drops in atmospheric pressure
option_c: medical specialists are incapable of providing any preventative advice
option_d: patients cannot take any proactive measures whatsoever to maintain health
option_e: DNA sequencing has been declared completely irrelevant by modern cardiology
explanation: Genetik yatkınlığın kalp hastalıklarında yadsınamaz bir rol oynamasına karşılık beslenme ve egzersiz gibi yaşam tarzı tercihlerinin de aynı derecede derin bir etkiye sahip olması mantıksal zıtlığı kurar.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Having analyzed meteorological data collected from thousands of tracking stations worldwide over the past fifty years, -----.
option_a: temperature fluctuations could not yield any discernible statistical correlation
option_b: climatologists concluded that global surface temperatures are steadily rising
option_c: the conclusion was immediately disregarded by all regional weather reporters
option_d: global warming ceased to be an area of scientific inquiry
option_e: unprecedented amounts of snowfall were recorded in dry desert plateaus
explanation: "Having analyzed data..." kısaltmasıyla başlayan yan cümlenin gizli öznesi analizi bizzat gerçekleştiren kişi veya kurum olmak zorundadır. Cümleyi yalnızca "climatologists" (iklim bilimciler) öznesi doğru biçimde tamamlayabilir.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: ----- because they lack the chlorophyll required to synthesize organic compounds through sunlight.
option_a: Green algae multiply rapidly in shallow freshwater wetlands during summer
option_b: Deciduous broadleaf trees shed their foliage before winter sets in
option_c: Fungi absorb essential nutrients directly from decomposing organic matter in their surroundings
option_d: Evergreen pines retain their needles throughout the freezing mountain winter
option_e: Flowering perennials depend on solar radiation to produce nectar for insects
explanation: Cümledeki "they lack the chlorophyll" (klorofilden yoksundurlar) çoğul zamiri klorofili olmayan ve fotosentez yapamayan mantarlara ("Fungi") işaret eder; mantarlar besinlerini çürüyen organik maddelerden emer.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: So intricate and delicate were the geared wheels inside the ancient astronomical mechanism that -----.
option_a: historians promptly discarded the artifact as a worthless contemporary forgery
option_b: blacksmiths could easily duplicate the entire apparatus using primitive hand tools
option_c: the clockwork ceased functioning solely because the dry chemical battery was exhausted
option_d: casual gallery visitors were invited to touch and operate the mechanism freely
option_e: museum conservators had to utilize high-resolution 3D tomography to inspect them without disassembly
explanation: "So + sıfat + yardımcı fiil + özne ... that" yapısı. Düzenek içindeki dişliler o kadar karmaşık ve narindi ki konservatörler parçalamadan incelemek için yüksek çözünürlüklü 3D tomografi kullanmak zorunda kaldı.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Notwithstanding the remarkable breakthroughs achieved in machine learning architectures over recent years, -----.
option_a: neural network software operates entirely without processing any digital data
option_b: technological research has ground to a complete standstill across all universities
option_c: computers have completely replaced all human emotional and creative capacity
option_d: artificial intelligence models still struggle to demonstrate authentic common sense and contextual empathy
option_e: every cognitive profession has already been automated in contemporary companies
explanation: "Notwithstanding" (-e rağmen) resmi zıtlık bağlacıdır. Makine öğrenimindeki dikkat çekici atılımlara rağmen yapay zeka modelleri hala gerçek sağduyu ve bağlamsal empati sergilemekte zorlanmaktadır.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: No sooner had international delegates finalized the draft of the treaty on marine biodiversity than -----.
option_a: several coastal states officially announced their reservations regarding commercial fishing boundaries
option_b: ancient maritime civilizations began erecting harbor fortifications along the coast
option_c: the coastal waters had already been completely contaminated by toxic waste
option_d: no country in the hemisphere took any interest in oceanic conservation agreements
option_e: environmental ministers will agree to disband all ocean protection committees
explanation: "No sooner had S + V3 ... than + Simple Past" kalıbı (-mesiyle -mesi bir oldu / tam yapmıştı ki). Delegeler deniz biyoçeşitliliği anlaşma taslağını netleştirir netleştirmez bazı kıyı devletleri balıkçılık sınırlarına dair çekincelerini duyurdu.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Regular physical activity strengthens the immune system and significantly lowers the risk of chronic illnesses.

Yukarıdaki İngilizce cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?
option_a: Düzenli fiziksel aktivite bağışıklık sistemini güçlendirir ve kronik hastalık riskini önemli ölçüde düşürür.
option_b: Kronik hastalıkların riskini azaltan en etkili yöntem, bağışıklık sistemini güçlendiren fiziksel aktivitelerdir.
option_c: Fiziksel aktiviteler bağışıklık sistemine katkı sağladığı için kronik rahatsızlıkların önüne geçebilmektedir.
option_d: Bağışıklık sistemini güçlendirmek isteyen bireyler, kronik hastalıklardan korunmak için düzenli spor yapmalıdır.
option_e: Düzenli spor yapıldığında bağışıklık sistemi güçlenmekte ve böylece kronik hastalıklar tamamen yok olmaktadır.
explanation: Özne: "Regular physical activity" (Düzenli fiziksel aktivite), yüklemler: "strengthens" (güçlendirir) ve "significantly lowers" (önemli ölçüde düşürür). Birebir ve eksiksiz çeviri A seçeneğidir.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Düzenli kitap okuma alışkanlığı, bireylerin kelime dağarcığını zenginleştirir ve eleştirel düşünme becerilerini geliştirir.

Yukarıdaki Türkçe cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?
option_a: Reading books regularly is essential because it expands vocabulary as well as critical thinking abilities.
option_b: Developing critical thinking skills depends largely on the habit of reading books and expanding vocabulary.
option_c: The habit of reading books regularly enriches individuals' vocabulary and develops their critical thinking skills.
option_d: Individuals who read books regularly can improve both their vocabulary and critical thinking.
option_e: Having a rich vocabulary helps individuals develop critical thinking through regular reading.
explanation: Özne: "The habit of reading books regularly" (Düzenli kitap okuma alışkanlığı), yüklemler: "enriches" (zenginleştirir) ve "develops" (geliştirir). Tam ve doğru yapı C seçeneğidir.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
The historic city library, which was damaged in the earthquake, was meticulously restored by master craftsmen.

Yukarıdaki İngilizce cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?
option_a: Tarihi kütüphane depremden büyük hasar almış olsa da ustalar tarafından kısa sürede onarılmıştır.
option_b: Şehir kütüphanesi tarihi bir yapı olduğu için depremden sonra titiz bir restorasyon sürecinden geçti.
option_c: Depremde yıkılan şehir kütüphanesinin restorasyonu, alanında uzman zanaatkarlarca tamamlandı.
option_d: Usta zanaatkarlar, deprem sonrasında tarihi kütüphaneyi yeniden inşa etmek için büyük çaba harcadılar.
option_e: Depremde hasar gören tarihi şehir kütüphanesi, usta zanaatkarlar tarafından titizlikle restore edildi.
explanation: Sıfat cümleciği: "which was damaged in the earthquake" (depremde hasar gören), ana özne: "The historic city library" (tarihi şehir kütüphanesi), edilgen yüklem: "was meticulously restored" (titizlikle restore edildi).

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Küresel ısınmanın yıkıcı etkilerini azaltmak amacıyla, pek çok gelişmiş ülke fosil yakıt tüketimini kademeli olarak sınırlandırmaktadır.

Yukarıdaki Türkçe cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?
option_a: Although global warming causes devastating consequences, developed countries refuse to restrict their fossil fuel consumption.
option_b: Many countries have decided to stop using fossil fuels so that global warming will no longer be a major threat.
option_c: Limiting fossil fuel consumption in developed countries has completely eliminated the devastating impacts of global warming.
option_d: Because fossil fuel consumption increases rapidly, developed nations are trying to reduce the harm of global warming.
option_e: In order to mitigate the devastating effects of global warming, many developed countries are gradually limiting fossil fuel consumption.
explanation: Amaç belirten zarf öbeği: "In order to mitigate the devastating effects of global warming" (azaltmak amacıyla), ana özne: "many developed countries", yüklem: "are gradually limiting" (kademeli olarak sınırlandırmaktadır).

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Although modern communication technologies enable instantaneous connectivity, they often cause individuals to feel increasingly isolated.

Yukarıdaki İngilizce cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?
option_a: Kendilerini izole hisseden insanlar, anlık bağlantı kurabilmek için modern iletişim araçlarına yönelmektedirler.
option_b: İletişim teknolojileri geliştikçe insanların yalnızlık hissi artmakta ve gerçek bağlantılar kopmaktadır.
option_c: Modern iletişim teknolojileri anlık bağlantı sağlasa da bireylerin kendilerini giderek daha fazla izole hissetmelerine sıklıkla neden olmaktadır.
option_d: Bireyler kendilerini izole hissettikleri için modern iletişim araçları anlık bağlantı sağlamak amacıyla geliştirilmiştir.
option_e: Modern iletişim teknolojilerinin sağladığı anlık bağlantı imkanı, insanları yalnızlaşmaktan kurtarmaya yetmemektedir.
explanation: "Although ... enable instantaneous connectivity" -> anlık bağlantı sağlasa da, "they often cause individuals to feel increasingly isolated" -> bireylerin kendilerini giderek daha fazla izole hissetmelerine sıklıkla neden olmaktadır.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Önde gelen deniz biyologları, mercan resiflerini korumanın yalnızca su altı yaşamı için değil, aynı zamanda kıyı ekonomileri için de hayati olduğunu vurgulamaktadır.

Yukarıdaki Türkçe cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?
option_a: Unless coral reefs are protected by marine scientists, both marine ecosystems and coastal communities will collapse.
option_b: Coral reefs must be preserved immediately because coastal economies depend entirely on diverse underwater marine species.
option_c: Leading marine biologists emphasize that preserving coral reefs is vital not only for underwater life but also for coastal economies.
option_d: Preserving coastal economies requires marine biologists to protect fragile underwater ecosystems and coral reefs.
option_e: Marine biologists agree that protecting marine life is more important than supporting local coastal economic activities.
explanation: Özne: "Leading marine biologists" (Önde gelen deniz biyologları), yüklem: "emphasize that" (vurgulamaktadır), nesne cümleciği: "preserving coral reefs is vital not only for underwater life but also for coastal economies".

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Sanayi Devrimi'nden bu yana fosil yakıtların denetimsiz kullanımı, atmosferik sera gazı yoğunluğunu daha önce görülmemiş seviyelere çıkarmıştır.

Yukarıdaki Türkçe cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?
option_a: Although the Industrial Revolution encouraged fuel efficiency, greenhouse gases accumulated at alarming rates in the atmosphere.
option_b: Since the Industrial Revolution, the unchecked use of fossil fuels has driven atmospheric greenhouse gas concentrations to unprecedented levels.
option_c: The Industrial Revolution led to severe air pollution because fossil fuels were used without any safety regulations.
option_d: Atmospheric greenhouse gas concentrations reached high levels whenever fossil fuels were consumed by industrial factories.
option_e: Had the Industrial Revolution not relied on fossil fuels, greenhouse gas concentrations would never have risen so quickly.
explanation: Zaman ifadesi: "Since the Industrial Revolution" (Sanayi Devrimi'nden bu yana), özne: "the unchecked use of fossil fuels" (fosil yakıtların denetimsiz kullanımı), yüklem: "has driven ... to unprecedented levels" (görülmemiş seviyelere çıkarmıştır).

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Had the international maritime authorities reacted more decisively to the warning signs, the disastrous oil spill could have been largely prevented.

Yukarıdaki İngilizce cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?
option_a: Uluslararası denizcilik otoriteleri kararlı davrandığı takdirde benzer petrol sızıntısı felaketlerinin önüne kolayca geçilebilir.
option_b: Uyarı işaretlerine rağmen uluslararası yetkililer kararlı adımlar atmadığı için petrol sızıntısı büyük bir felakete dönüşmüştür.
option_c: Petrol sızıntısının önlenebilmesi için denizcilik yetkililerinin uyarı işaretlerini dikkate alarak derhal harekete geçmesi gerekirdi.
option_d: Felaket boyutundaki petrol sızıntısının tamamen engellenememesi, denizcilik kurumlarının uyarıları geç fark etmesinden kaynaklanmıştır.
option_e: Uluslararası denizcilik yetkilileri uyarı işaretlerine daha kararlı bir şekilde tepki vermiş olsalardı, felaket niteliğindeki petrol sızıntısı büyük ölçüde önlenebilirdi.
explanation: Devrik Type 3 Conditional ("Had ... reacted ..."): "tepki vermiş olsalardı", sonuç yüklemi ("could have been largely prevented"): "büyük ölçüde önlenebilirdi". Eksiksiz ve tam çeviri E seçeneğidir.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Bir toplumun gerçek gelişmişlik düzeyi, yalnızca ekonomik büyüme göstergeleriyle değil; vatandaşlarına sunduğu eğitim, sağlık ve adalet standartlarıyla ölçülür.

Yukarıdaki Türkçe cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?
option_a: Measuring development requires economists to compare financial performance with public satisfaction in healthcare.
option_b: Unless a society achieves high economic growth, it cannot provide adequate standards of education and justice for its citizens.
option_c: Citizens evaluate their society's progress based solely on whether education and healthcare institutions function properly.
option_d: Economic growth indicators show a society's development, whereas education and healthcare are secondary welfare factors.
option_e: A society's true level of development is measured not merely by economic growth indicators, but by the standards of education, healthcare, and justice it provides to its citizens.
explanation: Özne: "A society's true level of development" (Bir toplumun gerçek gelişmişlik düzeyi), edilgen yüklem: "is measured not merely by ..., but by ..." (yalnızca ... ile değil, ... ile ölçülür). Tam karşılık E seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Honeybees are renowned for their remarkable communication method known as the 'waggle dance.' When a foraging worker bee discovers a rich patch of nectar-bearing flowers, she returns to the hive and performs a figure-eight dance on the honeycomb. The angle of the dance relative to the sun indicates the direction of the food source, while the duration of the waggle run conveys the distance to the flowers.

According to the passage, the waggle dance performed by a honeybee -----.
option_a: communicates both the direction and distance of a floral nectar source
option_b: serves to frighten away potential rivals trying to enter the hive
option_c: is performed exclusively during cold winter months inside the nest
option_d: indicates that the worker bee has failed to locate any suitable blossoms
option_e: signals to the queen bee that a predator is approaching the colony
explanation: Metinde "The angle ... indicates the direction ..., while the duration ... conveys the distance to the flowers" ifadesi açıkça dansın hem yönü hem de mesafeyi aktardığını doğrulamaktadır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The International Space Station (ISS) orbits Earth roughly 400 kilometers above the surface at an astonishing speed of approximately 28,000 kilometers per hour. Circling the globe every 90 minutes, astronauts aboard the station experience 16 sunrises and sunsets every 24 hours. The microgravity environment aboard this floating laboratory allows researchers from around the world to conduct experiments in biology, physics, and materials science that would be impossible under normal terrestrial conditions.

It is stated in the passage that the unique environment of the ISS enables researchers to -----.
option_a: carry out scientific experiments that cannot be performed on Earth
option_b: observe deep oceanic marine life from high above the atmosphere
option_c: alter the speed at which our planet completes its daily rotation
option_d: travel to distant galaxies within a short time frame
option_e: eliminate the need for human astronauts to experience any sunlight
explanation: Metnin son cümlesinde mikro yerçekimi ortamının Dünya'da imkansız olan deneylerin yapılmasına olanak tanıdığı ("conduct experiments ... that would be impossible under normal terrestrial conditions") açıkça ifade edilmiştir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Volcanic ash may appear soft and powdery, but it is actually composed of tiny, jagged particles of fractured rock and volcanic glass. When inhaled, these sharp microscopic fragments can severely irritate human respiratory passages and cause acute breathing difficulties, particularly in individuals with pre-existing pulmonary illnesses such as asthma. Furthermore, heavy ash accumulations on building roofs can cause structural collapses due to their enormous weight, especially when saturated with rainwater.

According to the passage, volcanic ash is hazardous to humans and structures because it -----.
option_a: dissolves instantaneously in rainwater and evaporates into harmless gas
option_b: consists entirely of soft organic plant dust that improves soil fertility
option_c: is composed of jagged rock and glass particles that injure lungs and burdens roofs with immense weight
option_d: permanently stops all forms of precipitation in neighboring geographic areas
option_e: causes only minor aesthetic blemishes without any physical risk to buildings
explanation: Metne göre volkanik kül akciğerleri tahriş eden sivri kaya ve cam parçacıklarından oluşur ve ıslandığında binaların çatılarını çökertecek kadar ağır bir yük bindirir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The deep ocean, extending below 200 meters where sunlight cannot penetrate, constitutes the largest living habitat on Earth. In this perpetually dark and frigid realm, immense hydrostatic pressure prevails, and organic food is exceptionally scarce. To survive under these hostile conditions, deep-sea creatures have evolved remarkable adaptations. Many species utilize bioluminescence—chemical light produced within their bodies—to attract prey, deter predators, or signal prospective mates, while others possess expandable stomachs to engulf meals substantially larger than themselves.

It can be understood from the passage that bioluminescence in deep-sea creatures -----.
option_a: serves multiple vital survival functions, including predation, defense, and mating
option_b: is an accidental chemical byproduct that confers no practical utility
option_c: occurs only when sunlight briefly filters through upper ocean layers
option_d: prevents them from consuming prey larger than their own body dimensions
option_e: is primarily utilized to raise their internal body temperature in icy waters
explanation: Metinde canlıların kimyasal ışığı av çekmek (predation), avcılardan korunmak (defense) ve eş bulmak (mating) gibi çoklu hayatta kalma işlevleri için kullandığı ("attract prey, deter predators, or signal prospective mates") belirtilmiştir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The invention of papermaking in ancient China during the Han dynasty revolutionized the preservation and transmission of human knowledge. Prior to paper, Chinese texts were inscribed on heavy bamboo tablets or costly silk fabric, both of which severely restricted the dissemination of literature and administrative records. The introduction of lightweight, inexpensive paper manufactured from plant fibers and rags transformed education and imperial governance, eventually spreading along trade routes to the Islamic world and medieval Europe.

It can be inferred from the passage that before paper was invented, writing materials in China -----.
option_a: were imported in vast quantities from ancient Mediterranean civilizations
option_b: were entirely nonexistent, leaving society without any written records
option_c: were so fragile that they disintegrated during routine transport
option_d: were cumbersome or prohibitively expensive, which limited the widespread circulation of texts
option_e: allowed all ordinary citizens affordable and open access to scholarship
explanation: Parçaya göre kağıttan önceki bambu şeritler ağır (cumbersome), ipek ise çok pahalıydı (prohibitively expensive); bu durum metinlerin geniş kitlelere yayılmasını ciddi şekilde kısıtlamıştı.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Urban green spaces, such as public parks, rooftop gardens, and tree-lined boulevards, provide vital ecological and psychological benefits in crowded metropolises. Beyond absorbing carbon dioxide and mitigating the 'urban heat island' effect by shading paved surfaces, these natural pockets offer city residents tranquil refuges that lower stress hormones and promote active exercise. Consequently, progressive municipal architects increasingly view green infrastructure not as an optional luxury, but as an indispensable pillar of sustainable urban health.

The main purpose of the author in this passage is to -----.
option_a: criticize municipal leaders for investing excessive funds in public park maintenance
option_b: highlight the multifaceted ecological and health benefits of incorporating nature into urban centers
option_c: explain why rooftop gardens cannot be maintained during hot summer seasons
option_d: argue that rural life is inherently superior to living in modern urban centers
option_e: prove that paved roads are the exclusive cause of psychological distress in towns
explanation: Yazarın temel amacı, kentsel yeşil alanların hem çevresel (karbon emilimi, ısı adası azaltımı) hem de insan sağlığına yönelik (stres azaltma, spor) çok yönlü faydalarını ve zorunluluğunu ortaya koymaktır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Although placebos contain no biologically active therapeutic ingredients, patients administered them frequently report genuine symptom relief—a psychological reality known as the placebo effect. Advanced neuroimaging demonstrates that optimistic clinical expectations trigger the release of organic neurotransmitters, including endorphins and dopamine, which physically inhibit pain pathways in the brain. However, this cognitive mechanism possesses an equally potent mirror image: the nocebo effect, in which the negative anticipation of adverse side effects induces tangible physical discomfort.

Which of the following can be reasonably deduced from the passage regarding the placebo and nocebo effects?
option_a: The nocebo effect completely eliminates the brain's capacity to produce endorphins permanently.
option_b: Both phenomena demonstrate that mental expectations can trigger genuine physiological responses in the human body.
option_c: Brain scanning technology has failed to locate any neurological basis for cognitive expectations.
option_d: Placebos are scientifically effective only when administered without patient knowledge.
option_e: Physical pain is merely an imaginary sensation that requires no medical intervention.
explanation: Hem plasebo hem de nosebo, hastanın zihinsel beklentilerinin (olumlu beklentide endorfin/dopamin salınımı, olumsuz beklentide gerçek rahatsızlık oluşması) vücutta somut fizyolojik tepkiler ürettiğini kanıtlar.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
For decades, human space colonization remained firmly confined to the domain of speculative science fiction. Today, private aerospace enterprises speak boldly of establishing self-sustaining cities on Mars within our generation. Yet, these optimistic pronouncements gloss over monumental biological hurdles: pervasive cosmic radiation that mutates cellular DNA, prolonged microgravity that degrades musculoskeletal density, and the psychological strain of extreme isolation. Until engineers devise foolproof shields and countermeasures for these existential hazards, proclamations of imminent interplanetary migration remain prematurely confident.

The author's attitude towards the near-term feasibility of human colonization on Mars can best be described as -----.
option_a: unconditionally enthusiastic and celebratory
option_b: cautious and skeptical
option_c: entirely indifferent and detached
option_d: aggressively hostile and mocking
option_e: amused and sarcastic
explanation: Yazar Mars'a yerleşme iddialarının ciddi biyolojik engelleri göz ardı ettiğini vurgulayarak erken ve aşırı iyimser olduğunu belirtmektedir. Bu tutum "cautious and skeptical" (temkinli ve şüpheci) olarak nitelenir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Coral reefs sustain more than twenty-five percent of all marine species despite covering less than one percent of the ocean floor. However, climate change poses an existential threat to these biodiversity hotspots. When sea surface temperatures climb even one degree above summer averages, corals expel their symbiotic photosynthetic microalgae, turning stark white—a devastating crisis known as coral bleaching. Deprived of their primary nutrient providers, bleached corals gradually starve, and prolonged warming triggers widespread reef mortality, threatening fisheries and coastal barriers globally.

Which of the following would be the most suitable title for this passage?
option_a: Economic Advantages of Industrial Deep-Sea Fishing Fleets
option_b: The Dynamics of Oceanic Tides in Tropical Lagoons
option_c: Coral Reefs: Marine Biodiversity Under Threat from Warming Oceans
option_d: How Marine Algae Compete for Sunlight in Shallow Waters
option_e: The Geological Evolution of Submerged Volcanic Archipelagos
explanation: Metin mercan resiflerinin muazzam denizel biyoçeşitliliğini ve küresel okyanus ısınmasının yol açtığı beyazlama tehlikesini konu edinir. En uygun ve kapsamlı başlık C seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Liam: Have you had a chance to visit the new modern art exhibition at the municipal gallery?
Noah: Not yet, but I heard mixed reviews from some classmates. Did you find it worthwhile?
Liam: -----
Noah: Really? In that case, I will definitely purchase an admission ticket for this Saturday.
option_a: I thought it was a complete waste of time, so you shouldn't bother going.
option_b: I have never had any interest in contemporary paintings or sculptures.
option_c: Absolutely! The interactive digital installations were breathtaking and unlike anything I've seen.
option_d: The gallery was completely closed for electrical repairs when I arrived.
option_e: Admission fees were far too high, so I just waited in the bookstore next door.
explanation: Noah "Gerçekten mi? Öyleyse kesinlikle bu cumartesi için bilet alacağım" dediğine göre Liam sergiyi çok beğenmiş ve coşkuyla övmüş olmalıdır (C seçeneği).

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Student: I'm really struggling to memorize all these academic vocabulary words for the upcoming language test.
Teacher: -----
Student: That makes total sense. Encountering words inside authentic sentences will certainly make them stick better than memorizing isolated lists.
option_a: You should stop reading English materials and rely entirely on intuition during the exam.
option_b: Most fluent language speakers never study any vocabulary at all throughout their education.
option_c: English vocabulary is far too complex, so you should focus exclusively on verb tenses.
option_d: Why don't you try learning them in context through extensive reading rather than relying on isolated flashcards?
option_e: You must memorize twenty pages of a dictionary word-for-word by tomorrow morning.
explanation: Öğrenci "Kelimelerle gerçek cümleler içinde karşılaşmanın izole listelerden çok daha akılda kalıcı olacağını" belirterek öğretmenin D seçeneğindeki bağlamda okuma önerisini onaylamaktadır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Sarah: Several of us from the university are organizing a coastal cleanup drive this Saturday morning. Would you care to join us?
David: -----
Sarah: That's wonderful! Don't worry about bags or heavy gloves; the environmental club will provide all necessary supplies on-site.
option_a: Why should volunteers clean the coast when industrial shipping causes most ocean litter?
option_b: I strongly dislike beach activities and prefer spending my entire weekend playing video games.
option_c: I have an unavoidable family gathering scheduled for early Saturday morning.
option_d: I already organized my own private cleanup yesterday, so I don't need any more outdoor work.
option_e: I'd love to participate, but I don't have any protective work gloves or heavy-duty trash bags.
explanation: Sarah'nin "Çanta veya eldivenleri dert etme; çevre kulübü tüm ekipmanı alanda temin edecek" yanıtı, David'in E seçeneğindeki "Katılmak isterim ama eldivenim ve çöp torbam yok" ifadesine doğrudan karşılıktır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Passenger: Excuse me, our connecting flight to Frankfurt has just been canceled due to a technical malfunction. What alternatives do we have?
Airline Agent: -----
Passenger: That sounds very acceptable. As long as our checked luggage is transferred directly, we don't mind the brief two-hour layover.
option_a: The cancellation is not the airline's fault, so you must find and pay for your own hotel.
option_b: You should have checked international weather patterns before purchasing tickets with us.
option_c: All passengers must vacate the departures hall immediately and wait for an SMS update.
option_d: We can rebook you on the partner airline's departure in two hours, or issue a full refund if you prefer.
option_e: There are no available seats on any European flight for the next three weeks.
explanation: Yolcunun "Bu oldukça makul. Bagajımız doğrudan aktarıldığı sürece 2 saatlik kısa beklemeyi sorun etmeyiz" yanıtı, görevlinin D seçeneğindeki iki saat sonraki ortak uçuşa yerleştirme teklifine uygundur.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Doctor: Your comprehensive blood panel shows that your vitamin D and ferritin levels are considerably below the recommended threshold.
Patient: That certainly explains why I have felt perpetually fatigued over the past month. Will I require aggressive prescription medication?
Doctor: -----
Patient: Understood. I will take the daily oral supplements consistently and schedule a follow-up test in two months.
option_a: You must avoid eating all fruits, vegetables, and whole grains until your next consultation.
option_b: Not aggressive medication, but I advise a targeted daily supplement regimen alongside increased outdoor sunlight exposure.
option_c: Your laboratory markers are completely optimal, so you should stop worrying about your stamina.
option_d: There is no known medical cure for low vitamin levels, so you will just have to endure exhaustion.
option_e: You must be admitted to the emergency ward immediately for intensive surgical care.
explanation: Hastanın takviyeleri her gün düzenli alacağını ve iki ay sonra kontrole geleceğini ifade etmesi, doktorun B seçeneğindeki hedefe yönelik günlük takviye ve güneş ışığı tavsiyesine verilen cevaptır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Project Director: The enterprise client has requested three major structural modifications just forty-eight hours prior to our scheduled software launch.
Lead Engineer: -----
Project Director: I agree completely. Let's schedule an emergency briefing to explain that rushing these changes now would compromise core data security.
option_a: The corporate client knows far more about backend architecture than our entire engineering department.
option_b: We should accept every single demand immediately and bypass all security protocols.
option_c: Let's terminate our company's business license immediately and disconnect all servers.
option_d: We can easily rewrite the entire database infrastructure overnight without performing any quality tests.
option_e: Implementing such fundamental changes at this late stage would introduce severe instability and bugs into the production build.
explanation: Proje direktörü "Tamamen katılıyorum. Bu değişiklikleri alelacele uygulamanın veri güvenliğini tehlikeye atacağını açıklayalım" dediği için baş mühendis E seçeneğindeki son dakika değişikliklerinin sisteme kararsızlık ve hata getireceği uyarısını yapmış olmalıdır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Policy Analyst: Emerging economies frequently argue that demanding an immediate halt to fossil fuel usage unfairly hinders their industrial development.
Climate Economist: While industrial aspirations are legitimate, the escalating economic costs of extreme weather disasters will soon outstrip the cost of adopting clean technologies.
Policy Analyst: -----
Climate Economist: Precisely. That is why international climate agreements must facilitate subsidized clean technology transfers rather than relying solely on punitive regulations.
option_a: So developing nations should be granted unconditional permission to burn coal indefinitely?
option_b: Then we must concede that economic prosperity and environmental stewardship are mutually exclusive.
option_c: Renewable technology has been shown to cause more economic devastation than global warming.
option_d: So the equitable solution lies in wealthy nations providing substantial technological and financial subsidies to bridge the gap?
option_e: Why should industrialized nations care about carbon emissions originating in other hemispheres?
explanation: Ekonomistin "Precisely. That is why international climate agreements must facilitate subsidized clean technology transfers..." (Kesinlikle. İşte bu yüzden uluslararası anlaşmalar sübvanse edilmiş temiz teknoloji transferini kolaylaştırmalıdır) onayı, Analistin D seçeneğindeki çözüm önerisine doğrudan uyar.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Historian A: Early modern chronicles frequently depicted the fall of the Western Roman Empire as an abrupt, catastrophic event triggered exclusively by barbarian invasions.
Historian B: -----
Historian A: Exactly. Deep-seated fiscal debasement, administrative fragmentation, and rural depopulation had eroded imperial resilience long before barbarian tribes breached the frontiers.
option_a: External warfare was the sole factor that ever determined the lifespan of ancient Mediterranean kingdoms.
option_b: Recent scholarship demonstrates that it was actually a protracted, centuries-long transformation driven predominantly by internal structural decay.
option_c: We possess no surviving epigraphic or archaeological material from antiquity to formulate any reasonable historical model.
option_d: The Roman Empire never truly fragmented and remained the dominant superpower throughout medieval centuries.
option_e: Those early accounts were thoroughly accurate, and modern historians have no reason to revisit the consensus.
explanation: Tarihçi A "Exactly. Deep-seated fiscal debasement, administrative fragmentation..." (Kesinlikle. Mali çöküş ve idari bölünme imparatorluğu zaten zayıflatmıştı) diyerek Tarihçi B'nin B seçeneğinde dile getirdiği "yüzyıllar süren ve iç yapısal çöküşle tetiklenen dönüşüm" tezini onaylamaktadır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Geneticist: With the refinement of precision gene-editing tools, we stand on the threshold of eradicating devastating monogenic disorders permanently.
Bioethicist: The clinical promise is undeniable, yet without enforceable international oversight, the identical technique could easily be deployed for non-therapeutic genetic enhancement.
Geneticist: -----
Bioethicist: Exactly. That could entrench existing socioeconomic disparities into a profound and irreversible biological caste system.
option_a: No competent scientist would ever consider applying molecular tools for cosmetic or cognitive traits.
option_b: And that raises the chilling prospect of wealthy elites purchasing engineered physical or cognitive advantages for their progeny.
option_c: So there is virtually no justification for ethical deliberation regarding gene-editing technologies.
option_d: All genetic editing tools should be commercialized directly to consumers without clinical screening.
option_e: The underlying science is so elementary that high school laboratories will master it within days.
explanation: Biyoetikçinin "Exactly. That could entrench existing socioeconomic disparities into a profound biological caste system" (Kesinlikle. Bu durum sosyoekonomik eşitsizlikleri geri döndürülemez bir biyolojik kast sistemine dönüştürebilir) ifadesi, Genetikçinin B seçeneğindeki zengin elitlerin çocuklarına genetik avantaj satın alması uyarısına verilmiş tam destektir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
It was only after the fierce storm subsided late in the evening that the emergency crews could initiate rescue operations.

Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın olan seçeneği bulunuz.
option_a: The storm was so mild that emergency workers completed all rescue operations before dusk.
option_b: If emergency crews had arrived earlier, the storm would not have caused any damage to the coastal town.
option_c: Although the fierce storm continued throughout the night, emergency crews managed to rescue everyone.
option_d: The emergency crews were unable to begin rescue operations until the fierce storm calmed down late in the evening.
option_e: Emergency workers initiated rescue efforts as soon as the fierce storm began late in the evening.
explanation: "It was only after X that Y could happen" (ancak X olduktan sonra Y yapılabildi) ifadesi "Y was unable to happen until X happened" (X gerçekleşene kadar Y yapılamadı) ifadesine anlamca birebir denktir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
A friendly coworker invites you to join an informal dinner party tonight, but you have an early morning business flight tomorrow and need to pack and rest. You want to decline the invitation politely without hurting their feelings.

What would you say?
option_a: You should have notified me several days ago instead of disturbing me with last-minute plans.
option_b: I will come only if you guarantee that the entire gathering will end in less than thirty minutes.
option_c: Why would you invite me on a weeknight when you know I detest eating out at crowded diners?
option_d: Thank you so much for the kind invite, but I have an early morning flight tomorrow and need to prepare, so I'll have to pass this time.
option_e: Your dinner parties are notoriously dull, so I would much rather stay home and sleep.
explanation: Kişiyi incitmeden, nazikçe teşekkür ederek erken uçuş mazeretini belirten ve bu seferlik katılamayacağını ifade eden en uygun cümle D seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Nobody in our academic department has published more research papers on renewable energy than Dr. Evans.

Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın olan seçeneği bulunuz.
option_a: Dr. Evans rarely authors papers on renewable energy compared to his departmental peers.
option_b: Several researchers in our department have published substantially more papers than Dr. Evans.
option_c: Unless Dr. Evans publishes more articles, our academic department will lose its research accreditation.
option_d: Dr. Evans is the only scholar in the department who refuses to collaborate on clean energy projects.
option_e: Dr. Evans has published at least as many or more research papers on renewable energy as anyone else in our academic department.
explanation: "Bölümümüzde hiç kimse Dr. Evans'tan daha fazla makale yayınlamadı" = Dr. Evans en çok makale yayınlayan kişidir (herkes kadar ya da herkesten fazla yayınlamıştır). Birebir denk ifade A'dır.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Despite possessing extensive reserves of natural minerals, the nation remained economically stagnant due to poor infrastructure and weak governance.

Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın olan seçeneği bulunuz.
option_a: Mineral reserves were exhausted completely before the government could build adequate transport corridors.
option_b: The nation attained unprecedented economic prosperity because its leaders invested all mineral revenues into modern roads.
option_c: If the nation had lacked mineral wealth, its transportation infrastructure would have modernized much faster.
option_d: Neither natural mineral deposits nor civil administration had any impact on the nation's financial status.
option_e: Inadequate infrastructure and ineffective governance prevented the nation from growing economically, even though it had abundant mineral wealth.
explanation: "Despite possessing extensive reserves" = even though it had abundant mineral wealth; "remained stagnant due to poor infrastructure and weak governance" = inadequate infrastructure and ineffective governance prevented it from growing economically.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
You are staying at a business hotel for an important international summit, but the heating system in your room is not functioning on a freezing winter night. After phoning the front desk twice without any result, you head downstairs to demand an immediate solution.

What would you say to the duty manager?
option_a: I have reported the heating failure in my room twice without any action; since the room is freezing, I need it repaired right now or to be moved to another room.
option_b: The outdoor temperature is rather brisk tonight, but I certainly wouldn't want to inconvenience anyone regarding my room.
option_c: Hotel personnel everywhere are completely incompetent, and everyone at the desk should be discharged immediately!
option_d: Could you perhaps dim the lobby chandeliers slightly so that other guests can sleep more peacefully?
option_e: I intend to purchase a space heater from a downtown shop tomorrow, so please disregard my earlier calls.
explanation: İki kez bildirilmesine rağmen çözülmeyen donma derecesindeki oda sorununu kararlı, makul ve doğrudan bir dille ifade edip derhal tamir veya oda değişikliği talep eden en uygun cümle A seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
If modern medical science had not developed effective vaccines, many infectious diseases that are rare today would still be widespread.

Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın olan seçeneği bulunuz.
option_a: Even without vaccinations, modern medicine would have halted infectious diseases with basic hygiene alone.
option_b: Many infectious diseases are uncommon nowadays primarily because effective vaccines were developed by modern medical science.
option_c: Vaccines are no longer considered necessary because the human immune system has evolved complete resistance.
option_d: Infectious illnesses were completely eradicated well before pharmaceutical labs began engineering vaccines.
option_e: Although vaccines were formulated decades ago, infectious diseases remain just as prevalent as in past centuries.
explanation: Type 3 karşı-olgusal koşul: "Aşılar geliştirilmemiş olsaydı pek çok hastalık yaygın olmaya devam edecekti" = Bu hastalıkların günümüzde nadir olmasının temel sebebi tıbbın etkili aşılar geliştirmiş olmasıdır (B seçeneği).

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Far from being merely an ornamental art form, ancient monumental architecture functioned as a potent instrument of political legitimation and religious hegemony.

Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın olan seçeneği bulunuz.
option_a: While religious beliefs influenced monumental masonry, politicians seldom used grand structures for public messaging.
option_b: Ancient monumental buildings were not simply decorative; they played an essential role in reinforcing political legitimacy and religious authority.
option_c: Monumental architecture shed all spiritual significance once political dynasties began using it as decorative backdrop.
option_d: The decorative motifs of ancient monuments were considerably more advanced than their political symbolism.
option_e: Ancient emperors erected monumental buildings purely for aesthetic delight without any political calculations.
explanation: "Far from being merely ornamental" (sadece dekoratif olmaktan çok uzak / sadece dekoratif değildi) + "functioned as a potent instrument of political legitimation and religious hegemony" (siyasi meşruiyet ve dini otoriteyi pekiştirmede hayati rol oynadı).

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
You are directing an executive project team, and one of your senior analysts submits a slide deck containing several outdated market figures right before a pivotal client presentation. You need to alert them so they can correct the metrics immediately, while preserving team morale and their professional standing.

What would you say?
option_a: Statistics are irrelevant in business meetings, so let's delete all numerical slides and speak off the cuff.
option_b: You clearly didn't bother verifying your numbers, so I am removing your name from this presentation deck entirely.
option_c: Excellent work on the comprehensive analysis, but a few of the market metrics in section three appear outdated; let's quickly refresh them with last quarter's numbers before we begin.
option_d: Let's simply present these incorrect figures to the boardroom and pray that no executive notices our blunders.
option_e: I have never witnessed such incompetent slide preparation from a senior employee in my professional life.
explanation: Hem çalışmayı takdir eden hem de eski verileri yapıcı ve diplomatik biçimde toplantı öncesinde güncellemeye yönlendiren en profesyonel yaklaşım C seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Only through coordinated multilateral cooperation and transparent data exchange can humanity hope to mitigate the catastrophic perils of future global pandemics.

Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın olan seçeneği bulunuz.
option_a: Transparent data exchange will merely intensify worldwide panic unless all sovereign borders are shut permanently.
option_b: Coordinated international action is helpful, but individual sovereign nations can easily eradicate global pandemics alone.
option_c: International health bodies have already eliminated the possibility of future pandemics through global clinical trials.
option_d: If future viral outbreaks occur, sharing clinical data openly will be pointless because catastrophic harm is inevitable.
option_e: Unless nations collaborate globally and share information openly, mankind has little prospect of reducing the devastating threats posed by future pandemics.
explanation: "Only through X can Y happen" = "Unless X happens, Y cannot happen" (Uluslararası iş birliği ve açık bilgi paylaşımı olmadıkça insanlığın gelecekteki pandemi tehditlerini azaltma umudu yoktur). Birebir ve eksiksiz denk ifade E seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) The olive tree has been a foundational pillar of Mediterranean agriculture and civilization for thousands of years. (II) Ancient societies in Greece and Rome revered olive oil not only as a nutritional staple, but also as lamp fuel and sacred ceremonial ointment. (III) Modern industrial plastics, by contrast, are synthesized predominantly from refined petroleum fractions. (IV) In classical antiquity, olive wreaths were presented to athletic champions and diplomatic envoys as universal emblems of peace and prosperity. (V) Even today, traditional olive groves across southern Europe continue to shape local culinary identities and rural economies.

Numaralanmış cümlelerden hangisi parçanın anlam akışını bozmaktadır?
option_a: IV
option_b: I
option_c: V
option_d: II
option_e: III
explanation: Paragraf boyunca zeytin ağacı ve zeytinyağının Akdeniz tarihindeki, kültüründeki ve ekonomisindeki kutsal ve pratik yeri anlatılmaktadır. (III) numaralı cümle ise konuyla hiçbir ilgisi olmayan modern plastiklerin petrolden üretilmesine değinerek anlam akışını bozmaktadır.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
In 1928, Scottish bacteriologist Alexander Fleming returned to his London laboratory from holiday and observed an unusual mold growing on an uncovered petri dish of staphylococci bacteria. Curiously, the bacterial colonies immediately adjacent to the fungal growth had completely dissolved. ----- Fleming subsequently identified the active therapeutic substance secreted by the mold as penicillin, inaugurating the era of modern antibiotic medicine that has saved countless millions of lives.

Boş bırakılan yere düşüncenin akışına göre getirilebilecek en uygun cümle hangisidir?
option_a: He promptly discarded all laboratory glassware into the incinerator without recording any notes.
option_b: Most microbiologists during the 1920s preferred studying planetary orbits rather than bacterial cultures.
option_c: Recognizing that this fungus produced a potent chemical agent capable of destroying bacteria, he isolated it for further experimental cultivation.
option_d: Baker's yeast is an organic ingredient traditionally utilized in baking artisan sourdough bread.
option_e: Fleming concluded that bacterial strains were entirely beneficial microbes requiring no medical intervention.
explanation: Boşluğun öncesinde bakterilerin küf etrafında eridiği gözlemi, sonrasında ise Fleming'in bu maddeyi penisilin olarak tanımlaması yer alır. C seçeneği ("bu mantarın bakterileri yok eden güçlü bir kimyasal madde ürettiğini fark ederek onu ileri deneyler için izole etti") iki cümle arasındaki mantık köprüsünü kurar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Monarch butterflies undertake one of the most astonishing multi-generational migrations in the natural world. (II) Every autumn, millions of these fragile insects journey thousands of kilometers from Canada and the northern United States to forested sanctuaries in the mountains of central Mexico. (III) What makes this endurance feat truly extraordinary is that the migrating individuals have never visited the Mexican overwintering sites before; they navigate using navigational cues inherited genetically. (IV) Commercial passenger jetliners burn millions of gallons of aviation fuel annually while ferrying tourists across oceans. (V) Come spring, surviving butterflies travel northward once more, reproducing along the route to perpetuate an enduring natural cycle.

Numaralanmış cümlelerden hangisi parçanın anlam akışını bozmaktadır?
option_a: V
option_b: II
option_c: III
option_d: I
option_e: IV
explanation: Metin Kral kelebeklerinin Kuzey Amerika'dan Meksika'ya uzanan hayret verici genetik göç serüvenini anlatmaktadır. (IV) numaralı cümle ise ticari uçakların jet yakıtı tüketiminden bahsederek tematik bütünlüğü koparmaktadır.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
Acquiring multiple spoken languages during early childhood confers substantial cognitive and neurological benefits. Bilingual children regularly exhibit superior executive functioning, including enhanced attention switching, cognitive flexibility, and creative problem-solving abilities. ----- Exposure to diverse grammatical frameworks helps young minds understand that different cultures conceptualize reality in distinct ways, cultivating deeper social empathy and communicative tolerance.

Boş bırakılan yere düşüncenin akışına göre getirilebilecek en uygun cümle hangisidir?
option_a: Grammar conventions in classical languages like Sanskrit are notoriously frustrating for toddlers to grasp.
option_b: Furthermore, early bilingualism strengthens children's communicative awareness and perspective-taking faculties.
option_c: Monolingual immersion is universally accepted as the fastest path toward cultivating musical appreciation.
option_d: Learning two languages simultaneously induces severe speech impediments that permanently stunt intellectual growth.
option_e: Most youngsters forget their primary maternal dialect completely once they enter formal primary schooling.
explanation: Boşluk öncesinde zihinsel esneklik ve dikkat kontrolü anlatılmış, boşluk sonrasında ise farklı dil sistemlerinin empati ve farklı bakış açılarını anlamaya katkısı verilmiştir. "Furthermore" (Ayrıca) ile başlayan B seçeneği ("çocukların iletişimsel farkındalık ve başkalarının bakış açısını anlama yetisini güçlendirir") bu geçişi sağlar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Robotic rovers exploring Mars have fundamentally rewritten our comprehension of the planet's ancient hydrological history. (II) Advanced spectrometer instruments on rovers have identified layered clay deposits and dried river deltas, confirming that liquid water once flowed persistently across the Martian crust. (III) Organic carbon molecules and seasonal atmospheric methane fluctuations further suggest the possibility of past habitable microscopic environments. (IV) Future missions aim to seal pristine drilled rock samples in titanium tubes to be collected by an orbiter and returned to Earth. (V) Engineering luxury supersonic passenger jets for business travelers crossing the Atlantic continues to encounter prohibitive fuel costs.

Numaralanmış cümlelerden hangisi parçanın anlam akışını bozmaktadır?
option_a: I
option_b: V
option_c: II
option_d: IV
option_e: III
explanation: Paragraf Mars'ta görev yapan uzay araçlarının su ve geçmiş yaşam izlerine dair keşiflerini anlatmaktadır. (V) numaralı cümle ise Atlantik aşırı lüks süpersonik uçak mühendisliğinden bahsederek konuyla tamamen alakasız kalmaktadır.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
Offshore wind energy has evolved into a vital pillar of the global strategy to replace carbon-intensive electrical generation. Turbines anchored in open ocean waters benefit from stronger and far more dependable wind regimes than onshore towers, enabling them to generate vastly greater energy output. ----- Nonetheless, with ongoing engineering innovations in floating platform stabilization and high-voltage subsea cables, offshore installations are steadily pushing into deeper waters.

Boş bırakılan yere düşüncenin akışına göre getirilebilecek en uygun cümle hangisidir?
option_a: Wind dynamics across marine shores are identical to air currents found deep inside underground limestone caverns.
option_b: Thermal coal plants generate zero greenhouse emissions and require negligible operational oversight.
option_c: Subsea wind turbines cease generating electric current whenever surface wave temperatures dip below freezing.
option_d: However, harsh marine environments present immense structural challenges and demand substantial capital expenditure for construction and maintenance.
option_e: Coastal municipalities have universally legislated against all forms of mechanical electrical infrastructure.
explanation: Boşluktan önce açık deniz rüzgar türbinlerinin yüksek verimi övülmüş, boşluktan sonra ise "Nonetheless" (Yine de mühendislik yenilikleriyle derin sulara yayılıyor) denmiştir. Boşluğa açık deniz koşullarının zorluk ve maliyetini getiren "However..." (D seçeneği) gelmelidir.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Utilitarianism, a prominent normative ethical theory systematized by Jeremy Bentham and John Stuart Mill, holds that the moral quality of an action is judged exclusively by its consequences. (II) In essence, an action is deemed virtuous if it fosters the greatest net happiness for the largest number of sentient beings. (III) Sizable philosophical objections contend that this aggregate calculus could theoretically sanction trampling fundamental human rights if a net societal benefit is attained. (IV) Ancient Olympic sprinters in classical Greece competed naked in stadion races to symbolize physical purity and democratic equality. (V) To resolve this vulnerability, modern rule-utilitarians argue that universal moral rules—such as strictly prohibiting torture—must be maintained because adherence maximizes utility over the long run.

Numaralanmış cümlelerden hangisi parçanın anlam akışını bozmaktadır?
option_a: I
option_b: IV
option_c: III
option_d: V
option_e: II
explanation: Paragraf baştan sona faydacı etik teorisini (utilitarianism), getirdiği mutluluk hesabını, birey hakları eleştirisini ve kural-faydacılığının çözümünü tartışmaktadır. (IV) numaralı cümle ise Antik Yunan olimpiyat koşucularından bahsederek felsefi akışı tamamen koparmaktadır.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
Before the establishment of standardized musical notation in medieval Europe, liturgical melodies were preserved and transmitted entirely through oral recitation. Monastic cantors spent decades memorizing thousands of complex Gregorian chants, relying wholly on fallible human recall. ----- Guido of Arezzo's eleventh-century innovation of a four-line musical staff fundamentally transformed sacred culture, allowing choristers to accurately sight-read and reproduce unfamiliar chants across distant abbeys.

Boş bırakılan yere düşüncenin akışına göre getirilebilecek en uygun cümle hangisidir?
option_a: Benedictine abbeys strictly prohibited all forms of vocal praise and musical performance during liturgical ceremonies.
option_b: Sight-reading intricate polyphonic sheet music was a natural instinct possessed by virtually every illiterate peasant.
option_c: The movable type printing press in ancient Athens had already duplicated all known musical scores centuries earlier.
option_d: Medieval cathedral architects preferred electronic amplification systems because stone vaults muffled vocal projection.
option_e: This precarious oral tradition inevitably caused localized melodic distortions, memory lapses, and the permanent loss of ancient compositions.
explanation: Boşluk öncesinde müziğin sadece insan hafızasına ve sözlü aktarıma dayandığı, boşluk sonrasında ise nota çizgisinin (porte) icadıyla bu sorunun çözüldüğü anlatılmaktadır. Boşluğa sözlü aktarımın yarattığı riskleri (unutma, bozulma, eserlerin kaybolması - E seçeneği) anlatan cümle gelmelidir.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) For decades, classical molecular genetics operated under the conviction that an organism's biological traits were dictated exclusively by the immutable nucleotide sequence of its DNA. (II) However, the burgeoning discipline of epigenetics has demonstrated that environmental exposures—such as chronic stress, nutritional deficits, and chemical toxins—can alter gene expression without altering the underlying genetic letters. (III) These molecular modifications occur primarily via chemical mechanisms like DNA methylation and histone acetylation, which effectively silence or activate specific genetic segments. (IV) Evidence increasingly reveals that certain acquired epigenetic marks can even be transmitted across generations, challenging foundational paradigms of biological inheritance. (V) American inventor Thomas Edison secured over one thousand patents during his career, including commercial electric lighting and early phonographs.

Numaralanmış cümlelerden hangisi parçanın anlam akışını bozmaktadır?
option_a: II
option_b: I
option_c: III
option_d: IV
option_e: V
explanation: Paragraf genetik ve epigenetik bilimindeki devrimi, DNA dizilimi değişmeden çevresel faktörlerin gen ifadesini nasıl etkilediğini ve kalıtımı tartışmaktadır. (V) numaralı cümle ise Thomas Edison'un patentlerinden bahsederek metnin konusunu tamamen bozmaktadır.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: The government has announced an ambitious new program to encourage foreign ----- in the country's renewable energy sector.
option_a: punishment
option_b: destruction
option_c: investment
option_d: accident
option_e: symptom
explanation: "Investment" (yatırım) kelimesi bağlama tam uymaktadır. Hükümet ülkenin yenilenebilir enerji sektörüne yabancı yatırımı teşvik etmek için yeni bir program duyurmuştur.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Scientists are trying to ----- whether human activities have accelerated the melting of glaciers in polar regions.
option_a: pretend
option_b: complain
option_c: destroy
option_d: postpone
option_e: determine
explanation: "Determine" (belirlemek, saptamak) fiili araştırmacıların durumun doğruluğunu ortaya koyma çabasına uygundur.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Adequate sleep and a balanced diet are ----- for maintaining both physical health and mental performance during exam periods.
option_a: dangerous
option_b: necessary
option_c: harmful
option_d: jealous
option_e: redundant
explanation: "Necessary" (gerekli, elzem) sıfatı sınav döneminde fiziksel sağlık ve zihinsel performansı korumak için uykunun ve beslenmenin önemini ifade eder.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: The international flight had to be ----- until the following morning because of a severe thunderstorm over the airport.
option_a: taken after
option_b: made out
option_c: brought up
option_d: put off
option_e: broken into
explanation: "Put off" (ertelemek / delay, postpone) fiili fırtına nedeniyle uçuşun ertesi sabaha ertelenmesi bağlamında doğrudur.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: The lack of adequate transportation infrastructure remains a formidable ----- to economic development in landlocked regions.
option_a: component
option_b: remedy
option_c: incentive
option_d: coincidence
option_e: obstacle
explanation: "Obstacle" (engel) kelimesi "formidable obstacle to" (önemli/aşılması güç engel) kalıbıyla ekonomik kalkınmanın önündeki engeli ifade eder.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: The international committee agreed to ----- additional funds to assist regional communities devastated by the recent earthquake.
option_a: dismiss
option_b: distort
option_c: conceal
option_d: alienate
option_e: allocate
explanation: "Allocate" (tahsis etmek, ayırmak / assign, apportion) fiili bütçe ve kaynak dağıtımı bağlamında ÖSYM'nin en sık sorduğu sözcüklerdendir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Recent innovations in genetic medicine have ----- improved the survival rates of patients suffering from rare autoimmune disorders.
option_a: superficially
option_b: scarcely
option_c: reluctantly
option_d: significantly
option_e: arbitrarily
explanation: "Significantly" (önemli ölçüde, kayda değer biçimde) zarfı hayatta kalma oranlarındaki belirgin artışı niteler.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Marine ecologists have warned that unchecked industrial pollution could ----- the collapse of delicate coastal habitats.
option_a: drop in
option_b: take down
option_c: clear out
option_d: bring about
option_e: turn off
explanation: "Bring about" (neden olmak, yol açmak / cause, lead to) ekolojik sistemin çöküşüne yol açılması bağlamında doğrudur.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Owing to the highly ----- nature of emerging tech stocks, even seasoned portfolio managers struggle to forecast price shifts.
option_a: redundant
option_b: persistent
option_c: plausible
option_d: compliant
option_e: volatile
explanation: "Volatile" (oynak, değişken, istikrarsız) finansal piyasalardaki ani dalgalanmaları ve tahmin güçlüğünü niteleyen akademik sıfattır.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Unethical corporate practices and repeated data breaches have severely ----- consumer trust in the multinational tech enterprise.
option_a: undermined
option_b: revitalized
option_c: accommodated
option_d: perpetuated
option_e: underpinned
explanation: "Undermine" (baltalamak, zayıflatmak, sarsmak) kamu veya tüketici güveninin sarsılması bağlamında "undermine trust / confidence" kalıbıyla kullanılır.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Due to rampant deforestation and illegal poaching, the rare mountain gorilla has been pushed to the ----- of extinction.
option_a: expense
option_b: sake
