option_c: spite
option_d: verge
option_e: behalf
explanation: "On / to the verge of extinction" (tükenmenin / yok olmanın eşiğinde) kalıbı türlerin yok olma tehlikesini ifade eden yaygın edat öbeğidir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Rather than tackling the systemic causes of structural unemployment, the proposed legislation merely addresses the dilemma -----.
option_a: inadvertently
option_b: superficially
option_c: mutually
option_d: rigorously
option_e: predominantly
explanation: "Superficially" (yüzeysel olarak) zarfı, köklü ve yapısal çözümler yerine meseleye yüzeysel biçimde yaklaşılmasını ifade eder.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: If you ----- your laboratory assignment before Friday afternoon, the instructor will permit you to attend the weekend field trip.
option_a: had completed
option_b: will complete
option_c: complete
option_d: completed
option_e: were completing
explanation: Type 1 Conditional: "If + Simple Present (complete), will + V1". Şart yan cümleciğinde will/would kullanılmaz.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Marie Curie, ----- conducted pioneering research on radioactivity, became the first person to win Nobel Prizes in two distinct sciences.
option_a: where
option_b: who
option_c: whose
option_d: whom
option_e: which
explanation: Boşluktan sonra gelen "conducted pioneering research on radioactivity" bölümü, Marie Curie adlı kişiyi niteleyen bir sıfat cümleciğidir ve fiilin öznesi eksiktir. Özne konumunda insanı niteleyen ilgi zamiri "who"dur: "Marie Curie, who conducted ...". "Whom" nesne konumunda, "whose" aitlik bildirirken, "which" cansız varlıklar için, "where" yer için kullanılır; bu yüzden diğerleri uymaz.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: All laboratory personnel ----- wear protective safety goggles and gloves when handling hazardous chemicals; it is an obligatory safety rule.
option_a: would
option_b: might
option_c: could
option_d: used to
option_e: must
explanation: Cümle laboratuvar personeli için zorunlu bir güvenlik kuralını anlatıyor ("it is an obligatory safety rule"). Zorunluluk bildiren modal "must"tır: "personnel must wear protective goggles". "Would" ve "could" olasılık veya geçmiş yetenek, "might" zayıf ihtimal, "used to" ise geçmişteki alışkanlık bildirir; hiçbiri zorunluluğu karşılamaz.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ----- she revised the study materials diligently for several weeks, she failed to obtain the score required for the scholarship.
option_a: As long as
option_b: Since
option_c: In order that
option_d: Because
option_e: Although
explanation: Haftalarca özenle çalışmasına karşın burs için gereken puanı alamaması zıtlık ilişkisidir; tam cümle aldığı için "Although" uygundur.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Ever since the ancient Roman aqueduct ----- by archaeologists in the late 1980s, historians ----- the hydraulic engineering of the era.
option_a: unearthed / will investigate
option_b: is unearthed / investigated
option_c: had unearthed / investigate
option_d: has been unearthed / had investigated
option_e: was unearthed / have investigated
explanation: "Ever since + Simple Past (was unearthed), Present Perfect (have investigated)" zaman uyumu kuralıdır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ----- substantial subsidies provided by the state to support organic farming, consumer adoption has remained somewhat sluggish.
option_a: Since
option_b: In spite of
option_c: Because of
option_d: Whereas
option_e: Provided that

option_b: converting concrete buildings into natural stone structures

option_d: generating high-velocity wind currents in urban streets

question_text:

Unlike daylight, which generates considerable thermal energy, bioluminescent light is almost entirely 'cold light,' meaning that very little energy is lost as heat. Deep-sea creatures employ this internal illumination for diverse survival purposes, including attracting mates, luring prey, and startling potential predators with sudden blinding flashes.

One distinctive feature of bioluminescent light mentioned in the passage is that -----.
option_a: it is exclusively utilized by marine plants rather than fauna
option_b: it can only be emitted when organisms are exposed to direct sunlight
option_c: very little energy is wasted as thermal heat during its emission
option_d: it generates tremendous amounts of heat in cold waters
option_e: it causes permanent blindness in every organism that perceives it
explanation: Metinde "very little energy is lost as heat" (neredeyse hiç enerji ısı olarak kaybedilmez / cold light) açıkça belirtilmektedir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
In the perpetual darkness of the deep ocean, more than seventy percent of marine organisms produce their own light through a biochemical reaction known as bioluminescence. Unlike daylight, which generates considerable thermal energy, bioluminescent light is almost entirely 'cold light,' meaning that very little energy is lost as heat. Deep-sea creatures employ this internal illumination for diverse survival purposes, including attracting mates, luring prey, and startling potential predators with sudden blinding flashes.

According to the passage, marine animals do NOT use bioluminescence to -----.
option_a: generate visual signals in deep waters
option_b: scare away potential predators in the dark
option_c: attract prospective reproductive mates
option_d: synthesize essential vitamins from solar radiation
option_e: lure unsuspecting prey toward them
explanation: Metinde eş çekme, av tuzağı ve avcıları korkutma sayılmıştır; güneş radyasyonundan vitamin sentezleme metinde yer almaz.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
During the Middle Ages and the Renaissance, spices such as black pepper, cinnamon, and cloves were far more than culinary flavorings; they represented wealth, social prestige, and religious piety. Because these exotic goods had to be transported across perilous overland caravan routes and navigated through intermediate maritime hubs in the Indian Ocean, their final prices in European markets were extraordinarily inflated. The desire to bypass Venetian and Ottoman monopolies over these lucrative spice routes ultimately served as the primary catalyst for the European Age of Exploration, driving navigators like Vasco da Gama and Christopher Columbus to chart new sea lanes across uncharted oceans.

It can be inferred from the passage that European oceanic expeditions were heavily motivated by -----.
option_a: an urgent necessity to find alternative agricultural staples for famine relief
option_b: financial incentives to circumvent costly commercial intermediaries
option_c: efforts to promote democratic institutions in Far Eastern kingdoms
option_d: an academic desire to document exotic marine wildlife species
option_e: monastic rivalries among competing European religious orders
explanation: Metinde Venedik ve Osmanlı tekellerini ve aracıları devreden çıkarıp ("bypass monopolies") kazançlı baharat yollarına doğrudan ulaşma arzusunun keşifleri tetiklediği ifade edilmektedir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)

According to the passage, the exorbitant prices of spices in Europe were largely due to -----.
option_a: the hazardous and lengthy multi-stage journey required to transport them
option_b: the refusal of Asian merchants to accept European gold currency
option_c: frequent maritime storms that sank almost all merchant ships
option_d: international treaties prohibiting the consumption of black pepper
option_e: the widespread domestic cultivation of spices in northern European estates
explanation: Metinde tehlikeli kervan yolları ve çok aşamalı limanlar üzerinden taşınmaları nedeniyle nihai fiyatların fahiş olduğu açıkça belirtilmiştir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Neuroscientists have long established that chronic sleep deprivation severely impairs neuroplasticity—the brain's capacity to reorganize itself by forming new neural connections throughout life. During deep slow-wave sleep, the glymphatic system becomes active, clearing toxic metabolic waste products, including beta-amyloid proteins, from brain tissue. When individuals are persistently deprived of adequate rest, these metabolic toxins accumulate, impairing the synaptic communication between neurons. Consequently, sleep-deprived individuals exhibit reduced attention spans, compromised emotional regulation, and significant deficits in working memory consolidation.

According to the passage, the glymphatic system is crucial because it -----.
option_a: stimulates rapid muscle growth while lowering internal body temperature
option_b: flushes hazardous metabolic waste products from brain tissue during deep sleep
option_c: prevents the brain from entering restorative slow-wave sleep cycles
option_d: generates adrenaline to keep individuals alert during stressful events
option_e: converts working memory directly into involuntary motor reflexes
explanation: Metinde "clearing toxic metabolic waste products... from brain tissue" (zararlı metabolik atıkları temizler) açıkça ifade edilmektedir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Neuroscientists have long established that chronic sleep deprivation severely impairs neuroplasticity—the brain's capacity to reorganize itself by forming new neural connections throughout life. During deep slow-wave sleep, the glymphatic system becomes active, clearing toxic metabolic waste products, including beta-amyloid proteins, from brain tissue. When individuals are persistently deprived of adequate rest, these metabolic toxins accumulate, impairing the synaptic communication between neurons. Consequently, sleep-deprived individuals exhibit reduced attention spans, compromised emotional regulation, and significant deficits in working memory consolidation.

The primary focus of the passage is to explain -----.
option_a: how nutritional habits and physical fitness dictate the duration of REM cycles
option_b: the historical development of electroencephalography in neuroscience
option_c: how prolonged lack of sleep biologically impairs cognitive and neural functioning
option_d: the evolutionary advantages of nocturnal hunting behaviors in mammals
option_e: why synthetic pharmaceutical sedatives fail to induce natural sleep patterns
explanation: Metnin ana konusu uykusuzluğun beyin plastisitesi ve bilişsel işlevler üzerindeki biyolojik zararlarıdır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The discovery of extremophiles—microorganisms that thrive in environments once deemed completely inhospitable to life—has fundamentally revolutionized our understanding of biological resilience and redefined the boundaries of terrestrial habitability. These resilient microbes flourish in scalding hydrothermal vents under titanic pressures at the ocean floor, within hyper-saline lakes, and deep beneath Antarctic ice sheets where temperatures perpetually linger far below freezing. Their cellular integrity is preserved through specialized enzymes called extremozymes, which retain structural stability under conditions that would irrevocably denature ordinary proteins. The existence of these resilient lifeforms not only provides profound insights into the primordial origins of life on Earth but also significantly bolsters astrobiological hypotheses that microbial life could potentially endure beneath the frozen crusts of icy moons such as Europa and Enceladus.

It is stated in the passage that extremophiles withstand extreme environmental conditions because -----.
option_a: they migrate seasonally to temperate geographical regions
option_b: they consume molten magma to maintain constant metabolic temperatures
option_c: they depend entirely on sunlight penetrating through miles of solid ice
option_d: their cell membranes lack any protein compounds entirely
option_e: their specialized enzymes remain structurally intact where normal proteins would denature
explanation: Metinde "specialized enzymes called extremozymes, which retain structural stability under conditions that would irrevocably denature ordinary proteins" ifadesi tam olarak E seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The discovery of extremophiles—microorganisms that thrive in environments once deemed completely inhospitable to life—has fundamentally revolutionized our understanding of biological resilience and redefined the boundaries of terrestrial habitability. It can be inferred from the passage that extremophiles have energized astrobiological research because they suggest that -----.
option_a: extremophiles can transform volcanic planets into lush agricultural biospheres
option_b: terrestrial bacteria originally colonized Earth aboard icy comets from Europa
option_c: living organisms can only survive on planets with identical atmospheric chemistry to Earth
option_d: intelligent civilizations must have engineered hydrothermal vents on other celestial bodies
option_e: extraterrestrial microbial life could survive in harsh environments previously assumed to be sterile
explanation: Zorlu koşullarda yaşayabilen ekstremofiller, Europa ve Enceladus gibi daha önce steril/cansız sanılan ortamlarda da mikrobiyal yaşamın olabileceği fikrini destekler.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:

These resilient microbes flourish in scalding hydrothermal vents under titanic pressures at the ocean floor, within hyper-saline lakes, and deep beneath Antarctic ice sheets where temperatures perpetually linger far below freezing. The author's tone toward the discoveries concerning extremophiles is best described as -----.
option_a: indifferent and detached
option_b: scornful and suspicious
option_c: alarmist and sorrowful
option_d: appreciative and informative
option_e: dismissive and cynical
explanation: Yazar bilimsel buluşları takdir eden ("revolutionized", "profound insights") ve bilgilendirici bir üsluba (appreciative and informative) sahiptir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The discovery of extremophiles—microorganisms that thrive in environments once deemed completely inhospitable to life—has fundamentally revolutionized our understanding of biological resilience and redefined the boundaries of terrestrial habitability. These resilient microbes flourish in scalding hydrothermal vents under titanic pressures at the ocean floor, within hyper-saline lakes, and deep beneath Antarctic ice sheets where temperatures perpetually linger far below freezing. The existence of these resilient lifeforms not only provides profound insights into the primordial origins of life on Earth but also significantly bolsters astrobiological hypotheses that microbial life could potentially endure beneath the frozen crusts of icy moons such as Europa and Enceladus.

Which of the following would serve as the most appropriate title for the passage?
option_a: The Lethal Impact of Oceanic Pressures on Marine Fauna
option_b: The Inevitable Destruction of Cellular Enzymes in Saline Lakes
option_c: Extremophiles: Redefining the Limits of Life on Earth and Beyond
option_d: Astrobiological Expeditions for Advanced Civilizations in the Galaxy
option_e: Hydrothermal Vents: The Exclusive Cradle of Prehistoric Organisms
explanation: Metin hem dünyadaki yaşamın sınırlarının yeniden tanımlanmasını hem de dünya dışı yaşam olasılıklarını kapsadığından 'Extremophiles: Redefining the Limits of Life on Earth and Beyond' başlığı en uygundur.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Kevin: Have you decided which university you will apply to for your master's degree?
Laura: I'm really torn between Oxford and Edinburgh. Both offer fantastic literature programs.
Kevin: -----
Laura: That's a good point! Living expenses in Edinburgh are much more affordable for students.
option_a: Have you taken into account the difference in the cost of living between the two cities?
option_b: My cousin studied in Oxford twenty years ago and disliked the faculty intensely.
option_c: Both cities are located in warm Mediterranean regions with great beaches.
option_d: I think you should abandon literature and study computer engineering instead.
option_e: You must apply to both institutions without reading any course syllabus.
explanation: Laura'ın "That's a good point! Living expenses in Edinburgh are much more affordable" yanıtı Kevin'ın iki şehir arasındaki yaşam maliyeti farkını sormuş olduğunu gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Doctor: Your blood test results indicate that your cholesterol levels have risen slightly.
Patient: That is concerning. What can I do to bring them back down without taking prescription drugs?
Doctor: -----
Patient: That sounds manageable. I can definitely walk forty minutes every morning and cut down on processed snacks.
option_a: You should consume more fried fast food and sugary desserts each day.
option_b: We must schedule an urgent open-heart surgical operation for tomorrow morning.
option_c: Adopting a balanced Mediterranean diet and engaging in daily cardiovascular exercise would be the best start.
option_d: Cholesterol tests are completely fraudulent, so you can safely disregard the results.
option_e: There is nothing you can do, so you should abandon physical exercise altogether.
explanation: Hastanın "Her sabah 40 dakika yürüyebilirim ve abur cuburu kesebilirim" demesi doktorun Akdeniz diyeti ve kardiyo egzersizi önerdiğini gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Emma: I can never concentrate on my reading assignments when I study in my bedroom.
David: Why don't you try studying at the central public library downtown?
Emma: -----
David: Exactly! It's quiet, well-lit, and everyone around you is studying, which keeps you motivated.
option_a: The central library was closed down permanently five years ago.
option_b: I prefer noisy coffee shops where loud music plays continuously.
option_c: The books at that library are far too outdated for academic research.
option_d: Do you think the environment there would really make a noticeable difference?
option_e: My bedroom is the quietest venue in the entire neighborhood.
explanation: David'ın "Exactly! It's quiet, well-lit, and keeps you motivated" cevabı Emma'nın ortamın fark yaratıp yaratmayacağını sorduğunu gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Mark: Our team finished the software presentation, but I'm worried we won't have enough time to rehearse before the client meeting.
Sophia: -----
Mark: That's a huge relief! Having two extra days will definitely allow us to refine our delivery.
option_a: We must delete the presentation slides and rewrite the entire code from scratch.
option_b: Good news then; the client just emailed asking to reschedule the presentation for Thursday.
option_c: We have already practiced six times today, so further rehearsals are unnecessary.
option_d: I think we should terminate our business contract with the client immediately.
option_e: The client insisted that we present the project within the next ten minutes.
explanation: Mark'ın "İki ekstra güne sahip olmak prova yapmamızı sağlayacak" rahatlaması, Sophia'nın müşterinin toplantıyı perşembeye ertelediğini bildirdiğini gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Professor Harris: I noticed that your research term paper contains no citations from academic journals published in the last five years.
Student: I relied predominantly on classical textbooks because my research focuses on the historical origins of thermodynamics.
Professor Harris: -----
Student: I see your point now. I will review recent literature to demonstrate how modern physicists re-evaluate those foundational theories.
option_a: Even when analyzing foundational concepts, engaging with contemporary scholarship demonstrates that your analysis is current.
option_b: You will have to fail the semester because of this minor citation omission.
option_c: You should discard the historical background entirely and write exclusively about quantum computers.
option_d: Textbooks written in the nineteenth century are far superior to modern research papers.
option_e: Peer-reviewed scientific journals are irrelevant for physics undergraduates anyway.
explanation: Öğrencinin modern fizikçilerin teorileri nasıl yeniden değerlendirdiğini literatürden tarayacağını söylemesi profesörün güncel akademik çalışmaları dahil etmeyi vurguladığını gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Liam: Did you read the article about how artificial intelligence models are assisting radiologists in detecting lung abnormalities?
Clara: Yes, some diagnostic algorithms can identify microscopic nodules faster than experienced specialists.
Liam: That sounds impressive, but doesn't relying on automated tools introduce a severe risk of misdiagnosis in atypical cases?
Clara: -----
option_a: The article was pure science fiction and had no basis in clinical medicine.
option_b: Radiologists are forbidden from looking at scans once an AI software is activated.
option_c: That's why medical experts treat AI as an assistive second opinion rather than an autonomous substitute for doctors.
option_d: Diagnostic errors only happen when patients refuse their prescribed medication.
option_e: Machines never commit errors, so human radiologists should be replaced immediately.
explanation: Liam'ın atipik vakalardaki yanlış teşhis riskine karşılık Clara yapay zekânın ikame değil yardımcı ikinci görüş olarak konumlandırıldığını açıklar.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Architect A: The client insists on installing expansive floor-to-ceiling glass panels along the entire southern facade of the office complex.
Architect B: While that will flood the interior with natural daylight, it will drastically increase cooling loads during hot summer months.
Architect A: -----
Architect B: That's a brilliant compromise! High-performance solar-control glass will minimize heat gain without compromising daylighting.
option_a: Cooling costs are trivial, so the client won't mind outrageous utility bills.
option_b: We ought to advise the client to cancel the construction project permanently.
option_c: What if we utilize electrochromic smart glazing that dynamically tints in response to solar radiation?
option_d: Then let's convince the client to build the entire tower without a single window.
option_e: The southern facade never gets any sun anyway, so overheating is an illusion.
explanation: Mimar B'nin "Harika bir orta yol!" demesi, Mimar A'nın dinamik kararan akıllı cam önerisiyle doğrudan uyumludur.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Journalist: Your latest documentary highlights the decline of traditional carpet weaving in rural mountain villages.
Filmmaker: Yes, younger generations are migrating to metropolises, leaving very few apprentices to preserve centuries of artisanal knowledge.
Journalist: -----
Filmmaker: Surprisingly, yes. Several youth cooperatives are now leveraging online platforms to sell authentic rugs internationally, sparking renewed interest.
option_a: Are you planning to relocate to a remote village to take up wool weaving yourself?
option_b: Are you observing any promising grassroots initiatives that might slow down or reverse this loss?
option_c: Do you believe traditional weaving should be banned by modern economic planners?
option_d: How much financial funding did you receive from international cinema festivals?
option_e: Why did you choose rural Anatolia instead of documenting industrial factories in Europe?
explanation: Yönetmenin "Şaşırtıcı şekilde evet. Bazı kooperatifler internet üzerinden satış yaparak ilgiyi canlandırıyor" yanıtı gazetecinin gerilemeyi durduracak girişimler olup olmadığı sorusuna cevaptır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Dr. Vance: The latest clinical trials for the candidate neurological drug demonstrated high efficacy, but participant dropout reached nearly thirty percent.
Dr. Sterling: That is exceptionally high. Did the trial logs indicate what caused so many participants to abandon the trial prematurely?
Dr. Vance: -----
Dr. Sterling: In that case, reformulating the chemical delivery vehicle to alleviate those adverse gastrointestinal symptoms must be our immediate priority.
option_a: The placebo cohort reported zero complications, proving that neurological disorders are purely psychological.
option_b: The drug was so miraculous that patients felt completely healed within two days and departed.
option_c: Regulatory officials ordered the trial halted due to trademark disputes over the compound's name.
option_d: A large portion of patients experienced severe nausea and persistent dizziness during the titration phase.
option_e: Participants simply grew bored because the clinic was situated outside the metropolitan center.
explanation: Dr. Sterling'in mide-bağırsak yan etkilerini hafifletmeye odaklanılması gerektiğini söylemesi, Dr. Vance'in bulantı ve baş dönmesini belirttiğini gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Historian A: The traditional consensus argues that the sudden collapse of late Bronze Age civilizations was caused exclusively by the devastating raids of the Sea Peoples.
Historian B: -----
Historian A: Exactly. A prolonged multi-century megadrought likely undermined agricultural yields, generating systemic famine that left urban centers defenseless against external raids.
option_a: Archaeological surveys in the Mediterranean basin have ceased entirely for forty years.
option_b: That monocausal perspective ignores robust paleoclimatic evidence showing severe environmental stress across the region.
option_c: I believe the Sea Peoples never existed and were merely fictional allegories created by scribes.
option_d: Military invasions are the single reason any ancient kingdom ever disintegrated in history.
option_e: Bronze Age economies were so industrialized that climate variations had zero impact on them.
explanation: Tarihçi A'nın "Aynen öyle. Kuraklık tarımı vurdu ve kırılganlık yarattı" demesi, Tarihçi B'nin iklimsel kanıtları göz ardı eden tek nedenli yaklaşıma dikkat çektiğini gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Economist: Imposing carbon border tariffs will incentivize foreign exporters to adopt decarbonized production methods if they wish to access our single market.
Trade Analyst: Theoretically, yes. However, developing nations might view these border levies as disguised protectionism designed to shelter domestic manufacturers.
Economist: -----
Trade Analyst: Fair enough. Directing all tariff revenues into green technology transfer funds for those exporting states would certainly alleviate allegations of economic hypocrisy.
option_a: Trade protectionism always enhances global cooperation and should be practiced without shame.
option_b: We should disregard foreign protests and enact prohibitive trade embargoes on all manufactured imports.
option_c: No jurisdiction has ever successfully implemented any environmental levy on cross-border commodities.
option_d: Developing states are indifferent to export earnings, so tariff adjustments will produce no behavioral shift.
option_e: To dispel that perception, we could earmark all tariff proceeds to co-finance clean energy infrastructure in those developing nations.
explanation: Analistin "Gelirleri yeşil teknoloji transferine aktarmak suçlamaları azaltacaktır" onayı Ekonomistin toplanan parayı o ülkelerin temiz enerjisine harcama önerisine tam uyar.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Museum Curator: We are debating whether our institution should repatriate contested colonial artifacts to their country of origin or keep them in our encyclopedic galleries.
Director: It is an ethical quandary. Retaining them allows millions of global visitors to view disparate cultures in comparative dialogue.
Museum Curator: True, but archival provenance confirms that many of these cultural treasures were seized under military coercion during colonial conquests.
Director: -----
option_a: Restitution has never once been debated in the history of international museology.
option_b: Therefore, we ought to hide the artifacts in subterranean storage vaults and deny having them.
option_c: Colonial-era treaties remain legally binding in perpetuity, so moral concerns have zero relevance.
option_d: Then establishing shared stewardship treaties and reciprocal loan programs could reconcile historical restitution with universal educational access.
option_e: The source nations lack any cultural facilities, so the artifacts would disintegrate overnight.
explanation: Müze müdürünün hem tarihi iadeyi hem de kamusal erişimi uzlaştıracak ortak mülkiyet ve karşılıklı ödünç programları önermesi bağlama tam uyar.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Given Sentence: You cannot expect to master a musical instrument without practicing on a daily basis.

Which of the following sentences is closest in meaning to the given sentence?
option_a: Consistent daily practice is indispensable if one wishes to achieve proficiency in playing a musical instrument.
option_b: Musical instruments are so intricate that no person can ever truly attain mastery.
option_c: Practicing an instrument daily prevents students from focusing on other academic disciplines.
option_d: Practicing occasionally is more than enough to become an accomplished musician.
option_e: Anyone who practices an instrument every day is guaranteed to achieve celebrity status.
explanation: "Günlük pratik yapmadan bir müzik aletinde ustalaşamazsınız" = "Yetkinlik kazanmak için günlük pratik vazgeçilmezdir" (indispensable).

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: A close friend invites you to go to the cinema tonight. However, you have a crucial university midterm exam early tomorrow morning that you need to study for. You want to decline the invitation politely without hurting your friend's feelings. What do you say?
option_a: I will never speak to you again if you keep trying to distract me from my studies!
option_b: Sure, let's watch two movies back-to-back; failing an exam doesn't matter anyway.
option_c: I'd really love to join you, but I have a major exam early tomorrow and must revise tonight. Could we reschedule for the weekend?
option_d: You should cancel your plans and come over to clean my study desk instead.
option_e: Why on earth would you ask me to go out when you know I despise going to cinemas?
explanation: Durum, arkadaşın davetini incitmeden reddetmeyi gerektiriyor. Doğru ifade önce davete teşekkür eden ve isteğini belirten ("I'd really love to join you"), sonra gerekçeyi açıklayan ("I have a major exam early tomorrow") ve alternatif sunan ("Could we reschedule for the weekend?") cümledir. Diğerleri ya tehdit, ya sorumsuz davranış, ya da kırıcı bir üslup içerir; kibarlık ve çözüm önerisi bulunmaz.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Given Sentence: Only when the torrential rain ceased were the emergency rescue teams able to reach the isolated mountain community.

Which of the following sentences is closest in meaning to the given sentence?
option_a: Had the rain stopped earlier, the rescue teams would not have bothered to visit the village.
option_b: Despite the persistent rainfall, the rescuers easily reached the mountain hamlet without delay.
option_c: The rescue teams arrived at the village while the torrential rain was at its peak intensity.
option_d: The emergency rescue teams could access the isolated mountain village exclusively after the heavy rain had stopped.
option_e: The mountain village refused to receive any assistance after the storm passed.
explanation: "Only when ... ceased were ... able to reach" = "could access ... exclusively after ... had stopped".

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Given Sentence: Although genetic inheritance plays a notable role in cardiovascular health, lifestyle habits such as nutrition and exercise are equally consequential.

Which of the following sentences is closest in meaning to the given sentence?
option_a: Adopting a healthy lifestyle is completely futile if one has a familial history of cardiac conditions.
option_b: Cardiovascular disorders are caused exclusively by hereditary traits regardless of personal dietary choices.
option_c: Neither genetic heritage nor daily lifestyle habits have any measurable influence on cardiac longevity.
option_d: Genetics undoubtedly influences cardiovascular well-being, but lifestyle factors like diet and physical activity are just as significant.
option_e: Physical exercise is infinitely more crucial for heart health than any genetic factor ever discovered.
explanation: Genetik rolü kabul edip yaşam tarzının da en az onun kadar önemli olduğunu belirten denklik D seçeneğinde eksiksiz karşılanmıştır.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: You are staying at a luxury hotel, but when you return to your room late in the evening, you discover that the air conditioner is broken and making a deafening rattling noise. You call the front desk to register your dissatisfaction firmly yet politely and request a swift resolution. What do you say?
option_a: Don't worry about the noise; I actually find mechanical grinding sounds very calming while sleeping.
option_b: How dare you assign me this room? Every employee in this building should be dismissed on the spot!
option_c: The air conditioning unit in my room is malfunctioning and producing a loud noise. Could you please send a maintenance technician right away, or arrange a room change?
option_d: I am planning to file a formal lawsuit against your hotel brand in municipal court tomorrow morning!
option_e: Could you please lower the volume of the radio playing in the reception area?
explanation: Kibar ama kararlı bir şekilde sorunu bildirip derhal teknisyen veya oda değişimi talep eden ifade B'dir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Given Sentence: Had the municipal authorities acted upon the engineers' warnings regarding the aging viaduct, the disastrous collapse could have been averted.

Which of the following sentences is closest in meaning to the given sentence?
option_a: The municipal council took immediate preventative steps the moment engineers inspected the viaduct.
option_b: Even if the city council had intervened promptly, the viaduct would inevitably have collapsed under traffic.
option_c: The viaduct's tragic failure might have been prevented if local authorities had heeded the engineers' cautionary advice.
option_d: The structural engineers neglected to alert the city council about fractures in the viaduct prior to its failure.
option_e: Nobody could have foreseen the collapse because the viaduct had been comprehensively reinforced the year before.
explanation: Type 3 if/had inversion yapısının (uyarılar dikkate alınsaydı çöküş engellenebilirdi) birebir karşılığı C seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Given Sentence: Few technological breakthroughs have disrupted contemporary global commerce as profoundly as the emergence of decentralized digital payment systems.

Which of the following sentences is closest in meaning to the given sentence?
option_a: Almost every single technology in modern history has reshaped commerce more dramatically than digital payments.
option_b: The rise of decentralized digital payment systems has transformed modern international commerce more radically than nearly any other technological breakthrough.
option_c: Digital payment mechanisms were introduced exclusively to eradicate traditional cash-based small retailers.
option_d: Contemporary commerce has remained virtually untouched by the advent of decentralized digital payment systems.
option_e: Decentralized payment systems are among the least influential financial tools invented in recent decades.
explanation: "Few ... have disrupted ... as profoundly as ..." karşılaştırmasının karşılığı "has transformed ... more radically than nearly any other ..." ifadesidir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: You are directing an academic research laboratory. A promising graduate researcher consistently generates brilliant conceptual hypotheses, yet their empirical data analysis contains careless mathematical errors. During a performance review, you want to offer constructive encouragement while underscoring that rigorous data precision is non-negotiable in scientific publication. What do you say?
option_a: You don't need to double-check calculations; in theoretical physics, having imaginative hypotheses is all that counts.
option_b: Your mathematical aptitude is abysmal, and you ought to withdraw from the scientific doctorate program immediately.
option_c: You are barred from publishing any research until you master elementary high-school arithmetic.
option_d: I have already re-done your entire statistical analysis myself because your draft was completely unreadable.
option_e: Your theoretical ideas are genuinely exceptional; however, uncompromised precision in data analysis is vital for scientific integrity, so please thoroughly verify your calculations.
explanation: Hem araştırmacının parlak fikirlerini takdir eden hem de veri doğruluğunun bilimsel dürüstlük için vazgeçilmezliğini vurgulayan yapıcı ifade E'dir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Given Sentence: It is only by acknowledging historical injustices that a divided society can lay the foundations for genuine reconciliation and enduring peace.

Which of the following sentences is closest in meaning to the given sentence?
option_a: Acknowledging past atrocities guarantees that all societal grievances will be eliminated without effort.
option_b: Societies divided by ethnic strife should disregard past grievances if they wish to achieve immediate economic growth.
option_c: Even when communities acknowledge past wrongdoings, genuine peace remains an unattainable fantasy.
option_d: Enduring reconciliation occurs spontaneously over generations without requiring any historical soul-searching.
option_e: True reconciliation and lasting peace within a fractured society cannot be established unless historical injustices are openly recognized.
explanation: "It is only by acknowledging ... that ... can lay ..." = "cannot be established unless historical injustices are openly recognized" denkliği A'da kurulmuştur.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text: Honeybees are essential pollinators responsible for fertilizing approximately one-third of the crops we consume. In recent decades, however, managed and wild bee colonies worldwide have suffered alarming population collapses. -----. Without these vital insect pollinators, agricultural yields would plummet precipitously, threatening global food security.
option_a: Factors including pesticide exposure, habitat destruction, and climate volatility are identified as the primary drivers of this crisis.
option_b: Honey has been celebrated since antiquity for its natural antimicrobial qualities.
option_c: Unlike social bees, solitary wasps rarely manufacture complex wax comb structures.
option_d: Ancient Egyptian beekeepers transported their clay hives along the Nile on barges.
option_e: Most consumers prefer strawberry preserves over raw honey at breakfast.
explanation: Boşluğun öncesinde arı kolonilerinin çöküşü, sonrasında ise tozlaştırıcılar olmadan tarımın çökeceği belirtilmiştir; krizin nedenlerini sıralayan A seçeneği mantıksal köprüdür.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Regular brisk walking is one of the most accessible and effective forms of aerobic exercise for people of all age groups. (II) It strengthens cardiovascular endurance, boosts mood by releasing endorphins, and assists in regulating blood glucose levels. (III) Many sprawling metropolitan centers suffer from a noticeable deficit of public parks and pedestrian avenues. (IV) Furthermore, engaging in brisk walking for just thirty minutes daily can substantially decrease the risk of chronic cardiovascular ailments. (V) Because it requires no specialized athletic equipment, it can seamlessly be integrated into anyone's daily routine.

Which of the sentences in the passage disrupts the flow of thought?
option_a: II
option_b: IV
option_c: III
option_d: V
option_e: I
explanation: Paragrafın tamamı düzenli tempolu yürüyüşün bireysel sağlık faydalarını anlatırken, III. cümle metropollerdeki park ve kaldırım yetersizliğinden bahsederek konunun odağını bozar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text: The invention of the movable-type printing press by Johannes Gutenberg in mid-15th century Germany fundamentally transformed human civilization. Prior to this breakthrough, manuscripts were painstakingly transcribed by hand by scribes, rendering books scarce and exorbitantly expensive luxuries. -----. As public literacy broadened, the rapid circulation of scientific and philosophical treatises catalyzed the Renaissance and the Scientific Revolution.
option_a: Most aristocratic patrons preferred private libraries adorned with hand-painted heraldic bindings.
option_b: Medieval monks utilized goose quills and soot-based inks to produce illuminated manuscripts.
option_c: Paper production technology was originally formulated in ancient China during the Han dynasty.
option_d: Gutenberg's mechanized process allowed literary works to be mass-produced swiftly and affordably for the wider populace.
option_e: Gutenberg struggled with mounting commercial debts for much of his later life.
explanation: Kitapların elle kopyalanmasının yarattığı kıtlıktan sonra, matbaanın kitapların kitlesel ve ucuz üretilmesini sağlaması ve peşinden gelen okuryazarlık patlaması D seçeneğiyle bağlanır.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Bioluminescence is the biochemical production and emission of light by living organisms. (II) This biological phenomenon occurs predominantly among marine vertebrates and invertebrates dwelling in the abyss of the ocean. (III) In these sunless oceanic depths, bioluminescent creatures utilize light flashes for intraspecies communication, counterillumination camouflage, and luring prey. (IV) Certain terrestrial organisms, including fireflies and select fungal species, also display this fascinating enzymatic glow. (V) Commercial deep-sea trawlers routinely utilize multi-beam sonar arrays to map ocean floor topography.

Which of the sentences in the passage disrupts the flow of thought?
option_a: II
option_b: IV
option_c: V
option_d: I
option_e: III
explanation: Bütün cümleler biyolüminesansın işlevini ve görüldüğü canlı türlerini açıklarken, V. cümle ticari balıkçı gemilerinin sonar cihazlarından bahsederek akışı bozar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text: Urban development has severely fragmented natural ecosystems, isolating wildlife populations within shrinking island-like habitats. To counteract this ecological divide, landscape conservationists are designing wildlife corridors—continuous strips of protected vegetation connecting isolated reserves. -----. By facilitating these safe seasonal crossings, corridors prevent genetic inbreeding and help sustain resilient animal populations across developed landscapes.
option_a: Asphalt production for intercity superhighways generates significant revenue for regional civil engineering firms.
option_b: Domestic felines should be kept indoors at all times to curb the predatory decimation of native songbirds.
option_c: Large apex predators usually steer clear of residential neighborhoods due to vehicle noise and artificial illumination.
option_d: These vegetated overpasses and subterranean underpasses allow animals to cross busy highways safely and access expanded feeding ranges.
option_e: Metropolitan zoological gardens offer educational workshops for primary school pupils studying biodiversity.
explanation: Yaban hayatı koridorlarının işlevini (yeşil üst geçitler ve alt geçitler sayesinde otoyolları güvenle geçebilmeleri) açıklayan D seçeneği, sonraki cümleye zemin hazırlar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) The Great Library of Alexandria stood as the premier intellectual repository and scholarly research center of the Hellenistic world. (II) Alexandria was established by the Macedonian general Alexander the Great in 331 BC following his conquest of the Persian satrapy of Egypt. (III) Renowned scholars from across the Mediterranean gathered at the library to advance mathematics, astronomy, grammar, and medicine. (IV) The institution gathered an estimated half-million papyrus scrolls representing the accumulated literary and scientific heritage of antiquity. (V) Its tragic decline over several centuries remains an enduring symbol of the catastrophic vulnerability of recorded human knowledge.

Which of the sentences in the passage disrupts the flow of thought?
option_a: I
option_b: IV
option_c: II
option_d: V
option_e: III
explanation: I, III, IV ve V. cümleler doğrudan İskenderiye Kütüphanesi'nin entelektüel rolünü, koleksiyonunu ve kaybını anlatırken, II. cümle şehrin kuruluşu hakkında tarihsel bir detay vererek odağı bozar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text: In the philosophy of mind, the 'hard problem of consciousness' designates the challenge of explaining how and why physical neural processes give rise to subjective qualia. While cognitive neuroscientists can accurately map neural correlates—identifying which brain sectors activate during sensory perception—this empirical data fails to solve the central mystery. -----. Why shouldn't complex information processing occur entirely 'in the dark,' without any qualitative inner experience accompanying it?
option_a: Deep learning algorithms can recognize handwritten digits with higher accuracy than human eyes.
option_b: Specifically, it does not explain why electro-chemical signaling across synapses should feel like anything at all from a first-person perspective.
option_c: Advanced functional magnetic resonance imaging scanners have become standard equipment in major neurological clinics.
option_d: Substance dualists maintain that the soul operates completely independently of physical biochemistry.
option_e: Phineas Gage's historical frontal lobe trauma provided foundational insights into personality localization.
explanation: "Specifically, it does not explain why electro-chemical signaling... should feel like anything at all..." ifadesi, ardından gelen "Why shouldn't complex information processing occur entirely in the dark..." sorusuyla kusursuz bir felsefi ve mantıksal köprü kurar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Circadian rhythms are endogenous, approximately 24-hour physiological oscillations synchronized primarily by ambient photic cues. (II) Light exposure stimulates specialized intrinsically photosensitive retinal ganglion cells that transmit neural inputs directly to the suprachiasmatic nucleus. (III) Evening exposure to short-wavelength blue light from digital displays suppresses nocturnal melatonin secretion, impairing sleep architecture. (IV) Synthetic melatonin capsules are readily available over the counter in pharmacies and supermarket chains across North America. (V) Chronic disruption of these circadian cycles is clinically associated with metabolic syndrome, cardiovascular disease, and immunological impairment.

Which of the sentences in the passage disrupts the flow of thought?
option_a: III
option_b: V
option_c: IV
option_d: I
option_e: II
explanation: I, II, III ve V cümleleri sirkadiyen ritmin biyolojik mekanizması, ışık duyarlılığı ve bozulmasının klinik sonuçlarını anlatırken, IV. cümle melatonin haplarının ticari satışından bahsederek bilimsel akışı bozar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text: Paleoclimatologists reconstruct prehistoric planetary climates by investigating geochemical proxies preserved within polar ice sheets, deep marine sediment cores, and ancient speleothems. In polar ice caps, tiny atmospheric air bubbles trapped during snowfall millennia ago preserve pristine samples of ancient air. -----. By correlating these greenhouse gas measurements with isotopic temperature records, researchers can reconstruct global climate fluctuations spanning hundreds of thousands of years.
option_a: Antarctic scientific stations require specialized geothermal generators to sustain researchers during winter blizzards.
option_b: Modern meteorological satellite networks calculate sea surface temperatures with millimeter-grade infrared accuracy.
option_c: Dendrochronology studies reveal that annual tree rings expand noticeably during prolonged drought conditions.
option_d: By extracting and analyzing these trapped gaseous inclusions, scientists can directly quantify prehistoric concentrations of carbon dioxide and methane.
option_e: Fossilized dinosaur footprints offer valuable insights into the migratory speeds of Cretaceous herbivores.
explanation: Önceki cümledeki "tiny atmospheric air bubbles trapped during snowfall... preserve pristine samples of ancient air" ifadesine doğrudan "By extracting and analyzing these trapped gaseous inclusions..." ile bağlanan D seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Due to the heavy storm, the school administration decided to ----- the football tournament until next weekend.
option_a: make up for
option_b: carry out
option_c: put off
option_d: turn down
option_e: bring about
explanation: "Put off" ertelemek (postpone/delay) anlamına gelir. Cümlede fırtına nedeniyle futbol turnuvasının gelecek haftaya ertelendiği ifade edilmektedir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Drinking enough water every day is ----- for maintaining healthy kidney function and high energy levels.
option_a: reluctant
option_b: ambiguous
option_c: essential
option_d: vulnerable
option_e: scarce
explanation: "Essential" hayati, son derece gerekli, vazgeçilmez (vital/crucial) anlamına gelir. Su içmenin böbrek fonksiyonları için gerekliliği anlatılmaktadır.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Many endangered species are currently ----- risk of extinction due to rapid habitat destruction.
option_a: by
option_b: in
option_c: on
option_d: under
option_e: at
explanation: İngilizcede "tehlike altında / risk altında" ifadesi kalıplaşmış olarak "at risk of" şeklinde kullanılır.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: The international team of astrophysicists will ----- an extensive survey to observe recently discovered exoplanets.
option_a: wipe out
option_b: carry out
option_c: call off
option_d: look down on
option_e: fall behind
explanation: "Carry out", bir araştırma, anket veya deneyi yürütmek, uygulamak (conduct/execute) anlamına gelir ("carry out a survey").

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Prolonged periods of severe drought have ----- the region's underground water reserves, making agricultural irrigation almost impossible.
option_a: enhanced
option_b: flourished
option_c: depleted
option_d: facilitated
option_e: allocated
explanation: "Deplete", tüketmek, suyunu çekmek, miktarını tüketip bitirmek (exhaust/consume) anlamına gelir. Kuraklığın yer altı su kaynaklarını tüketmesi anlatılmaktadır.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Renewable energy sources currently account ----- approximately twenty percent of the nation's total electricity consumption.
option_a: about
option_b: for
option_c: to
option_d: with
option_e: from
explanation: "Account for", bir oranın veya miktarın payını oluşturmak (comprise/make up) anlamına gelir ve daima "for" edatıyla kullanılır.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Constant political turmoil and corruption severely ----- the country's economic development, deterring potential foreign investors.
option_a: exceeded
option_b: impeded
option_c: perceived
option_d: fostered
option_e: restored
explanation: "Impede" engellemek, köstek olmak, güçleştirmek (hinder/hamper/obstruct) anlamına gelir. Siyasi çalkantıların ekonomik gelişmeyi engellediği belirtilmiştir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Children living in underprivileged neighborhoods are particularly ----- to nutritional deficiencies due to inadequate access to fresh produce.
option_a: imperative
option_b: compatible
option_c: redundant
option_d: reluctant
option_e: susceptible
explanation: "Susceptible to", bir hastalığa veya olumsuzluğa karşı savunmasız, açık, duyarlı (vulnerable to / prone to) anlamına gelir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Governments must take prompt actions to protect coastal cities, which are now ----- the verge of catastrophic flooding as sea levels rise.
option_a: by
option_b: under
option_c: with
option_d: on
option_e: in
explanation: "On the verge of" (veya "on the brink of"), bir şeyin eşiğinde olmak anlamına gelen kalıplaşmış bir edat öbeğidir.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Ever since the discovery of penicillin in 1928, antibiotics ----- millions of lives across the globe.
option_a: were saving
option_b: have saved
option_c: saved
option_d: had saved
option_e: will save
explanation: "Ever since + past event" yapısı geçmişten günümüze süregelen etkiyi anlattığı için ana cümlede Present Perfect Tense ("have saved") kullanılmalıdır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ----- the weather was extremely freezing, the mountaineers decided to continue their ascent towards the summit.
option_a: Since
option_b: Despite
option_c: Therefore
option_d: Because
option_e: Although
explanation: Havanın dondurucu olmasına rağmen tırmanışa devam ettiklerini belirten zıtlık anlamı vardır. Boşluktan sonra tam cümle (S+V) geldiği için "Although" doğru yanıttır ("Despite" isim alır).

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: The ancient temple ----- by archaeologists during an excavation last summer.
option_a: discovered
option_b: is discovered
option_c: has discovered
option_d: was discovered
option_e: will be discovered
explanation: "Last summer" geçmiş zaman zarfıdır ve tapınak arkeologlar tarafından keşfedildiği için Simple Past Passive ("was discovered") gereklidir.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: By the time the rescue team reached the remote valley, the stranded hikers ----- all of their emergency supplies.
option_a: had exhausted
option_b: have exhausted
option_c: will exhaust
option_d: were exhausting
option_e: exhausted
explanation: "By the time + Simple Past (reached)" kalıbı, o andan daha önce tamamlanmış bir eylemi anlattığı için temel cümlede Past Perfect Tense ("had exhausted") gerektirir.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: He arrived at the interview soaking wet; he ----- his umbrella at home on such a rainy morning.
option_a: needn't have forgotten
option_b: might forget
option_c: must have forgotten
option_d: can't have forgotten
option_e: should have forgotten
explanation: Geçmişe yönelik güçlü bir çıkarım (kesin öyle olmuş olmalı) yapılmaktadır. "Must have V3" (must have forgotten) doğru çıkarımdır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ----- the economic recession that hit the region, the company managed to expand its export volume.
option_a: Unless
option_b: Even though
option_c: Because of
option_d: In order that
option_e: In spite of
explanation: Boşluktan sonra tam bir cümle değil, bir isim öbeği ("the economic recession that hit the region") gelmektedir ve zıtlık anlamı vardır. Dolayısıyla isim alan "In spite of" doğru cevaptır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Dinosaurs are believed ----- extinct approximately 66 million years ago following the impact of a massive asteroid.
option_a: going
option_b: to go
option_c: to have gone
option_d: having gone
option_e: to be going
explanation: Passive raporlama kalıbında ("are believed"), bahsedilen olay ana fiilden daha önce (geçmişte) gerçekleştiği için Perfect Infinitive ("to have gone") kullanılır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ----- all the experimental trials with remarkable precision, the research team submitted their breakthrough findings to the journal.
option_a: Completed
option_b: Having completed
option_c: Being completed
option_d: To have completed
option_e: To complete
explanation: Ana eylemden (submitted) daha önce tamamlanmış etken bir eylemi kısaltırken Participle Clauses kuralına göre "Having V3" ("Having completed") kullanılır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: You ----- the entire report last night because the meeting was cancelled early this morning.
option_a: couldn't write
option_b: might have written
option_c: should have written
option_d: needn't have written
option_e: must have written
explanation: "Needn't have V3", geçmişte yapılmış olan bir eylemin aslında yapılmasına gerek olmadığını (boşuna zahmet edildiğini) anlatır.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Although electric vehicles produce zero tailpipe emissions, -----.
option_a: most governments offer substantial tax reductions for them
option_b: they can travel long distances on a single charge
option_c: their battery production process still involves considerable environmental impacts
option_d: they are increasingly preferred by environmentalists
option_e: they significantly reduce urban air pollution
explanation: "Although" zıtlık bağlacıdır. Ana cümlede sıfır egzoz emisyonu gibi olumlu bir durum verildiğinden, tamamlayan kısımda batarya üretiminin çevresel zararları gibi olumsuz bir unsur yer almalıdır.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Since regular physical exercise strengthens the cardiovascular system, -----.
option_a: it was first discovered in ancient Greece
option_b: unhealthy eating habits are becoming more prevalent
option_c: many people neglect drinking enough water
option_d: doctors warn against spending too much time outdoors
option_e: it notably lowers the risk of developing heart diseases
explanation: "Since" (çünkü/-dığı için) sebep bildirir. Egzersizin kalbi güçlendirmesinin mantıksal neticesi kalp hastalığı riskini azaltmasıdır.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Unless strict conservation laws are enacted immediately, -----.
option_a: the oceans would have been completely cleaned
option_b: marine biodiversity will continue to thrive undisturbed
option_c: ecologists were very optimistic about the future
option_d: the rare coral reefs will face irreversible degradation
option_e: fishermen have caught more fish than last year
explanation: "Unless" (eğer olmazsa/madıkça) Type 1 koşul cümlesidir. Sıkı yasalar çıkarılmazsa mercan resiflerinin geri dönülmez yıkımla karşılaşacağı mantıklı sonuçtur.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: While traditional farming methods depend heavily on unpredictable seasonal rainfall, -----.
option_a: excessive rainfall always damages wheat fields in early spring
option_b: drip irrigation systems provide crops with consistent moisture regardless of climate
option_c: organic food prices have decreased dramatically
option_d: farmers are reluctant to abandon ancient cultural rituals
option_e: most agricultural fertilizers are chemical-based
explanation: "While" burada zıtlık bildirmektedir. Geleneksel tarımın öngörülemeyen yağışa bağımlı olmasına karşılık damla sulama sistemlerinin iklimden bağımsız su sağlaması mükemmel bir tezat oluşturur.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: -----, psychologists advise students to take regular short breaks during study sessions.
option_a: Even if exams do not cause any significant stress
option_b: In order to prevent mental fatigue and enhance information retention
option_c: Since students never feel tired when listening to music
option_d: Unless they want to complete their assignments on time
option_e: Although cramming the night before an exam is proven to be successful
explanation: Tavsiyenin amacı ("In order to prevent mental fatigue and enhance information retention" - zihinsel yorgunluğu önlemek ve bilgiyi akılda tutmayı artırmak için) ana cümleyle tam bir amaç-eylem uyumu sergiler.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Despite initial scepticism from leading economists regarding its long-term feasibility, -----.
option_a: unemployment remained a persistent challenge for the government
option_b: the economic growth rate slowed down significantly that year
option_c: many small businesses went bankrupt shortly afterwards
option_d: no commercial bank agreed to fund the proposed infrastructure
option_e: the microfinance initiative lifted thousands of rural families out of poverty
explanation: "Despite" zıtlık bildirir. Ekonomistlerin başlangıçtaki şüphelerine rağmen mikrofinans projesinin binlerce aileyi yoksulluktan kurtarması (başarılı olması) zıtlık yapısını tamamlar.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Having conquered vast territories stretching from Greece to north-western India, -----.
option_a: ancient trade routes had already collapsed completely
option_b: Greek architecture became popular across Mediterranean ports
option_c: the soldiers were unwilling to march any further
option_d: Alexander the Great facilitated unprecedented cultural exchanges between East and West
option_e: the Persian empire was divided into separate satrapies
explanation: Kısaltma ile başlayan cümlede ("Having conquered...") gizli özne fetihleri gerçekleştiren kişidir. Dolayısıyla ana cümlenin öznesi "Alexander the Great" olmalıdır (Dangling modifier kuralı).

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: So intricate was the clockwork mechanism of the Antikythera mechanism that -----.
option_a: modern engineers could easily duplicate it within hours
option_b: ancient Greek sailors refused to use it on their voyages
option_c: it was made entirely of cheap wooden gears
option_d: no one believed that the artifacts were genuine
option_e: it took researchers decades to decipher its astrological and navigational functions
explanation: "So + adj + that" yapısı devrik (inverted) kullanılmıştır: Mekanizma o kadar karmaşıktı ki, araştırmacıların işlevini çözmesi onlarca yıl aldı.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Not only did the Industrial Revolution drastically accelerate global manufacturing, -----.
option_a: as well as creating massive migration to rural farming regions
option_b: nor could factory workers afford decent urban housing
option_c: however governments imposed strict regulations on child labour
option_d: and yet traditional artisan workshops continued to flourish
option_e: but it also fundamentally restructured social classes and family dynamics
explanation: "Not only ... but also ..." correlative bağlacı paralel yapılar kurar. Devrik başlayan cümlenin ("Not only did...") devamı "but it also fundamentally restructured..." olmalıdır.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"Recent scientific studies have revealed that chronic stress significantly weakens the human immune system."

Bu cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Bağışıklık sistemini zayıflatan kronik stres, son dönemde bilimsel çalışmalara konu olmuştur.
option_b: Kronik stresin insan bağışıklık sistemini zayıflattığı, son bilimsel araştırmalar sayesinde kanıtlanmaktadır.
option_c: Bilim insanları son araştırmalarda kronik stresin bağışıklık sistemini tahrip ettiğini açıklamışlardır.
option_d: Son bilimsel araştırmalar kronik stres ile bağışıklık sistemi arasındaki ilişkiyi göstermektedir.
option_e: Son bilimsel çalışmalar, kronik stresin insan bağışıklık sistemini önemli ölçüde zayıflattığını ortaya koymuştur.
explanation: İngilizce cümlenin öznesi "Recent scientific studies" (Son bilimsel çalışmalar), nesne cümlesi "...kronik stresin insan bağışıklık sistemini önemli ölçüde zayıflattığını", yüklemi ise "have revealed" (ortaya koymuştur) şeklindedir.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"Güneş panelleri, temiz ve yenilenebilir enerji ürettikleri için çevre dostu bir alternatif olarak kabul edilir."

Bu cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Solar panels are considered an eco-friendly alternative because they generate clean and renewable energy.
option_b: Because solar panels are clean and renewable, they produce eco-friendly alternative energy.
option_c: Generating clean and renewable energy makes solar panels the only eco-friendly choice.
option_d: Solar panels can be considered eco-friendly if they produce renewable and clean energy.
option_e: Eco-friendly solar panels are widely preferred to produce clean and renewable power.
explanation: Özne: "Solar panels", yüklem: "are considered an eco-friendly alternative" (çevre dostu bir alternatif olarak kabul edilir), bağlaç: "because they generate clean and renewable energy".

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"Although electric cars are becoming more affordable, the lack of charging stations remains a major problem."

Bu cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Şarj istasyonlarının yetersizliği, elektrikli araçların daha hesaplı olmasını engellemektedir.
option_b: Elektrikli arabalar giderek ucuzlamaktadır fakat şarj istasyonu eksikliği henüz çözülememiştir.
option_c: Elektrikli arabaların şarj istasyonu eksikliği büyük bir sorun olmaya devam etse de fiyatları düşmektedir.
option_d: Şarj istasyonu eksikliği büyük bir sorun olduğu için elektrikli arabaların fiyatı düşmemektedir.
option_e: Elektrikli arabalar daha uygun fiyatlı hale gelmesine rağmen şarj istasyonlarının eksikliği büyük bir sorun olmaya devam etmektedir.
explanation: "Although electric cars are becoming more affordable" (Elektrikli arabalar daha uygun fiyatlı hale gelmesine rağmen), "the lack of charging stations" (şarj istasyonlarının eksikliği), "remains a major problem" (büyük bir sorun olmaya devam etmektedir).

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"Yapay zeka teknolojilerinin hızla gelişmesi, birçok sektörde iş gücü talebini köklü bir biçimde değiştirebilir."

Bu cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: The rapid development of artificial intelligence technologies could drastically change labor demand in many sectors.
option_b: Labor demand in many sectors will definitely be changed by rapidly developing artificial intelligence technologies.
option_c: Drastic changes in labor demand have forced artificial intelligence technologies to develop rapidly in many sectors.
option_d: Since artificial intelligence is developing rapidly, labor demand has drastically changed across all industries.
option_e: Artificial intelligence technologies are developing so rapidly that labor demand in various sectors must change.
explanation: Özne: "The rapid development of artificial intelligence technologies" (Yapay zeka teknolojilerinin hızla gelişmesi), yüklem: "could drastically change" (köklü bir biçimde değiştirebilir), nesne: "labor demand in many sectors" (birçok sektörde iş gücü talebini).

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"Many philosophers argue that genuine happiness cannot be attained through material wealth alone."

Bu cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Filozofların çoğu, maddi zenginliğe ulaşanların gerçek mutluluğu kaybettiğini ileri sürmektedir.
option_b: Maddi zenginliğin tek başına gerçek mutluluğu getirmeyeceği filozoflar tarafından sıkça vurgulanır.
option_c: Gerçek mutluluğu arayan filozoflar, maddi zenginlikten uzak durulması gerektiğini savunurlar.
option_d: Bazı filozoflara göre gerçek mutluluk ve maddi zenginlik birbiriyle bağdaşmayan iki kavramdır.
option_e: Pek çok filozof, gerçek mutluluğun yalnızca maddi zenginlik yoluyla elde edilemeyeceğini savunmaktadır.
explanation: Özne: "Many philosophers" (Pek çok filozof), yüklem: "argue that" (...savunmaktadır), nesne: "genuine happiness cannot be attained through material wealth alone" (gerçek mutluluğun yalnızca maddi zenginlik yoluyla elde edilemeyeceğini).

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"Küresel ısınmanın olumsuz etkilerini en aza indirmek için tüm ülkeler sera gazı emisyonlarını acilen azaltmalıdır."

Bu cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Reducing greenhouse gas emissions will help all nations minimize the negative impacts of global warming.
option_b: In order to minimize the negative effects of global warming, all nations must urgently reduce their greenhouse gas emissions.
option_c: Unless greenhouse gas emissions are reduced urgently, global warming will negatively affect all nations.
option_d: All nations should have reduced greenhouse gas emissions to prevent the harmful effects of global warming.
option_e: Minimizing the consequences of global warming requires all countries to reduce greenhouse gas emissions completely.
explanation: Amaç öbeği: "In order to minimize the negative effects of global warming" (Küresel ısınmanın olumsuz etkilerini en aza indirmek için), ana cümle: "all nations must urgently reduce their greenhouse gas emissions" (tüm ülkeler sera gazı emisyonlarını acilen azaltmalıdır).

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"The telescope, which was launched into space in late 2021, has provided astronomers with unprecedented images of the earliest galaxies."

Bu cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: En eski galaksilerin benzeri görülmemiş görüntüleri, uzaya 2021'de fırlatılan yeni teleskop tarafından sağlanmaktadır.
option_b: 2021 sonunda uzaya yerleştirilen teleskobun amacı, gökbilimcilere eski galaksilerin görüntülerini ulaştırmaktı.
option_c: Gökbilimciler, 2021 sonlarında uzaya gönderdikleri teleskop sayesinde ilk galaksilere ait olağanüstü görüntüler elde etmişlerdir.
option_d: 2021'in sonlarında uzaya fırlatılan teleskop, gökbilimcilere en eski galaksilerin daha önce görülmemiş görüntülerini sağlamıştır.
option_e: Uzaya 2021 yılında fırlatılan teleskop, en eski galaksilerin fotoğraflarını çekerek gökbilimcileri şaşırtmıştır.
explanation: "The telescope, which was launched into space in late 2021" (2021'in sonlarında uzaya fırlatılan teleskop), "has provided astronomers with..." (gökbilimcilere sağlamıştır), "...unprecedented images of the earliest galaxies" (en eski galaksilerin daha önce görülmemiş görüntülerini).

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"Hükümetler tarafından alınan katı tedbirlere rağmen enflasyonun kontrol altına alınamaması, halkın satın alma gücünü ciddi biçimde zayıflatmıştır."

Bu cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: The public's purchasing power deteriorated severely because governments failed to take strict measures against inflation.
option_b: Strict measures taken by governments could not prevent inflation, which eventually undermined the public's buying power.
option_c: The failure to bring inflation under control despite the strict measures taken by governments has severely weakened the public's purchasing power.
option_d: Unless inflation is brought under control through strict measures, the purchasing power of the people will continue to weaken.
option_e: Although governments took strict measures to control inflation, the purchasing power of the public was completely lost.
explanation: Özne tamlaması: "The failure to bring inflation under control despite the strict measures taken by governments" (Hükümetler tarafından alınan katı tedbirlere rağmen enflasyonun kontrol altına alınamaması), yüklem: "has severely weakened" (ciddi biçimde zayıflatmıştır), nesne: "the public's purchasing power" (halkın satın alma gücünü).

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"It is widely acknowledged that emotional intelligence plays as crucial a role in career success as technical expertise does."

Bu cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Kariyer başarısı elde etmek isteyenlerin teknik uzmanlık yerine duygusal zekaya odaklanması gerektiği kabul edilir.
option_b: Teknik uzmanlık kadar duygusal zeka da kariyer başarısında önemli olduğu için geniş kitlelerce benimsenmiştir.
option_c: Duygusal zekanın kariyer başarısında teknik uzmanlık kadar kritik bir rol oynadığı yaygın bir biçimde kabul edilmektedir.
option_d: Duygusal zeka ve teknik uzmanlığın kariyer başarısındaki önemi birçok araştırmacı tarafından kanıtlanmıştır.
option_e: Yaygın kabule göre teknik uzmanlığı olmayan bir birey, sadece duygusal zekasıyla kariyerinde başarılı olamaz.
explanation: "It is widely acknowledged that..." (yaygın bir biçimde kabul edilmektedir), "...emotional intelligence plays as crucial a role in career success as technical expertise does" (duygusal zekanın kariyer başarısında teknik uzmanlık kadar kritik bir rol oynadığı).

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Honeybees play an indispensable role in maintaining global biodiversity and supporting modern agriculture. By transferring pollen from one flower to another, they enable flowering plants to reproduce, which accounts for nearly one-third of the crops consumed by humans. However, in recent decades, bee populations have suffered dramatic declines due to pesticide use, habitat loss, and climate shifts.

According to the passage, why are honeybees vital for human food supply?
option_a: They produce sweet honey that replaces sugar in modern diets.
option_b: They protect agricultural fields from aggressive pesticide chemicals.
option_c: They consume agricultural pests that destroy fruit orchards.
option_d: They migrate across continents to introduce exotic plant species.
option_e: Their pollination activities facilitate the reproduction of about a third of human-consumed crops.
explanation: Parçada açıkça "accounts for nearly one-third of the crops consumed by humans" ifadesiyle arıların tozlaşma yoluyla insanların tükettiği ürünlerin yaklaşık üçte birinin üremesini sağladığı belirtilmiştir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The Great Wall of China, stretching thousands of kilometers across northern China, was constructed over several centuries to protect Chinese states from nomadic invasions. Contrary to popular myth, the wall cannot actually be seen from low Earth orbit with the naked eye. Nevertheless, it remains one of humanity's greatest architectural and engineering feats.

It is clearly stated in the passage that the Great Wall of China -----.
option_a: can easily be spotted from space without binoculars
option_b: was erected within a single imperial dynasty
option_c: failed completely to protect ancient Chinese settlements
option_d: was built primarily to defend territories against nomadic incursions
option_e: is no longer considered a significant architectural landmark
explanation: Metinde "constructed over several centuries to protect Chinese states from nomadic invasions" cümlesi doğrudan D seçeneğindeki ifadeyi destekler.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Sleep deprivation has become an escalating public health crisis in contemporary societies. Chronic lack of adequate sleep not only impairs cognitive functions like memory and attention, but it also increases the risk of cardiovascular diseases and depression. Sleep researchers emphasize that adults require seven to nine hours of restorative rest each night.

What is the main topic of the passage?
option_a: How ancient civilizations managed their daily sleep cycles
option_b: The benefits of afternoon naps for working adults
option_c: The economic costs of pharmaceutical sleep aids
option_d: Why cardiovascular illnesses are more prevalent among teenagers
option_e: The severe physiological and mental consequences of insufficient sleep
explanation: Paragrafın bütünü yetersiz uykunun bilişsel, zihinsel ve kardiyovasküler sağlık üzerindeki olumsuz sonuçlarını ele almaktadır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
For decades, scientists believed that the adult human brain was a static organ, incapable of generating new neurons or altering its neural pathways. However, groundbreaking neuroscience research in the late 20th century disproved this dogma by introducing the concept of neuroplasticity. The brain possesses an extraordinary capacity to reorganize itself throughout life by forming new neural connections in response to learning, experience, or recovery from injury.

It can be understood from the passage that neuroplasticity -----.
option_a: was already well-documented by 18th-century medical scholars
option_b: demonstrates the brain's dynamic ability to adapt and rewire itself continuously
option_c: confirms the traditional view that the brain ceases development in adulthood
