option_d: occurs exclusively in children during early language acquisition
option_e: prevents any permanent recovery after traumatic brain injury
explanation: Metinde nöroplastisitenin beynin yaşam boyu yeni bağlantılar kurarak kendini yeniden yapılandırma ve uyum sağlama (adapt and rewire) yeteneğini gösterdiği açıkça vurgulanmaktadır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The deep sea remains the least explored ecosystem on Earth, with more than 80% of the ocean floor unmapped by high-resolution instruments. Despite the perpetual darkness, crushing hydrostatic pressures, and near-freezing temperatures, the abyss teems with bizarre organisms. Many of these creatures rely on bioluminescence—the biochemical production of light—to hunt, communicate, and deter predators in the pitch-black waters.

According to the text, deep-sea organisms utilize bioluminescence in order to -----.
option_a: generate body heat to survive freezing ocean currents
option_b: illuminate the entire ocean floor for human submarine explorers
option_c: dissolve toxic minerals released from hydrothermal vents
option_d: navigate and perform survival tasks such as capturing prey and warding off predators
option_e: produce oxygen through deep-water photosynthesis
explanation: Metinde bioluminescence özelliğinin "to hunt, communicate, and deter predators" (avlanmak, iletişim kurmak ve avcıları uzaklaştırmak) amacıyla kullanıldığı açıkça belirtilmiştir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Urbanization has transformed the natural landscape, replacing soil and vegetation with asphalt and concrete. Because these artificial materials absorb and retain significantly more heat than natural greenery, urban centers frequently experience substantially higher temperatures than their surrounding rural peripheries—a phenomenon termed the "urban heat island effect."

What is the primary cause of the urban heat island effect according to the passage?
option_a: The lack of adequate public transportation networks in suburbs
option_b: The excessive use of solar panels on skyscrapers
option_c: The rapid migration of wild animals into metropolitan areas
option_d: The absorption and retention of solar heat by artificial building materials
option_e: Extreme seasonal rainfalls washing away natural topsoil
explanation: Metinde kentsel ısı adası etkisinin sebebi "Because these artificial materials absorb and retain significantly more heat than natural greenery..." şeklinde açıklanmıştır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Archaeological excavations at Göbeklitepe in south-eastern Anatolia have fundamentally upended orthodox theories regarding human prehistory. Previously, scholars posited that agriculture led to settled life, which subsequently enabled the establishment of monumental religion and organized temples. Göbeklitepe, however, dating back roughly 11,500 years to a hunter-gatherer era, reveals massive stone megaliths carved with elaborate animal motifs erected before the advent of farming, implying that spiritual urges may have spurred agriculture rather than vice versa.

It can be inferred from the passage that the discovery of Göbeklitepe -----.
option_a: showed that religious temples were built exclusively after the invention of writing
option_b: proved that hunter-gatherers lacked any complex artistic or engineering capabilities
option_c: demonstrated that stone carving technology was brought from ancient Egypt
option_d: corroborated the classical view that farming preceded religious monuments
option_e: reversed the long-held assumption about the causal sequence between religion and settled farming communities
explanation: Metinde Göbeklitepe'nin, tarımın dine öncülük ettiği klasik teorisini tersine çevirerek ("upended orthodox theories... spiritual urges may have spurred agriculture rather than vice versa") din ve yerleşik tarım arasındaki nedensellik sırasını değiştirdiği belirtilmektedir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Language extinction is progressing at an alarming rate, with linguists estimating that nearly half of the world's 7,000 spoken tongues will vanish by the end of the 21st century. When a language disappears, it is not merely words that are lost; an entire repository of indigenous ecological knowledge, oral literature, and distinct cognitive frameworks disappears forever.

Which of the following expresses the author's primary concern regarding language extinction?
option_a: The increasing dominance of machine translation algorithms
option_b: The difficulty of teaching foreign languages in modern classrooms
option_c: The irreplaceable forfeiture of unique cultural wisdom and ecological insight
option_d: The political disputes between indigenous tribes and national governments
option_e: The economic burden of publishing multilingual dictionaries
explanation: Yazarın temel kaygısı, bir dilin yok olmasıyla sadece kelimelerin değil, telafisi imkansız yerli ekolojik bilginin, sözlü edebiyatın ve bilişsel modellerin sonsuza dek kaybolmasıdır ("entire repository of indigenous ecological knowledge... disappears forever").

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The ethical debate surrounding gene editing via CRISPR-Cas9 technology revolves around germline modification versus somatic therapy. While somatic therapies correct defective genes in non-reproductive cells to treat severe illnesses in a single individual, germline editing alters DNA in human embryos, thereby transmitting modifications to all future generations. Critics caution that germline interventions could trigger unintended off-target mutations and foster eugenic disparities.

The passage suggests that the principal ethical objection to germline editing is that -----.
option_a: heritable genetic alterations affect future descendants and carry unforeseen risks
option_b: it is substantially more expensive than conventional pharmaceutical drugs
option_c: it has failed to cure any non-reproductive genetic disorders so far
option_d: it requires the complete eradication of natural reproductive enzymes
option_e: it produces therapeutic effects that only last a few months in patients
explanation: Germline gen düzenlemesine yönelik temel etik itiraz, yapılan değişikliklerin gelecek nesillere kalıtım yoluyla aktarılması ("transmitting modifications to all future generations") ve öngörülemeyen mutasyon riskleri taşımasıdır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Emma: Have you seen my car keys anywhere? I've been looking for them for twenty minutes.
Liam: -----
Emma: Oh, you're right! I completely forgot I put them there when carrying the groceries.
option_a: I lost my house keys yesterday as well.
option_b: You should definitely take a driving course first.
option_c: Why don't you buy a brand-new car tomorrow?
option_d: Did you check the small basket on the hallway table next to the door?
option_e: I don't think you even own a car.
explanation: Emma'nın bir sonraki cümlesinde "Oh, you're right! I completely forgot I put them there..." demesi, Liam'ın anahtarların konulmuş olabileceği somut bir yeri (antredeki sepet) hatırlattığını gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
David: I'm planning to take up a new language this year, but I can't decide between Spanish and German.
Sarah: -----
David: That makes a lot of sense; global usefulness is definitely a big priority for my career.
option_a: German grammar is completely identical to English grammar.
option_b: Neither of them is useful in today's digital economy.
option_c: Spanish is spoken across so many countries, so it might open up more international opportunities.
option_d: I personally find learning any foreign language a waste of time.
option_e: You should drop out of college and travel the world instead.
explanation: David'in cevabındaki "global usefulness is definitely a big priority for my career" ifadesi, Sarah'nın İspanyolcanın küresel yaygınlığını ve uluslararası kariyer fırsatlarını önerdiğini gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Teacher: Why didn't you hand in your chemistry assignment yesterday, Alex?
Alex: -----
Teacher: All right, bring your medical note from the clinic tomorrow and you can submit it then.
option_a: I simply chose not to do it because it was boring.
option_b: Chemistry is my absolute favorite subject in school.
option_c: I thought assignments were never graded in this course.
option_d: I was suddenly taken ill and had to spend the entire afternoon at the doctor's.
option_e: My friend promised to do the entire homework for me.
explanation: Öğretmenin "bring your medical note from the clinic tomorrow" (yarın klinikten sağlık raporunu getir) yanıtı, Alex'in rahatsızlandığını ve doktora gittiğini belirttiğini açıklar.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Interviewer: Many remote workers report feeling isolated from their colleagues.
Manager: -----
Interviewer: So you believe regular informal interactions can restore that lost sense of community?
option_a: Isolation is an inevitable reality that no company can ever influence.
option_b: Yes, and we have decided to cancel all working-from-home privileges permanently.
option_c: Most employees refuse to communicate with their team members anyway.
option_d: To counter that, we schedule optional virtual coffee breaks and weekly team-building sessions.
option_e: Working from home is the most productive innovation in human history.
explanation: Mülakatçının "So you believe regular informal interactions can restore that lost sense of community?" sorusu, yöneticinin sanal kahve molaları ve takım etkinlikleri gibi gayriresmi etkileşimler düzenlediklerini söylediğini gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Dr. Harris: Our hospital's patient satisfaction rates have dropped considerably over the last quarter.
Dr. Evans: -----
Dr. Harris: Exactly. The excessive paperwork leaves nurses and doctors with barely any time to listen to patients.
option_a: Perhaps patients are simply ungrateful for the excellent medical treatment they receive.
option_b: All our physicians have recently resigned from their administrative duties.
option_c: It must be because our cafeteria serves low-quality sandwiches.
option_d: We should immediately double the parking fees outside the emergency ward.
option_e: I suspect the primary reason is the administrative burden distracting our staff from direct care.
explanation: Dr. Harris'in "Exactly. The excessive paperwork leaves nurses and doctors with barely any time..." onayı, Dr. Evans'ın idari yükün (administrative burden) personeli doğrudan hasta bakımından alıkoyduğunu ifade ettiğini gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Sophie: I was thinking of investing all my savings in cryptocurrency.
Mark: -----
Sophie: You're probably right. I shouldn't risk everything on such an unpredictable market.
option_a: Wouldn't it be wiser to diversify and put only a small portion into such a volatile asset?
option_b: You should never save any money and spend it immediately.
option_c: I already borrowed a million dollars to invest in the stock exchange.
option_d: That sounds like a guaranteed way to become a billionaire overnight.
option_e: Traditional banks are completely fraud-proof and much better.
explanation: Sophie'nin "You're probably right. I shouldn't risk everything on such an unpredictable market" yanıtı, Mark'ın tüm birikimi tek bir oynak varlığa yatırmak yerine sepeti çeşitlendirmeyi tavsiye ettiğini gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Professor Adams: The latest archeological carbon dating suggests human occupation in the Americas occurred far earlier than the Clovis culture.
Dr. Baker: -----
Professor Adams: Not necessarily. The stone tools recovered from the lower geological strata provide compelling material proof.
option_a: I was already convinced of that theory decades ago.
option_b: Everyone agrees that human migration across the Bering Strait never happened.
option_c: Archaeologists have lost all faith in radiocarbon dating accuracy.
option_d: The Clovis culture has always been dated to the Bronze Age.
option_e: Could those anomalies simply be the result of modern contamination in the soil samples?
explanation: Profesörün "Not necessarily. The stone tools recovered from the lower geological strata provide compelling material proof" cevabı, Dr. Baker'ın bulguların toprak kontaminasyonu (modern kirlenme) sonucu olabileceği yönünde şüphe belirttiğini ("Could those anomalies simply be the result of modern contamination...?") gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Journalist: Critics claim that space exploration budgets should be diverted entirely to resolving domestic poverty.
Astronaut: -----
Journalist: So in your view, the technological spin-offs actually yield far-reaching socioeconomic benefits down on Earth?
option_a: Governments have already ceased funding any planetary exploration programs.
option_b: We should build permanent human colonies on distant galaxies as soon as possible.
option_c: That view overlooks how space research sparks innovations in medicine, telecommunications, and clean energy.
option_d: Poverty on Earth will inevitably disappear on its own in a few years.
option_e: Space travel is exclusively designed for billionaires looking for extreme entertainment.
explanation: Gazetecinin "So in your view, the technological spin-offs actually yield far-reaching socioeconomic benefits down on Earth?" özetlemesi, astronotun uzay araştırmalarının tıp, telekomünikasyon ve temiz enerji gibi alanlarda Dünya'ya dönük yenilikler ürettiğini açıkladığını gösterir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Chloe: I'm hesitant about publishing this article because some of our conclusions might provoke strong public backlash.
Ethan: -----
Chloe: True, but if we lose our journalistic integrity for the sake of public comfort, we defeat the whole purpose of investigative reporting.
option_a: Investigative journalism has never contributed to any social reform.
option_b: We should publish it immediately without even double-checking the facts.
option_c: I couldn't care less about what our readers think of our editorial policies.
option_d: Perhaps we could soften the tone of the revelations to avoid alienating our readership.
option_e: Let's cancel the entire newspaper issue and take a vacation.
explanation: Chloe'nin "True, but if we lose our journalistic integrity for the sake of public comfort..." cevabı, Ethan'ın okuyucuları rahatsız etmemek için yazıdaki ifşaların tonunu yumuşatmayı (soften the tone) önerdiğini gösterir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"Only by drastically cutting fossil fuel consumption can humanity avoid the most catastrophic effects of global warming."

Bu cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: If humanity continues to consume fossil fuels, global warming will remain completely harmless.
option_b: Reducing fossil fuel consumption is one of several minor options to combat global warming.
option_c: Global warming will inevitably destroy the planet regardless of fossil fuel consumption levels.
option_d: Catastrophic global warming has already been avoided thanks to reductions in fossil fuels.
option_e: Humanity can prevent the worst consequences of climate change solely if fossil fuel usage is reduced substantially.
explanation: "Only by drastically cutting..." ifadesi "solely if fossil fuel usage is reduced substantially" (yalnızca fosil yakıt tüketimi önemli ölçüde azaltılırsa) ile birebir örtüşür; "avoid the most catastrophic effects" de "prevent the worst consequences" ile eş anlamlıdır.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
A colleague at work invites you to a weekend camping trip. You really appreciate the invitation, but you already made a prior commitment to attend your cousin's wedding out of town. You want to decline politely while explaining your situation.

What do you say?
option_a: Why would anyone go camping when they could stay comfortably in a hotel?
option_b: I will come camping only if you pay for all my equipment and travel expenses.
option_c: My cousin's wedding is boring, so I will cancel it and join your trip.
option_d: Thank you so much for the kind invite, but I have to attend my cousin's wedding that weekend.
option_e: I hate camping, so don't ever ask me again.
explanation: Kibarca teşekkür edip ("Thank you so much for the kind invite") önceden verilmiş kuzen düğünü sözünü mazeret olarak sunan ("but I have to attend my cousin's wedding that weekend") D seçeneği duruma tam uyar.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"No student in the class performed better than Emily on the final physics examination."

Bu cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Emily failed the final physics examination along with most of her classmates.
option_b: Several students in the class achieved a better physics score than Emily.
option_c: Emily scored the highest grade among all the students on the final physics exam.
option_d: Emily performed moderately well, but others performed equally well.
option_e: Physics was the easiest examination for everyone in the class including Emily.
explanation: "No student... performed better than Emily" cümlesi, Emily'nin sınıftaki tüm öğrenciler arasında en yüksek notu aldığını ("Emily scored the highest grade among all the students...") ifade eder.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"Although the manager had reservations about the proposed marketing campaign, she gave it her approval due to the team's enthusiasm."

Bu cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: The manager cancelled the marketing project because she felt the team lacked necessary enthusiasm.
option_b: Because the marketing campaign seemed flawless, the manager approved it without any hesitation.
option_c: The team's excitement persuaded the manager to endorse the marketing campaign despite her initial doubts.
option_d: The manager's deep skepticism caused the entire marketing team to lose their enthusiasm.
option_e: Despite the team's strong opposition, the manager insisted on launching the new marketing strategy.
explanation: Orijinal cümledeki "had reservations" (şüpheleri vardı) -> "initial doubts"; "gave it her approval" -> "endorse"; "due to the team's enthusiasm" -> "the team's excitement persuaded..." şeklinde eşdeğer biçimde C seçeneğinde ifade edilmiştir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
You ordered an expensive laptop online, but upon delivery, you discover that the screen is badly cracked. You immediately contact the customer service representative, intending to firmly express your dissatisfaction and demand a prompt replacement.

What do you say?
option_a: I don't really mind the broken screen as long as the battery works fine.
option_b: The laptop is fine, but could you tell me how to clean the keyboard properly?
option_c: You should never sell electronics online because delivery companies are clumsy.
option_d: The laptop arrived with a damaged screen, which is unacceptable; I would like an immediate replacement sent.
option_e: I accidentally dropped the laptop onto the floor, so can I get a full refund?
explanation: Memnuniyetsizliği kararlı ve net bir şekilde ifade edip ("unacceptable") derhal ürün değişimi talep eden ("I would like an immediate replacement sent") seçenek B'dir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"Hardly had the renowned pianist finished his recital when the audience erupted into thunderous applause."

Bu cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: The pianist could barely finish his recital because of the loud interruptions from the crowd.
option_b: The audience began cheering enthusiastically long before the pianist concluded his performance.
option_c: As soon as the celebrated pianist completed his performance, the audience applauded enthusiastically.
option_d: The audience hesitated to applaud even after the pianist had left the stage.
option_e: Unless the pianist played another piece, the audience refused to clap their hands.
explanation: "Hardly ... when ..." yapısı "As soon as" (yapar yapmaz) ile birebir denktir. Piyanist resitalini bitirir bitirmez seyircilerin coşkuyla alkışlaması C seçeneğinde tam olarak verilmiştir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"Had the local authorities evacuated the flood-prone residential districts in advance, the casualty toll would not have been nearly as devastating."

Bu cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Because municipal officials failed to evacuate vulnerable neighborhoods beforehand, a tragically high number of people lost their lives.
option_b: The authorities managed to evacuate the region on time, keeping casualty numbers down to a minimum.
option_c: Local residents refused to leave their homes despite urgent early warnings from emergency officials.
option_d: The high number of casualties was inevitable because evacuation procedures were completely impossible.
option_e: If the flood had struck unexpectedly, even an advance evacuation could not have reduced the casualties.
explanation: Devrik Type 3 koşul cümlesi ("Had the local authorities evacuated..."): Yetkililer su baskını riski taşıyan yerleşimleri önceden tahliye etmiş olsaydı can kaybı bu kadar yıkıcı olmazdı (yani tahliye etmediler ve bu yüzden can kaybı trajik biçimde yüksek oldu). A seçeneği bu gerçeği eksiksiz verir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
You are the manager of an engineering team. One of your junior engineers made a critical calculation mistake that delayed the project. However, you know they have been working under intense stress and usually perform excellently. You want to point out the error constructively while encouraging them and preserving their morale.

What do you say?
option_a: I will fix the mistake myself because you are clearly incapable of handling pressure.
option_b: I don't care why the project was delayed, as long as you do all the overtime for free.
option_c: Let's review this calculation together; mistakes happen under heavy workloads, and I have complete faith in your technical skills.
option_d: Your incompetence has ruined the entire project, and you will be dismissed immediately.
option_e: You should never attempt engineering calculations without asking permission first.
explanation: Hatayı yapıcı bir şekilde ele alırken ("Let's review this calculation together; mistakes happen under heavy workloads") çalışanının moralini koruyan ve ona güvendiğini belirten ("and I have complete faith in your technical skills") C seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"Much as artificial intelligence algorithms have advanced in medical diagnosis, they cannot replace the compassionate touch of experienced clinicians."

Bu cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Since AI algorithms lack compassion, they have proven entirely useless in clinical diagnosis.
option_b: Artificial intelligence will soon substitute human physicians entirely because of its superior diagnostic precision.
option_c: Experienced clinicians rely on artificial intelligence algorithms more than their own medical intuition.
option_d: Even though AI has made remarkable strides in diagnosing illnesses, human doctors remain irreplaceable due to their empathetic care.
option_e: Medical diagnosis has deteriorated significantly following the implementation of artificial intelligence.
explanation: "Much as..." (Although/Her ne kadar... ise de) zıtlık yapısıdır: Yapay zeka tıbbi teşhiste çok ilerlemiş olsa da tecrübeli hekimlerin şefkatli yaklaşımının yerini alamaz. D seçeneği bu zıtlığı ve anlamı birebir karşılar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
Volcanic eruptions can have profound impacts on global climate. When a major volcano erupts, it injects vast quantities of sulfur dioxide gas high into the stratosphere. -----. As a result, global surface temperatures can drop by several tenths of a degree for up to three years.

Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere anlam akışına göre getirilebilecek en uygun cümle hangisidir?
option_a: Local residents are usually evacuated well before the lava flows reach urban centers
option_b: Most volcanoes are located along the boundaries of tectonic plates in the Pacific Ocean
option_c: Volcanic ash makes surrounding agricultural lands exceptionally fertile over centuries
option_d: These gases react with water vapor to form reflective sulfate aerosols that bounce solar radiation back into space
option_e: Geologists use seismographs to detect early tremors beneath the mountain slopes
explanation: Önceki cümlede stratosfere kükürt dioksit gazı püskürtüldüğü belirtilmiş, sonraki cümlede ise küresel sıcaklıkların düşmesi neticesi verilmiştir. Aradaki köprü, bu gazların güneş ışınlarını geri yansıtan sülfat aerosollerine dönüşmesi olmalıdır.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Renewable energy sources, particularly solar and wind, have expanded rapidly across Europe over the past decade. (II) Modern solar panels have become significantly more affordable and efficient than their predecessors. (III) In fact, coal was the dominant fuel source during the nineteenth century Industrial Revolution. (IV) Similarly, wind turbine technology now produces electricity at prices competitive with fossil fuels. (V) This clean energy transition has substantially reduced the continent's reliance on imported gas.

Yukarıdaki numaralanmış cümlelerden hangisi parçanın anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır?
option_a: V
option_b: IV
option_c: I
option_d: II
option_e: III
explanation: Paragraf günümüz Avrupa'sında güneş ve rüzgar gibi yenilenebilir enerjilerin yükselişini anlatırken III numaralı cümle 19. yüzyıl Sanayi Devrimi'nde kömürün baskın yakıt olmasından bahsederek konu odağını ve kronolojiyi bozar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
Learning to play a musical instrument offers remarkable cognitive benefits, especially during childhood. It requires the simultaneous coordination of visual, auditory, and motor functions. -----. Consequently, children who undergo musical training often display improved spatial reasoning and mathematical competence.

Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek en uygun ifade hangisidir?
option_a: Classical music concerts usually adhere to strict dress codes and formal etiquette
option_b: Not all schools have sufficient funding to establish school marching bands
option_c: Many professional musicians suffer from chronic hearing loss later in their careers
option_d: Violins and pianos are among the most expensive instruments to purchase
option_e: This rigorous multi-sensory practice stimulates neural connectivity across different regions of the brain
explanation: Boşluktan önce görsel, işitsel ve motor fonksiyonların koordinasyonu belirtilmiş; boşluktan sonra da gelişmiş uzamsal akıl yürütme ve matematik yeteneği sonucu verilmiştir. E seçeneğindeki "This rigorous multi-sensory practice stimulates neural connectivity..." iki cümle arasında mükemmel mantık bağı kurar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Whales communicate across vast ocean distances using complex acoustic vocalizations known as whale songs. (II) These intricate melodies can travel thousands of kilometers through water, which conducts sound much faster than air. (III) Humpback whale populations have gradually recovered in several marine reserves following international hunting bans. (IV) Baleen whales utilize these calls to locate mates, coordinate migratory movements, and navigate underwater topography. (V) However, increasing anthropogenic noise from commercial shipping vessels now severely disrupts this vital communication channel.

Yukarıdaki numaralanmış cümlelerden hangisi parçanın anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır?
option_a: III
option_b: IV
option_c: V
option_d: I
option_e: II
explanation: Paragraf balinaların su altı sesli iletişimini (whale songs, acoustic calls, underwater sound) ve gemi gürültüsünün bunu engellemesini işlemektedir. III numaralı cümle ise avlanma yasaklarıyla balina nüfusunun toparlanmasından söz ederek tematik akışı bozar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
For centuries, paper was crafted exclusively from recycled cotton and linen rags, making books scarce and expensive luxury goods. -----. By utilizing abundant wood pulp and mechanized printing presses, publishers could produce thousands of affordable paperbacks daily, sparking a worldwide literacy revolution.

Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere anlam akışına göre getirilebilecek en uygun cümle hangisidir?
option_a: Ancient Egyptians wrote their religious texts on rolls of papyrus reed
option_b: This scarcity ended dramatically in the mid-19th century with the invention of industrial chemical papermaking
option_c: Many medieval monks spent decades illuminating religious manuscripts in monasteries
option_d: Digital e-readers have recently replaced printed paperbacks in modern schools
option_e: Libraries in the Middle Ages frequently chained valuable volumes to reading desks
explanation: Önceki cümlede kitapların nadir ve pahalı lüks eşyalar olduğu ("scarce and expensive") anlatılmış, sonraki cümlede ise binlerce ucuz kitabın üretildiği devrim anlatılmıştır. B seçeneği ("This scarcity ended dramatically in the mid-19th century...") bu kıtlığın nasıl sona erdiğini açıklayan köprüdür.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Photosynthesis is the fundamental biological process that sustains almost all aerobic life on Earth. (II) Chlorophyll pigments within plant leaves absorb sunlight, converting water and atmospheric carbon dioxide into glucose. (III) In addition to synthesizing sugars, this biochemical reaction releases oxygen as a vital byproduct into the atmosphere. (IV) Some carnivorous plants obtain nitrogen by capturing and digesting insects in nutrient-poor bogs. (V) Without this continuous replenishment of oxygen and organic nutrients, complex food webs would collapse.

Yukarıdaki numaralanmış cümlelerden hangisi parçanın anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır?
option_a: II
option_b: V
option_c: III
option_d: I
option_e: IV
explanation: Paragraf fotosentezin mekanizması ve oksijen-glikoz üretimiyle tüm canlıları beslemesini anlatmaktadır. IV numaralı cümle ise araya etçil bitkilerin böcek yakalamasını sokarak odağı bozar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
Deserts are often stereotyped as lifeless wastelands of shifting dunes. -----. Many desert plants possess succulent stems and extensive shallow root systems that capture flash flood water instantly, while nocturnal animals evade the blistering daytime heat by resting in underground burrows.

Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek en uygun cümle hangisidir?
option_a: Global desertification threatens millions of small-scale agricultural farms in Africa
option_b: Yet they host diverse biological communities exhibiting extraordinary physiological adaptations to arid conditions
option_c: The Sahara Desert covers nearly the entire northern third of the African continent
option_d: Camels have long served as the primary beasts of burden for trans-Saharan caravans
option_e: Solar energy farms built in arid deserts could theoretically power entire continents
explanation: İlk cümledeki stereotip ("lifeless wastelands") zıtlık bağlacıyla ("Yet they host diverse biological communities...") çürütülmüş, ardından bu canlıların kuraklığa olağanüstü uyumları (etkili kök sistemleri, gececil yaşam) örneklendirilmiştir.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) In ancient Roman society, the concept of citizenship evolved from an exclusive patrician privilege into a broader imperial instrument of assimilation. (II) Originally restricted to free-born male inhabitants of Rome itself, Roman civil rights granted immunity from arbitrary punishment and the right to vote. (III) Roman legions were renowned for their iron discipline and tactical mastery on Mediterranean battlefields. (IV) Over centuries, emperor edicts gradually extended citizenship to allied Italian communities and loyal provincial elites. (V) Ultimately, Emperor Caracalla's edict in 212 AD granted universal citizenship to virtually all free inhabitants across the entire Roman Empire.

Yukarıdaki numaralanmış cümlelerden hangisi parçanın anlam bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır?
option_a: II
option_b: V
option_c: IV
option_d: I
option_e: III
explanation: Paragraf baştan sona Roma vatandaşlığının (citizenship) kapsamının genişlemesini (I, II, IV ve Caracalla fermanı V) konu almaktadır. III numaralı cümle ise Roma lejyonlarının askeri disiplin ve taktiğinden bahsederek akışı bozar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
The placebo effect demonstrates the profound interconnectedness of mental expectation and physiological healing. When patients receive an inert substance—such as a sugar pill—believing it to be a potent pharmaceutical drug, their brains often release genuine neurotransmitters like endorphins and dopamine. -----. Consequently, clinical drug trials must always include blind, randomized placebo control groups to prove that a new medicine's efficacy exceeds mere psychological belief.

Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere getirilebilecek en uygun cümle hangisidir?
option_a: Homeopathic treatments have sparked heated controversies in public health councils
option_b: Some medical ethics committees completely ban all forms of surgical operations
option_c: Most patients prefer generic over-the-counter pain medications due to lower market prices
option_d: Modern pharmaceutical development requires billions of dollars in laboratory research
option_e: These biochemical secretions result in measurable, physical alleviation of pain and clinical symptoms
explanation: Önceki cümlede beynin endorfin ve dopamin gibi nörotransmitterleri salgıladığı söylenmiş; E seçeneğinde bu biyokimyasal salgıların ağrıda ölçülebilir somut fiziksel rahatlama sağladığı belirtilmiş, sonraki cümlede de bu yüzden ilaç deneylerinde plasebo kontrol gruplarının şart olduğu sonucuna bağlanmıştır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Read the passage and answer the question.

"Honeybees play an irreplaceable role in pollinating flowering plants and agricultural crops worldwide. Nearly one-third of the food humans consume depends directly or indirectly on bee pollination. However, habitat fragmentation, pesticide overuse, and climate fluctuations have led to an alarming decline in bee populations over the past few decades."

According to the passage, why are honeybees considered crucial for human life?
option_a: Because they produce all the agricultural fertilizer needed by farmers.
option_b: Because their populations have been steadily rising worldwide.
option_c: Because they provide pollination for about one-third of the global food supply.
option_d: Because pesticide use increases their honey production significantly.
option_e: Because they are completely resistant to environmental fluctuations.
explanation: Parçada 'Nearly one-third of the food humans consume depends directly or indirectly on bee pollination' ifadesi açıkça bal arılarının tükettiğimiz gıdaların yaklaşık üçte birinin tozlaşmasını sağladığını belirtmektedir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Read the passage and answer the question.

"Neuroplasticity refers to the human brain's remarkable capacity to reorganize synaptic connections throughout life in response to learning, environmental changes, or neurological injury. Previously, scientists believed that brain development halted entirely after early adulthood. Recent neuroimaging breakthroughs, however, have refuted this dogma by proving that adults can continuously forge new neural pathways when acquiring complex skills such as playing a musical instrument or mastering a foreign language."

It can be inferred from the passage that earlier scientific beliefs about the brain ----.
option_a: claimed that foreign language learning causes severe neurological damage
option_b: focused exclusively on the regeneration of peripheral nerves
option_c: were fully verified by recent neuroimaging breakthroughs
option_d: accurately predicted how musical training alters brain circuits
option_e: underestimated the brain's enduring adaptability in mature adults
explanation: Metinde daha önce bilim insanlarının beyin gelişiminin erken yetişkinlikte tamamen durduğuna inandığı ('development halted entirely after early adulthood'), fakat yeni bulguların bu dogmayı çürüttüğü ('refuted this dogma') anlatılmaktadır. Dolayısıyla eski inanışlar yetişkin beyninin uyum ve değişim kapasitesini hafife almıştır (underestimated).

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Read the passage and answer the question.

"The rapid advancement of generative artificial intelligence models has elicited profound debates regarding intellectual property and ethical accountability. While proponents emphasize unprecedented productivity gains across software engineering, medicine, and creative arts, critics caution against the rampant propagation of synthetic misinformation, algorithmic bias, and the potential displacement of knowledge workers. Consequently, international regulatory bodies are scrambling to construct comprehensive oversight frameworks that foster innovation without compromising societal safety."

What is the primary objective of the international regulatory bodies mentioned in the passage?
option_a: To ensure that synthetic media completely replaces human knowledge workers
option_b: To force creative artists to adopt generative models immediately
option_c: To ban all generative AI technologies across healthcare and software engineering
option_d: To strike a delicate equilibrium between promoting technological advancement and safeguarding public interests
option_e: To penalize organizations that achieve high productivity gains
explanation: Parçanın son cümlesindeki 'construct comprehensive oversight frameworks that foster innovation without compromising societal safety' ifadesi, inovasyonu (gelişimi) teşvik ederken toplum güvenliğini de tehlikeye atmayan dengeli bir denetim mekanizması oluşturma hedefini (strike an equilibrium) ifade eder.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text:
Choose the option that best completes the sentence.

Although renewable energy investments have expanded at an unprecedented rate, ----.
option_a: clean energy technologies have proven to be exceptionally efficient
option_b: wind turbines produce vast amounts of electricity without greenhouse emissions
option_c: solar panels are becoming significantly cheaper to manufacture
option_d: fossil fuels still account for the majority of global energy consumption
option_e: governments have completely eliminated coal-fired power plants
explanation: 'Although' (her ne kadar ... olsa da) zıtlık bağlacıdır. Yenilenebilir enerji yatırımları rekor hızla artsa da, fosil yakıtların hâlâ küresel enerji tüketiminin çoğunluğunu oluşturması mantıklı ve dilbilgisel bir zıtlık oluşturur.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text:
Choose the option that best completes the sentence.

----, researchers were unable to draw definitive conclusions from the clinical trial.
option_a: Even if the therapeutic outcome exceeded all medical expectations
option_b: As the experimental hypothesis had been conclusively validated
option_c: Since all laboratory equipment operated with flawless accuracy
option_d: Because the preliminary data contained substantial statistical inconsistencies
option_e: Owing to the remarkably large and diverse sample of participants
explanation: Ana cümlede araştırmacıların klinik deneyden kesin sonuçlar çıkaramadığı ('unable to draw definitive conclusions') belirtilmektedir. Bunun nedeni ön verilerdeki tutarsızlıklar ('preliminary data contained substantial statistical inconsistencies') olabilir; 'Because' sebep-sonuç ilişkisini kusursuz kurar.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text:
Choose the option that best completes the sentence.

Unless rigorous multilateral agreements are enacted to regulate deep-sea mining, ----.
option_a: ocean floor mineral extraction has already ceased completely
option_b: coastal communities will have celebrated the discovery of rare earth metals
option_c: marine biodiversity would have flourished without human interference
option_d: international maritime laws had proven to be redundant
option_e: fragile benthic ecosystems could suffer irreversible catastrophic damage
explanation: 'Unless' (eğer ... olmazsa / -medikçe) Type 1 koşul cümlesidir. Derin deniz madenciliğini düzenleyen sıkı çok taraflı anlaşmalar yürürlüğe konulmadığı takdirde, kırılgan dip ekosistemleri geri dönülmez yıkıcı hasarlar alabilir ('could suffer irreversible damage').

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Verilen İngilizce cümlenin Türkçe dengini bulunuz.

"Regular physical exercise not only strengthens the cardiovascular system but also significantly reduces stress levels."
option_a: Kardiyovasküler sistem güçlendikçe bireylerin stres seviyeleri düzenli olarak azalır.
option_b: Düzenli spor yapmak stresi azalttığı gibi kalp sağlığını da doğrudan korur.
option_c: Düzenli fiziksel egzersiz sadece kardiyovasküler sistemi güçlendirmekle kalmaz, aynı zamanda stres seviyesini de önemli ölçüde azaltır.
option_d: Kardiyovasküler sistemi güçlendiren düzenli egzersizler, stresi de tamamen ortadan kaldırabilir.
option_e: Stres seviyesini düşürmek için yapılan fiziksel aktiviteler kalp sistemini kuvvetlendirir.
explanation: 'not only ... but also ...' kalıbı 'sadece ... değil, aynı zamanda ...' anlamına gelir. 'strengthens the cardiovascular system' (kardiyovasküler sistemi güçlendirir) ve 'significantly reduces stress levels' (stres seviyesini önemli ölçüde azaltır). Tam ve eksiksiz karşılık C şıkkıdır.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Verilen Türkçe cümlenin İngilizce dengini bulunuz.

"Tarih boyunca ticaret yolları yalnızca ticari malların değil, aynı zamanda kültürel değerlerin ve bilimsel keşiflerin de yayılmasını sağlamıştır."
option_a: Cultural values and scientific breakthroughs were transmitted along trade routes long before commercial goods were traded.
option_b: The dissemination of scientific discoveries across trade routes has always surpassed the value of commercial merchandise.
option_c: Throughout history, trade routes primarily served to exchange cultural traditions rather than commercial commodities.
option_d: Throughout history, trade routes facilitated the dissemination not only of commercial goods, but also of cultural values and scientific discoveries.
option_e: Trade routes were historically established solely to transport goods, culture, and scientific innovations across distant continents.
explanation: 'Tarih boyunca' -> 'Throughout history'; 'ticaret yolları ... sağlamıştır' -> 'trade routes facilitated...'; 'yalnızca ticari malların değil, aynı zamanda...' -> 'not only of commercial goods, but also of cultural values and scientific discoveries'. Doğru çeviri D seçeneğidir.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Verilen İngilizce cümlenin Türkçe dengini bulunuz.

"Despite facing severe economic constraints, the small island nation has managed to achieve complete energy independence through geothermal power."
option_a: Ciddi ekonomik kısıtlamalarla karşı karşıya kalmasına rağmen küçük ada ülkesi, jeotermal enerji sayesinde tam enerji bağımsızlığı elde etmeyi başarmıştır.
option_b: Ekonomik kısıtlamalara rağmen enerji bağımsızlığına ulaşan ülke, jeotermal santralleri komşu adalara ihraç etmektedir.
option_c: Jeotermal enerji yatırımları, ekonomik kısıtlamalara maruz kalan küçük ada ülkesinin enerji ihtiyacını kısmen karşılamıştır.
option_d: Küçük ada ülkesi jeotermal enerji üretimine yönelerek tüm ekonomik engelleri ve enerji krizini tamamen aşmıştır.
option_e: Küçük ada ülkesi ekonomik sıkıntılar nedeniyle jeotermal enerjiden faydalanamamış ve dışa bağımlı kalmıştır.
explanation: 'Despite facing severe economic constraints' -> 'Ciddi ekonomik kısıtlamalarla karşı karşıya kalmasına rağmen'; 'the small island nation has managed to achieve...' -> 'küçük ada ülkesi ... başarmıştır'; 'complete energy independence through geothermal power' -> 'jeotermal enerji sayesinde tam enerji bağımsızlığı elde etmeyi'. Tam karşılık A'dır.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given statement.

"No sooner had the keynote speaker stepped onto the stage than the fire alarm went off."
option_a: The fire alarm was triggered long before the keynote presentation even began.
option_b: The audience panicked and evacuated the stage as soon as the speaker appeared.
option_c: The keynote speaker refused to enter the auditorium because the fire alarm was ringing.
option_d: The speaker delayed his presentation until the fire alarm was completely silenced.
option_e: The fire alarm sounded immediately after the keynote speaker walked onto the stage.
explanation: 'No sooner had ... than ...' kalıbı '... yapar yapmaz / hemen ardından ... oldu' anlamına gelir. Konuşmacı sahneye adımını atar atmaz yangın alarmı çalmıştır. Bu cümlenin en yakın anlamlısı 'The fire alarm sounded immediately after the keynote speaker walked onto the stage' (A) ifadesidir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Find the most appropriate response for the given situation.

"A colleague has spent weeks preparing an elaborate presentation for a prospective client. Just an hour before the meeting, the client calls to reschedule for next month. Your colleague is visibly demoralized and feels like their hard work has been wasted. You want to cheer them up and reassure them that their preparation will still be valuable. You say: ----"
option_a: I told you from the very beginning that this client was unreliable and that you were wasting your time.
option_b: Perhaps you should completely redo the slides because they were clearly dissatisfied with our offer.
option_c: You should definitely call them back and demand an immediate explanation for this unacceptable cancellation.
option_d: Don't be discouraged; your thorough preparation won't go in vain, and you'll be even more confident when we meet them next month.
option_e: Let's just delete the whole proposal since the contract has been permanently cancelled.
explanation: Durumda moral vermek ('cheer them up') ve emeğin boşa gitmediğini, gelecek ay yapılacak toplantıda işe yarayacağını belirterek rahatlatmak ('reassure them') isteniyor. A seçeneği tam bu teselliyi sağlar.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given statement.

"Had the expedition team not brought satellite communication devices, they could not have been rescued following the sudden avalanche."
option_a: If the rescue team had arrived earlier, the expedition would not have suffered from the avalanche.
option_b: Even though they possessed satellite equipment, the rescue crew failed to locate them after the avalanche.
option_c: The mountaineers decided to abandon their satellite devices before attempting the dangerous ascent.
option_d: The team was saved after the unexpected avalanche only because they had satellite communication equipment with them.
option_e: The sudden avalanche destroyed all their communication gear, making their rescue virtually impossible.
explanation: Devrik Type 3 koşul cümlesi: 'Eğer uydu iletişim cihazları getirmemiş olsalardı, ani çığın ardından kurtarılamazlardı.' Yani kurtarılmalarının yegâne sebebi yanlarında bu uydu cihazlarının bulunmasıydı ('The team was saved ... only because they had satellite communication equipment...'). Doğru yanıt D'dır.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: The government has introduced new strict regulations to ---- environmental pollution caused by industrial factories.
option_a: increase
option_b: reduce
option_c: expand
option_d: ignore
option_e: celebrate
explanation: Cümlede hükümetin yeni sıkı düzenlemelerle fabrikaların neden olduğu çevre kirliliğine ne yapmak istediği soruluyor. Mantıklı fiil "reduce"tur (azaltmak): "to reduce environmental pollution". "Increase" artırmak, "expand" genişletmek, "ignore" görmezden gelmek, "celebrate" kutlamak anlamındadır ve düzenleme amacıyla çelişir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Due to unexpected heavy snowfall and poor visibility, the aviation authorities decided to ---- all domestic flights until tomorrow morning.
option_a: carry out
option_b: look into
option_c: turn down
option_d: bring up
option_e: call off
explanation: "Call off" iptal etmek anlamına gelen bir phrasal verb'dür (cancel). Yoğun kar sebebiyle uçuşlar iptal edilmiştir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Despite facing severe financial hardships and numerous obstacles, the young entrepreneur showed remarkable ---- and successfully launched her innovative company.
option_a: coincidence
option_b: indifference
option_c: resilience
option_d: negligence
option_e: reluctance
explanation: "Despite ..." yapısı zorluklara rağmen gerçekleşen olumlu bir sonucu bildirir; genç girişimci güçlüklere karşı başarıyla şirket kurmuştur. Boşluğa zorluklardan sonra toparlanma gücünü anlatan "resilience" (dayanıklılık, direnç) uyar. "Coincidence" tesadüf, "indifference" ilgisizlik, "negligence" ihmalkârlık, "reluctance" isteksizliktir ve cümlenin olumlu anlamıyla çelişir.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: By the time the rescue team reached the isolated mountain village, the volunteers ---- several shelters for the survivors.
option_a: have built
option_b: will build
option_c: had already built
option_d: are building
option_e: build
explanation: "By the time + Simple Past" yapısı geçmişte daha önce tamamlanmış bir eylemi anlattığı için Past Perfect Tense (had already built) gerektirir.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ---- the weather forecast warned about imminent torrential rain, hundreds of eager runners participated in the annual charity marathon.
option_a: In order that
option_b: As long as
option_c: Since
option_d: Although
option_e: Because
explanation: Yağmur uyarısına rağmen koşucuların katılması zıtlık belirttiğinden "Although" (rağmen, -e karşın) bağlacı kullanılır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: If the ancient library of Alexandria ---- during historical conflicts, modern historians ---- far more about classical civilization today.
option_a: was not destroyed / know
option_b: had not been destroyed / would know
option_c: were not destroyed / have known
option_d: would not destroy / might have known
option_e: has not been destroyed / will know

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Emily: Have you finished reading the science fiction novel I lent you last week?
David: Yes, I read the entire book in just two days!
Emily: ----
David: Absolutely! The unexpected ending blew my mind.
option_a: What time will the train arrive?

option_d: Who was your primary school teacher?

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Dr. Miller: We need to publish our clinical research findings before the international conference.
Assistant: But we haven't double-checked the patient control group data yet.
Dr. Miller: ----
Assistant: You are right; scientific accuracy must always come before haste.
option_a: Let's just ignore the errors and send it anyway.
option_b: Let's invite all patients to the meeting instead.
option_c: Why don't we cancel the entire project permanently?
option_d: I don't think conferences are useful for researchers.
option_e: Then let's take our time to verify it carefully; flawed data would ruin our reputation.
explanation: Asistanın "Doğru, bilimsellik aceleye feda edilemez" cevabıyla uyumlu cümle: "Hatalı veri itibarımızı sarsar, o yüzden dikkatle doğrulayalım" ifadesidir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Interviewer: Many artificial intelligence experts warn against unregulated algorithmic autonomy.
Professor: Indeed, ethical boundaries must be codified into international law.
Interviewer: ----
Professor: Precisely because algorithms trained on biased historical datasets can perpetuate systemic social discrimination without accountability.
option_a: How much does a supercomputer cost nowadays?
option_b: Do you prefer laptops or desktop computers?
option_c: Why do you think ethical regulation is so crucial at this stage?

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)

"No other mammal on Earth can match the remarkable speed of the cheetah."

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)

option_b: coincidence
option_c: solution
option_d: hesitation

"Solution to" yaygın bir kolokasyondur: bilim insanları su kıtlığına sürdürülebilir bir çözüm arıyor. "Disaster" felaket, "coincidence" tesadüf, "hesitation" tereddüt, "obstacle" engeldir ve bilim insanlarının aradığı şey olamaz.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)

option_d: make up for
