explanation: Hükümet yoğun diplomatik baskıya rağmen isyancıların taleplerini reddediyor; bu yüzden anlam "talepleri kabul etmek, boyun eğmek" olmalıdır. Bu anlamı "give in to" phrasal verbi verir. "Run out of" tükenmek, "call off" iptal etmek, "make up for" telafi etmek, "look down" aşağı bakmaktır ve "to" edatıyla anlam kurmaz.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: If humanity ---- carbon emissions significantly over the next decade, severe climate catastrophes ---- unavoidable.
option_a: will not reduce / became
option_b: would not reduce / had become
option_c: had not reduced / would become
option_d: does not reduce / will become
option_e: did not reduce / become
explanation: Geleceğe yönelik olası durumları belirten Type 1 Conditional yapısıdır: If + Present Simple, will + V1.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ---- facing extreme weather conditions and scarce supplies, the explorers managed to reach the South Pole safely.
option_a: Since
option_b: Unless
option_c: Despite
option_d: Because
option_e: Although
explanation: "Despite" edatı arkasından isim öbeği veya V-ing (facing ...) alarak zıtlık anlamı katar (-e rağmen).

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: By the time the new telescope was finally launched into space in 2021, astronomers ---- on its optical systems for over two decades.
option_a: will have been working
option_b: have worked
option_c: are working
option_d: were working
option_e: had been working
explanation: "By the time + Past Simple" kalıbı temel cümlede daha önceki süreçte devam eden eylemi bildirmek için Past Perfect Continuous (had been working) gerektirir.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Although the team practiced every single day for several months, ----.
option_a: their coach was extremely pleased with the victory
option_b: the supporters cheered enthusiastically after the trophy
option_c: everyone expected them to celebrate their triumph
option_d: they were unable to win the final championship match
option_e: they easily defeated all their rivals in the tournament
explanation: "Although" zıtlık bağlacıdır; her gün çok sıkı çalışmalarına rağmen final maçını kazanamadılar anlamı çelişkiyi mantıklı tamamlar.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: ----, historians still debate whether it was caused primarily by external invasions or internal economic collapse.
option_a: Unless trade routes are completely mapped out by modern researchers
option_b: As soon as archeological artifacts were discovered in the Mediterranean
option_c: Even though centuries have passed since the fall of the Western Roman Empire
option_d: If emperors had taken more decisive military measures against rebellions
option_e: Because ancient civilizations left very detailed written documents
explanation: Ana cümledeki 'tarihçiler hâlâ tartışıyor' ifadesini zaman zıtlığı bildiren 'üzerinden yüzyıllar geçmesine rağmen' ifadesi eksiksiz tamamlar.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Electric vehicles are becoming increasingly popular worldwide ----.
option_a: whereas charging stations are readily available in every single remote village
option_b: so that petrol-powered cars can maintain their dominance in the automotive sector
option_c: not only because they produce zero direct emissions but also because battery technologies have advanced rapidly
option_d: in case fossil fuel prices drop to their lowest historic levels
option_e: despite the fact that they are much cheaper than conventional bicycles
explanation: "Not only ... but also ..." kalıbıyla elektrikli araçların popülerleşme gerekçeleri (sıfır emisyon ve gelişmiş batarya) mantıksal olarak birbirini destekler.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"Artificial intelligence is transforming modern medical diagnosis by detecting diseases much earlier than traditional methods."
Cümlesinin en doğru Türkçe çevirisi aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Hastalıkları erken teşhis etmek amacıyla yapay zekâ tıbbi teşhis yöntemlerine entegre edilmektedir.
option_b: Modern tıbbi teşhis, yapay zekânın erken hastalık tespiti sayesinde tamamen değişmiştir.
option_c: Yapay zekâ, hastalıkları geleneksel yöntemlerden çok daha erken tespit ederek modern tıbbi teşhisi dönüştürmektedir.
option_d: Geleneksel yöntemler yerine yapay zekâ kullanıldığında hastalıklar çok daha erken tespit edilmektedir.
option_e: Yapay zekâ sadece erken hastalık teşhisi yaparak modern tıbbı dönüştürmeyi hedefler.
explanation: Özne 'Artificial intelligence' (Yapay zekâ), yüklem 'is transforming' (dönüştürmektedir), zarf 'by detecting ...' (tespit ederek). Tam karşılığı C seçeneğidir.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"Yenilenebilir enerji kaynaklarına yapılan yatırımlar, sadece çevre kirliliğini azaltmakla kalmaz, aynı zamanda yeni istihdam alanları da yaratır."
Cümlesinin en doğru İngilizce çevirisi aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Investments in renewable energy sources not only reduce environmental pollution but also create new employment opportunities.
option_b: Although renewable energy reduces pollution, it rarely creates new job opportunities.
option_c: Environmental pollution can be eliminated only when renewable energy investments create new jobs.
option_d: Creating new employment opportunities is as important as investing in renewable energy sources.
option_e: If we invest in renewable energy, environmental pollution will decrease and jobs will be preserved.
explanation: "Sadece ... kalmaz, aynı zamanda ..." bağlacı İngilizcede "not only ... but also ..." kalıbıdır. A seçeneği birebir ve eksiksiz karşılar.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
"Derin okyanus çukurlarında yaşayan organizmalar, güneş ışığından tamamen yoksun olmalarına ve aşırı basınca maruz kalmalarına rağmen hayatta kalmayı başarırlar."
Cümlesinin en doğru İngilizce çevirisi aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Because there is extreme pressure and no sunlight in deep ocean trenches, very few organisms can survive there.
option_b: Organisms living in deep ocean trenches manage to survive despite being completely deprived of sunlight and exposed to extreme pressure.
option_c: Although sunlight cannot reach the deep ocean, organisms create their own pressure to survive.
option_d: Deep ocean trenches are inhabited by organisms that cannot survive without sunlight and pressure.
option_e: Organisms in deep ocean trenches would survive if they were protected from extreme pressure and sunlight.
explanation: Özne 'Organisms living in deep ocean trenches', zıtlık 'despite being completely deprived of sunlight and exposed to extreme pressure', yüklem 'manage to survive'. A seçeneği kusursuz çeviridir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Honeybees play an irreplaceable role in global ecosystems by pollinating a vast variety of flowering plants, including many of the crops that humans rely on for food. However, in recent decades, bee populations have suffered dramatic declines due to habitat destruction, pesticide overuse, and climate fluctuations. Without intensive conservation efforts, the loss of these vital pollinators could destabilize both wild ecosystems and the global food supply chain.

According to the passage, the primary danger of declining honeybee populations is that ----.
option_a: it will immediately cause all flowering plants to go extinct next year
option_b: it could threaten the stability of natural ecosystems and human food security
option_c: pesticides will no longer be effective against agricultural pests
option_d: honey production will completely stop in developed countries
option_e: wild ecosystems will expand into agricultural territories
explanation: Metnin son cümlesinde belirtildiği üzere arıların azalması hem doğal ekosistemleri hem de küresel gıda zincirini (food security) tehdit etmektedir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Sleep is far from being a passive state of physical rest; rather, it is an active neurological process crucial for memory consolidation and emotional regulation. During deep and REM stages of sleep, the brain actively filters daytime information, discarding irrelevant noise while integrating critical experiences into long-term neural networks. Chronic sleep deprivation, therefore, not only impairs cognitive functions but also significantly increases vulnerability to mood disorders.

It can be inferred from the passage that lack of proper sleep ----.
option_a: has no measurable effect on long-term memory formation
option_b: causes the brain to become permanently passive during the daytime
option_c: is necessary for discarding irrelevant daytime memories
option_d: improves cognitive focus by reducing unnecessary REM stages
option_e: negatively impacts both mental processing capabilities and emotional well-being
explanation: Metinde uykusuzluğun bilişsel fonksiyonları zayıflattığı (cognitive functions) ve duygu durum bozukluklarına (mood disorders / emotional well-being) yatkınlığı artırdığı açıkça ifade edilmiştir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The discovery of exoplanets located within the habitable zones of distant star systems has revolutionized modern astrophysics. These 'Goldilocks zones' represent orbital distances where atmospheric pressures could theoretically sustain liquid water on a planetary surface—a prerequisite for life as we currently understand it. Nevertheless, planetary habitability is governed by a complex interplay of magnetic shields, atmospheric density, and stellar radiation, meaning that mere orbital distance offers no absolute guarantee of biological viability.

According to the passage, being situated in a star's habitable zone ----.
option_a: protects a planet completely from harmful stellar radiation and magnetic flares
option_b: guarantees that an exoplanet has an atmosphere identical to Earth's
option_c: proves that intelligent biological life forms already exist there
option_d: makes atmospheric pressure completely irrelevant for astrophysical research
option_e: is a necessary preliminary condition for liquid water, but not a sufficient proof of life on its own
explanation: Metinde yörünge mesafesinin sıvı su için ön şart olduğu, ancak tek başına biyolojik yaşamın garantisi olmadığı vurgulanmaktadır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Emily: I've been trying to learn Spanish on my own for two months, but I feel like I'm making no progress.
Carlos: ----
Emily: Actually, mostly memorizing grammar rules and vocabulary lists from a book.
Carlos: That explains it! You should start listening to podcasts and practicing with native speakers instead.
option_a: Why don't you give up and learn German instead?
option_b: Which Spanish grammar book is your personal favorite?
option_c: Have you ever traveled to Madrid or Barcelona before?
option_d: How much money did you pay for your online language tutor?
option_e: What kind of study methods have you been using so far?
explanation: Emily'nin 'Mostly memorizing grammar rules...' (Çoğunlukla kitaptan kural ezberleme) cevabına karşılık gelen en uygun soru 'Şimdiye kadar ne tür yöntemler kullandın?' sorusudur.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Doctor: Your test results show significant signs of chronic fatigue and elevated stress levels.
Patient: I know, doctor. I've been working twelve hours a day including weekends to meet project deadlines.
Doctor: ----
Patient: You're right. If I don't slow down now, my body will force me to stop later.
option_a: You should definitely take on more freelance assignments to stay productive.
option_b: I will prescribe a medication that allows you to work without needing any sleep.
option_c: No project deadline is worth sacrificing your permanent physical and mental health.
option_d: Your company should promote you to senior executive immediately.
option_e: Why didn't you finish the project three months ago?
explanation: Hastanın 'Haklısınız, tempomu düşürmezsem vücudum beni durduracak' onayına en uygun doktor uyarısı A seçeneğindeki 'Hiçbir teslim tarihi kalıcı sağlığınızı feda etmeye değmez' ifadesidir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Professor: The peer reviewers raised valid criticisms regarding the sample size in your thesis chapter.
Student: Does that mean the entire methodology needs to be revised from scratch?
Professor: ----
Student: That's a huge relief! I will expand the participant survey immediately.
option_a: The reviewers rejected your thesis completely and canceled your enrollment.
option_b: I haven't had the time to read the reviewers' detailed feedback yet.
option_c: Not at all. You just need to collect supplementary data to strengthen your statistical confidence.
option_d: Sample sizes are completely irrelevant in modern sociological research.
option_e: Yes, unfortunately you will have to discard all your findings and pick a new topic.
explanation: Öğrencinin 'That's a huge relief!' (Büyük bir rahatlama) tepkisi profesörün sıfırdan başlamaya gerek olmadığını, sadece ek veri toplamanın yeteceğini belirttiğini gösterir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"Had it not been for the prompt intervention of the firefighters, the historic library would have burned to the ground."
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: The firefighters were unable to prevent the historic library from burning down entirely.
option_b: Although the firefighters arrived very quickly, the historic library could not be saved.
option_c: The historic library was saved from complete destruction only because the firefighters acted quickly.
option_d: If the fire had started in the library, the firefighters would have arrived much sooner.
option_e: The historic library burned down because nobody called the fire department in time.
explanation: "Had it not been for ..." kalıbı 'olmasaydı' demektir; itfaiyenin hızlı müdahalesi olmasaydı kütüphane tamamen yanardı cümlesi, kütüphanenin sadece itfaiyecilerin hızlı davranması sayesinde kurtulduğunu ifade eder.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
You are hosting an international guest who politely declines a dish at dinner, mentioning they have a severe peanut allergy. As the host who cooked the meal with peanut oil, you need to warn them immediately and offer a safe alternative.
What do you say politely and urgently?
option_a: Thank you for letting me know! Please don't touch that dish as it was cooked with peanut oil; let me prepare a completely fresh, allergy-safe meal for you right away.
option_b: I am terribly offended that you refuse to eat what I cooked for you tonight.
option_c: Peanut allergies are usually psychological, so you can eat it safely.
option_d: Why didn't you bring your own food if you have such a dangerous allergy?
option_e: A little bit of peanut oil has never harmed anyone, so you should give it a try anyway.
explanation: Misafir fıstık alerjisi olduğunu söylemiş ve yemek fıstık yağıyla pişirilmiştir; ev sahibi hem tehlikeyi hemen bildirmeli hem de çözüm sunmalıdır. Uygun cümle önce teşekkür eder, yemeğe dokunmamasını söyler ve alerjiye uygun taze bir yemek hazırlamayı önerir. Diğerleri alerjiyi küçümser, suçlayıcıdır veya tehlikeli bir davranışı teşvik eder.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"No sooner had the research paper been published online than it sparked intense controversy among leading climate scientists."
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Climate scientists debated the paper for several years before it was finally published online.
option_b: The publication of the paper was delayed until all climate scientists reached a consensus.
option_c: Because the paper was highly controversial, the journal decided not to publish it on their website.
option_d: As soon as the research paper became available online, prominent climate scientists began debating it fiercely.
option_e: Only a few junior researchers expressed minor disagreements after reading the paper.
explanation: "No sooner ... than ..." kalıbı 'yapar yapmaz / olur olmaz' (as soon as) anlamı taşır. Makale yayımlanır yayımlanmaz bilim insanları arasında hararetli tartışma başladı anlamına gelir.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) The invention of the printing press by Johannes Gutenberg in the mid-15th century transformed European society forever. (II) Before movable type, books had to be copied by hand, making them rare luxuries restricted to monasteries and wealthy nobility. (III) Gutenberg's press made information widely accessible, accelerating the spread of scientific and philosophical ideas. (IV) Printing presses in the 19th century required steam power to operate at industrial speeds. (V) Consequently, literacy rates rose sharply across the continent, laying the groundwork for the Reformation and the Enlightenment.

Which numbered sentence disrupts the overall coherence of the paragraph?
option_a: V
option_b: IV
option_c: III
option_d: I
option_e: II
explanation: Paragraf Gutenberg'in 15. yüzyıldaki icadı ve Aydınlanma'ya etkisinden bahsederken IV. cümle zamansal akıştan koparak 19. yüzyıldaki buharlı baskı makinelerinden bahsetmekte ve anlam akışını bozmaktadır.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
Urban green spaces, such as public parks and rooftop gardens, offer far more than mere aesthetic appeal to metropolitan residents. They absorb atmospheric pollutants, mitigate the 'urban heat island' effect by cooling ambient air, and reduce rainwater runoff during heavy storms. ----. Recent sociological studies demonstrate that regular access to nature within city limits significantly lowers cortisol levels and enhances overall community well-being.

Which of the following best completes the paragraph?
option_a: In contrast, asphalt roads reflect sunlight and increase surrounding temperatures noticeably
option_b: However, constructing underground parking lots is much more cost-effective for municipal budgets
option_c: Moreover, these green areas provide critical psychological benefits by reducing daily stress and anxiety
option_d: Although park benches are expensive to maintain during freezing winter months
option_e: Therefore, city planners should eliminate all recreational zones in downtown districts
explanation: Paragraf çevre faydalarından psikolojik faydalara geçiş yapmaktadır; arkasından gelen sosyolojik stres araştırmasıyla E seçeneğindeki 'psikolojik faydalar' tam uyumludur.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Marine bioluminescence—the ability of oceanic organisms to generate visible light through biochemical reactions—serves diverse evolutionary functions. (II) In the pitch-black abyss, predators such as anglerfish employ glowing lures to attract unsuspecting prey directly toward their jaws. (III) Other creatures use sudden flashes of light as a defensive smokescreen to startle and blind potential attackers. (IV) Commercial fishing vessels often use high-powered electric lamps to attract squid to the surface at night. (V) Furthermore, certain deep-sea species rely on intricate light patterns to signal prospective mates in the vast darkness.

Which numbered sentence disrupts the overall coherence of the paragraph?
option_a: III
option_b: II
option_c: I
option_d: IV
option_e: V
explanation: Paragraf deniz canlılarının kendi vücutlarında biyolüminesans ışık üretmesinin evrimsel işlevlerini (avlanma, savunma, eşleşme) anlatırken, IV. cümle insanların balıkçı teknelerinde yapay elektrik lambası kullanmasından bahsederek akışı bozar.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Due to unexpected technical difficulties, the organizers decided to ---- the annual international conference until next spring.
option_a: accelerate
option_b: postpone
option_c: recommend
option_d: celebrate
option_e: establish
explanation: 'Postpone' ertelemek demektir. Cümlede teknik aksaklıklar sebebiyle konferansın ilkbahara ertelendiği anlatılmaktadır.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: The government launched an ambitious campaign to ---- poverty and improve healthcare infrastructure in rural areas.
option_a: stimulate
option_b: eradicate
option_c: fabricate
option_d: tolerate
option_e: neglect
explanation: 'Eradicate' kökünü kazımak, tamamen ortadan kaldırmak demektir ('eradicate poverty' yoksulluğu yok etmek).

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Scientists are working tirelessly to ---- an innovative solution that can efficiently filter microplastics out of drinking water reservoirs.
option_a: run out of
option_b: get away with
option_c: come up with
option_d: put up with
option_e: look down on
explanation: Bilim insanları içme suyu depolarındaki mikroplastikleri filtreleyecek yenilikçi bir çözümü ortaya çıkarmaya çalışıyor. "Come up with" (fikir, çözüm bulmak veya ortaya atmak) bu anlama uyar. "Get away with" yaptığı şeyin cezasından kurtulmak, "run out of" tükenmek, "put up with" katlanmak, "look down on" küçümsemek anlamındadır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: ---- the weather was extremely stormy and cold, thousands of dedicated fans arrived at the stadium to support their team.
option_a: Unless
option_b: Since
option_c: Although
option_d: Because
option_e: In case
explanation: Cümlede "hava çok fırtınalı ve soğuktu" ile "binlerce taraftar stada geldi" birbirine zıt bir ilişki kuruyor: beklenmeyen bir durum söz konusu. Zıtlık bağlacı "Although"tır (-e rağmen). "Unless" aksi takdirde, "Since" ve "Because" neden, "In case" ise önlem anlamı verir; bunlar cümlenin mantığına uymaz.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: By the time the rescue team finally ---- the remote mountain village, the volunteers ---- most of the damaged houses.
option_a: was reaching / have repaired
option_b: reached / had already repaired
option_c: reaches / would repair
option_d: has reached / will repair
option_e: had reached / repaired
explanation: "By the time + simple past" yapısında ana cümle past perfect olur, çünkü ana cümlenin eylemi diğerinden önce tamamlanmıştır. Burada kurtarma ekibi köye ulaştığında (reached) gönüllüler evlerin çoğunu onarmış olmalıdır (had already repaired). Diğer zaman kombinasyonları zaman uyumunu bozar.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Had the engineers inspected the bridge cables more thoroughly prior to the storm, the tragic collapse ----.
option_a: could have been prevented
option_b: had been prevented
option_c: was preventing
option_d: will be prevented
option_e: might prevent
explanation: Inversion Type 3 Conditional: 'Had they inspected...' yapısının ana cümlesi 'could/would have been V3' olur.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: ----, many developing countries are heavily investing in solar and wind farms to meet their rising energy demands.
option_a: Even though coal is completely harmless to the atmosphere
option_b: As long as electric vehicles are banned worldwide
option_c: Whereas renewable energy has proven to be completely ineffective
option_d: Despite having abundant petroleum reserves
option_e: In order to reduce their reliance on imported fossil fuels
explanation: 'İthal fosil yakıtlara olan bağımlılıklarını azaltmak amacıyla...' cümleyi anlamca ve mantıkça tamamlar.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: While regular physical exercise significantly boosts cardiovascular health and cognitive function, ----.
option_a: athletes rarely need to pay attention to their daily hydration
option_b: most physicians recommend avoiding all forms of physical activity
option_c: overtraining without sufficient rest can lead to chronic fatigue and muscle injuries
option_d: it is universally agreed that junk food provides the best nutrients
option_e: it guarantees that a person will never encounter any illness
explanation: 'While' zıtlık kurar: Egzersiz faydalı olmakla birlikte dinlenmeksizin aşırı antrenman kronik yorgunluk ve sakatlığa yol açabilir.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Archaeologists were astonished by the intricate craftsmanship of the golden artifacts discovered in the royal tomb, ----.
option_a: until all remaining relics were destroyed by modern erosion
option_b: which clearly indicated that the ancient civilization possessed advanced metallurgical techniques
option_c: because ancient societies had no access to any precious metals whatsoever
option_d: although no historical tools were ever utilized during that period
option_e: so the excavation had to be permanently cancelled by the committee
explanation: 'which' ile başlayan relative clause altından yapılmış eserlerin o medeniyetin gelişmiş metalurji tekniklerine sahip olduğunu kanıtladığını açıklar.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
'Artificial intelligence has begun to transform healthcare by assisting doctors in diagnosing complex diseases accurately.'
Bu cümlenin en doğru Türkçe çevirisi aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Sağlık sektörü, yapay zekânın doktorların yerini almasıyla birlikte tamamen değişmiştir.
option_b: Doktorlar yapay zekâ sayesinde karmaşık hastalıkları kolayca teşhis ederek sağlık sistemini değiştirmişlerdir.
option_c: Yapay zekâ sadece teşhis aşamasında değil tedavi sürecinde de doktorlara destek vermektedir.
option_d: Karmaşık hastalıkların teşhisinde yapay zekâ kullanımı tüm dünyada zorunlu hale gelmiştir.
option_e: Yapay zekâ, karmaşık hastalıkların doğru teşhis edilmesinde doktorlara yardımcı olarak sağlık hizmetlerini dönüştürmeye başlamıştır.
explanation: Özne: Yapay zekâ, Yüklem: dönüştürmeye başlamıştır, Zarf: yardımcı olarak. E seçeneği eksiksiz ve birebir karşılar.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
'Temiz içme suyuna erişim, temel bir insan hakkı olmasına rağmen dünya genelinde milyonlarca insan hâlâ bu kaynaktan yoksundur.'
Bu cümlenin en uygun İngilizce çevirisi hangisidir?
option_a: Clean water is a human right, but governments refuse to distribute it to millions of citizens.
option_b: If clean drinking water were a basic right, millions of individuals would not suffer from thirst.
option_c: Despite the abundance of fresh water, millions of people cannot afford to purchase it.
option_d: Because drinking water is essential, many people around the world demand access to clean sources.
option_e: Although access to clean drinking water is a fundamental human right, millions of people worldwide are still deprived of this resource.
explanation: 'Although access to clean drinking water is a fundamental human right, millions of people worldwide are still deprived of this resource' tam ve kusursuz çeviridir.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
'Bilim insanları, küresel ısınmanın deniz ekosistemleri üzerindeki yıkıcı etkilerini azaltmak için acil önlemler alınması gerektiğini ısrarla vurgulamaktadır.'
Bu cümlenin en doğru İngilizce dengi hangisidir?
option_a: Marine ecosystems have been destroyed by global warming, so scientists are taking urgent actions.
option_b: Scientists believe that preventing global warming is impossible without protecting all marine creatures.
option_c: Scientists persistently emphasize that urgent measures must be taken to mitigate the devastating effects of global warming on marine ecosystems.
option_d: Global warming causes severe damage to oceans, which scientists are trying to investigate thoroughly.
option_e: Unless urgent steps are taken immediately, marine ecosystems will completely disappear according to scientists.
explanation: 'persistently emphasize that urgent measures must be taken to mitigate the devastating effects...' cümlenin tam ve doğru karşılığıdır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Honeybees play an indispensable role in maintaining terrestrial ecosystems and agriculture. By transferring pollen between flowering plants, they enable the reproduction of countless crops, including apples, almonds, and berries. However, widespread pesticide usage, habitat destruction, and climate anomalies have severely threatened bee colonies worldwide, endangering global food security.
According to the passage, honeybees are crucial because ----.
option_a: their pollination activity enables the reproduction of numerous agricultural crops
option_b: their honey is the primary energy source for all mammals
option_c: they produce synthetic pesticides that protect plants from pests
option_d: they can thrive in any severe weather condition without human help
option_e: they are the only insect species capable of surviving in urban gardens
explanation: Metinde bal arılarının polen taşıyarak elma, badem vb. sayısız tarım ürününün üremesini sağladığı açıkça belirtilmiştir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Deep-sea trenches, plunging thousands of meters beneath the ocean surface, represent one of Earth's most extreme environments. Deprived of sunlight and subjected to crushing hydrostatic pressure, these regions were once assumed to be barren wastelands. Nevertheless, oceanographic expeditions have uncovered thriving communities of bizarre organisms that derive their sustenance not from photosynthesis, but from chemosynthesis fueled by mineral-rich hydrothermal vents.
It can be inferred from the passage that life in deep-sea trenches ----.
option_a: consists exclusively of photosynthetic algae and giant coral reefs
option_b: is identical to the biodiversity found in shallow coastal waters
option_c: relies on chemical energy rather than solar radiation for survival
option_d: was completely eradicated by human deep-sea mining activities
option_e: requires warm atmospheric air to sustain its metabolic processes
explanation: Parçada derin deniz canlılarının güneş ışığı (fotosentez) yerine hidrotermal bacalardan beslenen kemosentezle enerji sağladığı ifade edilmiştir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The Library of Alexandria was renowned as the intellectual pinnacle of the ancient Mediterranean world. Founded in the 3rd century BCE under the Ptolemaic dynasty, it sought to compile a universal collection of all human knowledge. Scribes were dispatched across known lands to purchase, copy, or confiscate scrolls from arriving merchant ships. Although popularized myth attributes its demise to a single catastrophic inferno, historical consensus suggests it suffered a gradual decline punctuated by multiple fires, political upheaval, and dwindling imperial patronage.
The author emphasizes that the destruction of the Library of Alexandria ----.
option_a: was the outcome of a prolonged decay and various crises rather than a single sudden blaze
option_b: had absolutely no impact on the development of Western philosophy
option_c: spared every single philosophical parchment preserved inside its walls
option_d: was thoroughly documented and prevented by Ptolemaic scholars
option_e: occurred intentionally during a foreign military invasion in modern times
explanation: Son cümlede kütüphanenin yok oluşunun tek bir yangın efsanesi yerine çoklu yangınlar, siyasi krizler ve azalan himayeyle kademeli bir çöküş olduğu vurgulanmıştır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Emma: Are you planning to attend the guest lecture on renewable energy tomorrow?
Liam: I really want to, but I have a major chemistry laboratory exam right after lunch.
Emma: ----
Liam: That would be fantastic! Please take comprehensive notes for me.
option_a: I forgot to register for the lecture as well.
option_b: Don't worry, I can share my detailed lecture notes and slides with you afterwards.
option_c: I don't think renewable energy is an interesting topic anyway.
option_d: The professor cancelled the lecture due to bad weather.
option_e: Then you should definitely skip your chemistry exam instead.
explanation: Liam'ın 'Harika olur! Lütfen benim için detaylı not al' cevabına en uygun teklif Emma'nın notlarını paylaşmayı önermesidir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Dr. Aris: Our recent clinical trial demonstrates that mindfulness meditation significantly lowers cortisol levels in chronic stress patients.
Journalist: That sounds promising. Does this mean meditation could completely replace prescribed psychiatric medications?
Dr. Aris: ----
Journalist: Understood. So it acts as a supportive lifestyle intervention rather than a standalone cure.
option_a: We have not analyzed any statistical data from our patients yet.
option_b: Not entirely; it serves as a complementary therapy alongside clinical treatment rather than a full substitute.
option_c: Mindfulness has no measurable influence on human biological hormones.
option_d: The research funding was terminated before we could reach any conclusion.
option_e: Yes, absolutely; pharmaceutical drugs are entirely obsolete now.
explanation: Gazetecinin 'Demek ki tek başına tedavi yerine destekleyici bir yaşam müdahalesi' çıkarımına Dr. Aris'in tamamlayıcı tedavi olduğunu söylemesi uyar.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Professor Vance: Notice how the author employs unreliable narration to mirror the protagonist's disintegrating mental equilibrium.
Student: But wouldn't an unreliable narrator alienate the readers and diminish their emotional investment in the plot?
Professor Vance: ----
Student: Ah, I see. By forcing us to decipher the truth ourselves, we become active participants in the narrative.
option_a: The author simply lacked the technical skill to construct a coherent plotline.
option_b: You are correct; most literary critics consider this technique a disastrous flaw.
option_c: The publisher forced the author to alter the original ending at the last minute.
option_d: Readers never pay attention to whether a narrator is trustworthy or not.
option_e: On the contrary, it compels the audience to engage more critically, questioning every perceived reality.
explanation: Öğrencinin 'Gerçeği kendimiz çözmek zorunda kalarak anlatının aktif katılımcısı oluyoruz' aydınlanması Profesörün 'Aksine, okuyucuyu eleştirel düşünmeye zorlar' cevabıyla örtüşür.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
'No other land mammal on the African continent can match the exceptional sprinting velocity of the cheetah.'
Cümlesine anlamca en yakın olan seçenek hangisidir?
option_a: The cheetah rarely uses its speed when hunting prey in the grasslands.
option_b: The cheetah is faster over short distances than any other land mammal found in Africa.
option_c: Many African mammals are able to outrun a cheetah over long distances.
option_d: Cheetahs are the largest and strongest predators inhabiting the African savannah.
option_e: Several carnivores in Africa can run at the exact same top speed as a cheetah.
explanation: 'Afrika kıtasındaki hiçbir kara memelisi çitanın olağanüstü sprint hızına erişemez' cümlesi çitanın Afrika'daki en hızlı kara memelisi olduğunu ifade eder.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
'Had the government not implemented stringent conservation quotas, several Atlantic fish stocks would have faced irreversible extinction.'
Cümlesine anlamca en yakın ifade hangisidir?
option_a: Fishermen voluntarily ceased all operations before the government could pass any quotas.
option_b: The strict quotas enforced by the government successfully prevented the permanent demise of various Atlantic fish species.
option_c: The government refused to regulate Atlantic commercial fisheries because stocks were abundant.
option_d: Atlantic fish populations went entirely extinct despite the implementation of conservation laws.
option_e: Stricter conservation measures caused severe economic damage to local marine ecosystems.
explanation: Type 3 if-clause: 'Hükümet sıkı koruma kotaları getirmeseydi balık türleri yok olacaktı' -> Kotalar sayesinde balık türlerinin yok olması engellendi.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
'Only by integrating renewable energy with cutting-edge carbon capture technologies can heavily industrialized nations hope to achieve carbon neutrality by 2050.'
Cümlesine anlamca en yakın seçenek hangisidir?
option_a: Unless major industrial powers combine green energy sources with advanced carbon capture, reaching net-zero emissions by 2050 will remain unachievable.
option_b: Neither renewable energy nor carbon capture will play any substantial role in future climate policy.
option_c: Carbon capture technologies have proven to be an unnecessary distraction from expanding wind power.
option_d: Renewable energy by itself is sufficient for industrial economies to eliminate all emissions prior to 2050.
option_e: Industrial nations have already fulfilled their 2050 climate targets without resorting to green energy.
explanation: 'Only by... can they hope to achieve...' = 'Unless they combine both, reaching net-zero will remain unachievable' (birebir şart ve anlam dengi).

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) The James Webb Space Telescope has revolutionized observational astrophysics since its deployment. (II) Operating primarily in the infrared spectrum, it can peer through dense cosmic dust clouds to view the earliest galaxies. (III) Its massive gold-coated beryllium mirror enables unprecedented light sensitivity. (IV) Commercial airline tickets have become significantly more expensive over the past decade due to fuel prices. (V) These groundbreaking capabilities allow astronomers to probe the atmospheric composition of distant exoplanets.
Numaralanmış cümlelerden hangisi parçanın anlam akışını bozmaktadır?
option_a: IV
option_b: V
option_c: III
option_d: I
option_e: II
explanation: Parça James Webb Uzay Teleskobu'nun astrofiziksel yeteneklerini anlatırken IV. cümlede uçak bileti fiyatlarından bahsedilerek akış bozulmuştur.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Urban green spaces, such as parks, botanical gardens, and rooftop forests, provide critical ecological benefits to modern metropolises. (II) They act as natural sponges, absorbing stormwater runoff and reducing the risk of urban flash floods. (III) Furthermore, tree canopies mitigate the urban heat island effect by shading concrete surfaces and cooling the air through evapotranspiration. (IV) Modern skyscrapers frequently feature underground parking facilities for corporate executives. (V) In addition to environmental advantages, accessible urban nature fosters psychological well-being and stress recovery among residents.
Parçanın anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
option_a: I
option_b: V
option_c: II
option_d: III
option_e: IV
explanation: Metin şehir parklarının ve yeşil alanların ekolojik/ruhsal faydalarından bahsederken IV. cümlede gökdelenlerin otoparklarından bahsedilmiştir.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
Bioluminescence—the production and emission of light by living organisms—is widespread across marine taxa. ----. Some organisms, like the anglerfish, utilize a glowing lure dangling near their jaws to entice unwary prey. Others, including certain squid and jellyfish species, emit blinding flashes of light or luminous clouds to startle and evade encroaching predators. In still other cases, counterillumination enables animals to match ambient downwelling sunlight, effectively cloaking their silhouettes from observers below.
Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere düşüncenin akışına göre hangisi getirilmelidir?
option_a: Most land animals have completely abandoned the ability to produce bioluminescent enzymes
option_b: Deep-sea creatures are completely blind and cannot perceive any wavelengths of visible light
option_c: Commercial fishing vessels rely heavily on bioluminescent bait to capture tuna
option_d: Photosynthesis is the sole biological process responsible for light emission in nature
option_e: This fascinating biochemical capability serves diverse evolutionary functions, ranging from hunting to defense and camouflage
explanation: Sonraki cümlelerde avlanma (lure), savunma (startle predators) ve kamuflaj (counterillumination) örnekleri sıralandığı için boşluğa bu çeşitliliği özetleyen E seçeneği gelmelidir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Due to rapid technological advancements, many traditional machines are becoming ---, which forces manufacturing plants to upgrade their equipment.
option_a: vital
option_b: ancient
option_c: permanent
option_d: obsolete
option_e: contemporary
explanation: Cümlede hızlı teknolojik gelişmeler nedeniyle birçok geleneksel makinenin 'artık kullanılmayan / modası geçmiş / işlevsiz' (obsolete) hale geldiği ve bu durumun fabrikaları ekipmanlarını yenilemeye zorladığı ifade edilmektedir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Space agencies hope that the newly launched observatory will --- invaluable data regarding distant galaxies and exoplanets.
option_a: provide
option_b: reject
option_c: destroy
option_d: postpone
option_e: neglect
explanation: Cümlede uzay ajanslarının yeni fırlatılan gözlemevinin uzak galaksiler ve ötegezegenler hakkında paha biçilmez veriler 'sağlamasını / sunmasını' (provide) umduğu belirtilmektedir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Because of dense fog covering the airport runways, the flight coordinator had to --- all morning departures until visibility improved.
option_a: carry out
option_b: give away
option_c: look into
option_d: call off
option_e: take after
explanation: Havalimanı pistlerini kaplayan yoğun sis nedeniyle uçuş koordinatörünün tüm sabah kalkışlarını görüş mesafesi düzelene kadar 'iptal etmek / ertelemek' (call off) zorunda kaldığı anlatılmaktadır.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: Although the scientific team encountered severe technical hurdles, they worked --- to deliver the prototype before the deadline.
option_a: vaguely
option_b: reluctantly
option_c: relentlessly
option_d: superficially
option_e: scarcely
explanation: 'Although' ile kurulan tezatlık yapısında, teknik engellere rağmen ekibin prototipi teslim etmek için 'aralıksız, durup dinlenmeksizin, gayretle' (relentlessly) çalıştığı belirtilmektedir. B: isteksizce, C: belirsizce, D: yüzeysel olarak, E: neredeyse hiç.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: While inspecting the ancient trade route, the archaeological survey team unexpectedly --- an intact marble sarcophagus buried under dune sands.
option_a: came across
option_b: turned down
option_c: broke into
option_d: fell behind
option_e: backed down
explanation: Antik ticaret yolunu incelerken arkeologların kumların altına gömülü bozulmamış bir mermer lahitle 'tesadüfen karşılaştığı / bulduğu' (came across) ifade edilmektedir. Turn down: reddetmek, break into: zorla girmek, fall behind: geride kalmak, back down: geri adım atmak.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: The long-term economic stability of arid agrarian settlements is heavily reliant --- sophisticated groundwater replenishment systems.
option_a: from
option_b: on
option_c: toward
option_d: into
option_e: with
explanation: 'Reliant on' kalıbı (dependent on / based on gibi) bir şeye bağımlı/dayalı olmayı ifade eder. Kurak tarım yerleşimlerinin istikrarının yeraltı suyu besleme sistemlerine dayalı olduğu belirtilmektedir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: The unabated accumulation of microplastic particles in marine food webs exerts a profoundly --- impact on apex predator fertility and cellular integrity.
option_a: plausible
option_b: redundant
option_c: detrimental
option_d: frivolous
option_e: negligible
explanation: Mikroplastiklerin birikiminin yırtıcıların doğurganlığı ve hücresel bütünlüğü üzerinde 'zararlı / yıkıcı' (detrimental) bir etki yarattığı ifade edilmektedir. Plausible: makul, redundant: gereksiz/fazlalık, frivolous: ciddiyetsiz/boş, negligible: göz ardı edilebilir.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: To effectively mitigate catastrophic wildfires, forestry commissions must --- proactive controlled burn protocols and brush removal initiatives.
option_a: back out of
option_b: rule out
option_c: put up with
option_d: embark on
option_e: do away with
explanation: Orman komisyonlarının yangınları hafifletmek için proaktif kontrollü yakma protokollerine ve çalı temizleme girişimlerine 'başlaması / girişmesi' (embark on) gerektiği belirtilmektedir. Rule out: elemek/hariç tutmak, put up with: katlanmak, do away with: yürürlükten kaldırmak/ortadan kaldırmak, back out of: caymak/vazgeçmek.

topic_name: Kelime Bilgisi (Vocabulary, Phrasal Verbs & Prepositions)
question_text: There exists an overwhelming --- within the peer-reviewed climatology literature that anthropogenic aerosol and greenhouse emissions are driving polar amplification.
option_a: discrepancy
option_b: contradiction
option_c: ambiguity
option_d: deficiency
option_e: consensus
explanation: İklim bilimi literatüründe sera gazlarının kutupsal ısınmayı tetiklediği konusunda ezici bir 'fikir birliği / uzlaşı' (consensus) bulunduğu ifade edilmektedir. Discrepancy: tutarsızlık/çelişki, contradiction: tezat, deficiency: eksiklik, ambiguity: belirsizlik.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: By the time the rescue team reached the remote valley, local villagers --- all stranded mountaineers.
option_a: had already evacuated
option_b: will evacuate
option_c: are evacuating
option_d: have evacuated
option_e: evacuate
explanation: 'By the time + Past Simple' (reached) yapısı, o andan daha önce tamamlanan bir geçmiş eylemi ifade etmek için Past Perfect (had already evacuated) gerektirir.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Students --- enter the chemical research laboratory without protective eyewear and laboratory coats, as strict safety protocols apply.
option_a: might
option_b: must not
option_c: could
option_d: would
option_e: should have
explanation: Kesin yasaklama ve güvenlik kuralı bildirildiğinde 'must not' (girmemelidir / girmesi yasaktır) kullanılır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: --- the weather was unusually cold and windy, thousands of runners completed the annual charity marathon.
option_a: Because
option_b: In case
option_c: Since
option_d: Although
option_e: Unless
explanation: Havanın olağanüstü soğuk ve rüzgarlı olmasına rağmen binlerce koşucunun maratonu tamamladığı zıtlık ilişkisi 'Although' (-e rağmen) bağlacı ile sağlanır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: The ancient manuscripts --- during the recent archaeological excavation in Cappadocia date back to the fourth century AD.
option_a: discovering
option_b: to discover
option_c: discovered
option_d: having discovered
option_e: being discovering
explanation: 'The ancient manuscripts (which were) discovered...' yapısında kısaltma (participle reduction) edilgen olduğu için Past Participle olan 'discovered' (keşfedilen) kullanılır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Had the structural engineers --- the micro-fractures in the aqueduct earlier, the historic collapse during the tremor could have been averted.
option_a: identified
option_b: identify
option_c: identifying
option_d: to identify
option_e: been identified
explanation: Devrik Type 3 koşul cümlesidir (Inverted Conditional: 'Had + Subject + V3'). 'If the engineers had identified...' yapısı 'Had the structural engineers identified...' şeklinde devrilir.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Electric cars produce zero tailpipe emissions while running; ---, their comprehensive ecological footprint depends significantly on how regional electricity is generated.
option_a: consequently
option_b: moreover
option_c: therefore
option_d: for instance
option_e: however
explanation: İlk cümlede elektrikli araçların egzoz emisyonu üretmediği olumlu yönü, noktalı virgülden sonra ise çevresel ayak izinin elektriğin nasıl üretildiğine bağlı olduğu zıtlığı verilir. Bu geçişi 'however' (ancak / bununla birlikte) sağlar.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Benthic hydrothermal organisms are believed --- specialized physiological pathways millions of years before terrestrial life emerged.
option_a: to develop
option_b: to have developed
option_c: developing
option_d: to be developed
option_e: having developed
explanation: 'Subject + be believed + to infinitive' yapısında, inanılan durum geçmişte tamamlanmış bir süreci ('millions of years before') anlattığı için Perfect Infinitive olan 'to have developed' kullanılır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Scarcely had the bilateral armistice treaty been signed --- artillery skirmishes erupted once again along the disputed border.
option_a: than
option_b: when
option_c: as soon as
option_d: while
option_e: so
explanation: 'Scarcely / Hardly ... when' ve 'No sooner ... than' kalıpları zaman zıtlığı ve ardışıklık bildirir. 'Scarcely had + S + V3 ... when + S + V2' kuralına göre doğru bağlaç 'when'dir.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)
question_text: Judging by the colossal thickness of basaltic deposits across the plateau, the volcanic eruption --- immensely more violent than earlier geologic models assumed.
option_a: should have been
option_b: might not be
option_c: must have been
option_d: would rather be
option_e: could be
explanation: Geçmişe yönelik güçlü kanıta dayalı kesin çıkarım (past deduction) yapıldığında 'must have + V3' (olmuş olmalı / kesinlikle öyleydi) kullanılır. Bazalt tabakasının devasa kalınlığı geçmişteki patlamanın modellerden çok daha şiddetli olduğunu kanıtlamaktadır.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: ---, many modern universities now provide flexible evening and online degree programs.
option_a: Because campus lecture halls were permanently closed
option_b: In order to accommodate working professionals
option_c: While students strictly prefer written examinations
option_d: Although tuition fees were completely eliminated
option_e: Unless candidates fail their secondary school exams
explanation: Üniversitelerin esnek akşam ve online programlar sunmasının gerekçesi 'çalışan profesyonellere imkan sağlamak amacıyla' (In order to accommodate working professionals) ifadesidir.

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Unless agricultural irrigation techniques are modernized within this decade, ---.
option_a: farmers had harvested record amounts of wheat last summer
option_b: regional aquifers will suffer irreversible depletion
option_c: rainfall averages remained exceptionally high
option_d: water reservoirs were overflowing across the country
option_e: cities would not face any drinking water shortages
explanation: 'Unless + Present' (sulama teknikleri modernize edilmedikçe) şartına bağlı gelecekteki olumsuz sonuç Main Clause'da Future Simple ile verilir: 'bölgesel akiferler geri döndürülemez bir tükeniş yaşayacaktır' (regional aquifers will suffer irreversible depletion).

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Rooftop solar panels are becoming increasingly widespread in residential neighborhoods ---.
option_a: because they substantially cut household utility bills and carbon footprints
option_b: although coal-fired plants are much cleaner to operate
option_c: so that city councils banned renewable installations
option_d: while sunshine is completely absent throughout the summer
option_e: until electricity consumption reached zero everywhere
explanation: Çatı güneş panellerinin yaygınlaşmasının mantıksal nedeni 'ev faturalarını ve karbon ayak izini önemli ölçüde düşürmeleridir' (because they substantially cut household utility bills and carbon footprints).

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: While neuroscientists have mapped numerous localized regions of the cerebral cortex, ---.
option_a: the exact neural mechanisms underlying conscious perception remain largely elusive
option_b: they had successfully cured all cognitive impairments decades ago
option_c: conscious thoughts are completely understood by clinicians today
option_d: brain imaging technologies were invented in the eighteenth century
option_e: because memory consolidation occurs exclusively during deep sleep
explanation: 'While' (iken / -e karşın) zıtlık bildirir: Nörobilimciler beyin kabuğunun birçok bölgesini haritalandırmış olmalarına rağmen, bilinçli algının altında yatan kesin mekanizmalar hâlâ büyük ölçüde gizemini korumaktadır (remain largely elusive).

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)
question_text: Although synthetic antibiotics saved countless lives and transformed medicine in the twentieth century, ---.
option_a: bacterial strains have completely lost the capability to evolve
option_b: their pervasive overuse has accelerated the emergence of drug-resistant pathogens
option_c: they were synthesized prior to the discovery of any bacterial infections

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The ancient Silk Road was not merely a single paved highway, but rather an intricate network of overland trade routes connecting East Asia with the Mediterranean basin. For over a millennium, merchants transported silk, spices, porcelain, and precious stones across treacherous mountain passes and deserts. Crucially, alongside commercial commodities, the Silk Road served as a dynamic conduit for ideas, scientific knowledge, artistic styles, and religious philosophies.

According to the passage, the Silk Road is primarily characterized as ---.
option_a: a single well-maintained paved military highway built by the Romans
option_b: a complex network of routes that facilitated both trade and cultural exchange
option_c: a maritime shipping lane operating exclusively during summer months
option_d: an isolated mountain pass that prevented interaction between distant empires
option_e: a short-lived economic initiative that collapsed due to desert storms
explanation: Parçada İpek Yolu'nun tek bir yol değil, Doğu Asya ile Akdeniz'i birbirine bağlayan, ticaret mallarının yanı sıra fikirleri ve sanatı da taşıyan karmaşık bir rotalar ağı ('an intricate network of overland trade routes... served as a dynamic conduit for ideas') olduğu belirtilmiştir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Sleep is far from being a passive period of dormancy; rather, it is a highly active physiological state essential for survival. While an individual is asleep, the brain reorganizes and consolidates newly acquired memories, transferring short-term information from the hippocampus into the long-term storage of the neocortex. Concurrently, the glymphatic system clears out cellular metabolic waste, including beta-amyloid proteins that accumulate during waking hours.

We can understand from the passage that during sleep, the brain ---.
option_a: completely shuts down all metabolic and neurological processes
option_b: ceases communication between the hippocampus and neocortex
option_c: erases all information acquired during the preceding day
option_d: produces higher levels of harmful beta-amyloid toxins
option_e: actively processes memories and flushes out metabolic waste products
explanation: Metinde uykunun pasif bir dinlenme olmadığı, beynin anıları pekiştirip düzenlediği ve hücresel atıkları (beta-amiloid gibi) temizlediği ifade edilmektedir ('actively processes memories and flushes out metabolic waste products').

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Bioluminescence, the emission of visible cold light by living organisms through biochemical reactions, is predominantly a marine phenomenon. In the perpetual darkness of the deep ocean, where sunlight fails to penetrate beyond two hundred meters, over three-quarters of pelagic animals produce their own illumination. Creatures employ this adaptation for diverse survival strategies: the anglerfish dangles a glowing lure to attract unsuspecting prey, while certain squid species emit flashes to disorient predators or use counterillumination to camouflage against faint downwelling light.

According to the passage, marine organisms utilize bioluminescent light to ---.
option_a: generate internal heat to survive freezing ocean waters
option_b: absorb ultraviolet radiation from distant stars
option_c: communicate exclusively with photosynthetic surface algae
option_d: replace all biochemical digestive enzymes in their stomachs
option_e: serve multiple ecological purposes including hunting, camouflage, and predator deterrence
explanation: Metinde canlıların bu ışığı avlanma (av çekme), kamuflaj (counterillumination) ve avcıları şaşırtma gibi çeşitli hayatta kalma amaçları için kullandığı açıkça açıklanmıştır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The Neolithic Agricultural Revolution represents arguably the most profound socio-economic transformation in human prehistory. Beginning roughly twelve thousand years ago in the Fertile Crescent, nomadic hunter-gatherer bands began domesticating wild cereals and ungulates. Sedentary village life allowed for food surpluses, which in turn spurred rapid demographic expansion, craft specialization, and stratified social hierarchies. However, early farmers often experienced greater infectious disease burdens and nutritional deficiencies than their foraging forebears.

The author implies that the transition from foraging to sedentary farming ---.
option_a: brought immediate and unmitigated health benefits to all early human populations
option_b: was an effortless process that occurred simultaneously across all continents
option_c: entailed significant biological trade-offs despite enabling complex social structures
option_d: caused an immediate collapse in global human population levels
option_e: prevented the emergence of specialized professions and social divisions
explanation: Metinde yerleşik tarıma geçişin artılarına (nüfus artışı, uzmanlaşma, hiyerarşi) karşın, erken çiftçilerin daha fazla bulaşıcı hastalık ve beslenme yetersizliği çektiği ('greater infectious disease burdens and nutritional deficiencies') belirtilerek, karmaşık toplumsal yapılara olanak sağlamasına rağmen biyolojik bedelleri de olduğu (significant biological trade-offs) ima edilmektedir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Urban heat islands (UHIs) represent a pronounced microclimatic anomaly wherein metropolitan areas experience substantially higher surface and atmospheric temperatures than their rural peripheries. This thermal disparity stems from the pervasive replacement of permeable vegetative canopies with impervious, dark-colored asphalt and concrete surfaces possessing high thermal mass. Furthermore, anthropogenic waste heat generated by vehicular combustion and air conditioning units exacerbates the effect. To counteract this escalating phenomenon, urban climatologists advocate for passive architectural interventions, including high-albedo reflective roofs and vegetated bioswales.

It is pointed out in the passage that urban heat islands are exacerbated primarily when ---.
option_a: rural peripheries plant excessive deciduous forests around city limits
option_b: natural vegetation is displaced by dense artificial materials and waste heat is discharged
option_c: reflective roof coatings are mandatorily installed on all skyscrapers
option_d: atmospheric winds completely stop blowing across oceanic coastal plains
option_e: subway networks replace surface automobiles in metropolitan centers
explanation: Metinde kentsel ısı adalarının bitki örtüsünün yerini asfalt ve beton gibi koyu ve geçirimsiz yüzeylerin alması ve araçlardan/klimalardan kaynaklanan yapay atık ısının salınmasıyla şiddetlendiği açıkça belirtilmiştir.
