Patient: What steps should I take to restore them to healthy ranges?

Doctor: ---
option_a: You should stop consuming any iron-rich nutrients immediately.
option_b: I will prescribe an iron supplement, and you should also eat more dark leafy vegetables and legumes.
option_c: Fatigue is purely psychological, so medical intervention is unnecessary.
option_d: I suggest running twenty kilometers every single morning without rest.
option_e: You must stay hospitalized for six months without leaving bed.
explanation: Demir düşüklüğüne bağlı yorgunluk şikayetinde doktorun yapacağı uygun ve tıbbi tavsiye: Demir takviyesi yazıp koyu yeşil yapraklı sebzeler ve baklagiller tüketmesini önermektir (B seçeneği).

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Emre: Did you see that the municipality is constructing twenty kilometers of protected bike paths downtown?

Can: That's excellent news! It will encourage far more commuters to leave their cars at home.

Emre: ---

Can: Exactly, fewer motor vehicles on the road will significantly reduce air pollution and gridlock.
option_a: Yes, and it will make daily cycling both much safer and faster during peak hours.
option_b: I believe bicycles are far too dangerous to ever be allowed in cities.
option_c: That is why everybody should buy diesel SUVs instead.
option_d: Nobody in this city has ever learned how to balance on two wheels.
option_e: Cyclists should pay heavy road taxes before using public streets.
explanation: Can'ın 'Exactly, fewer motor vehicles on the road will significantly reduce air pollution...' tepkisiyle uyumlu olan, bisiklet sürmeyi daha güvenli ve hızlı hale getireceğini söyleyen A seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Professor: Your term paper on renewable energy transitions is well-argued, but your conclusion lacks actionable policy recommendations.

Student: ---

Professor: That would be ideal. Add a comparative case study showing how feed-in tariffs in northern Europe stimulated private solar adoption.
option_a: Can I simply replace my bibliography with arbitrary internet blogs?
option_b: Does that mean I should delete the entire theoretical framework?
option_c: Why did you penalize my grade without reading the introduction?
option_d: Should I incorporate specific economic incentive frameworks to ground my final proposals?
option_e: Is there really any relationship between government policy and green technology?
explanation: Profesörün 'That would be ideal. Add a comparative case study showing how feed-in tariffs... stimulated private solar adoption' yanıtı, öğrencinin 'Son önerilerimi somutlaştırmak için belirli ekonomik teşvik çerçeveleri eklemeli miyim?' (D seçeneği) sorusuna doğrudan bir cevaptır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Zeynep: I love the convenience of smart home speakers, but I'm worried about sensitive personal conversations being intercepted.

Burak: ---

Zeynep: That's somewhat reassuring, but users should still make sure to change default administrative credentials immediately.
option_a: Smart gadgets never connect to the internet, so interception is physically impossible.
option_b: You are completely right; all consumer audio feeds are streamed publicly on the internet.
option_c: We should disconnect from the electrical grid entirely and live in caves.
option_d: Most reputable manufacturers utilize end-to-end encryption and push automated security patches to safeguard data.
option_e: Cybersecurity firms never monitor vulnerabilities in consumer electronics.
explanation: Zeynep'in 'That's somewhat reassuring, but users should still make sure...' (Bu bir nebze rahatlatıcı ama yine de...) demesi, Burak'ın güvenlik önlemlerinden (uçtan uca şifreleme ve otomatik yamalar) bahsedip onu rahatlattığını gösterir (D seçeneği).

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Archaeologist A: These ceramic vessel fragments discovered in the lower stratum display decorative motifs identical to Aegean wares.

Archaeologist B: ---

Archaeologist A: Not necessarily. Petrographic clay analysis reveals they were made using local river sediments, indicating cultural diffusion rather than direct importation.
option_a: So you assume they were imported as finished luxury items via maritime trading routes?
option_b: Does that mean the lower stratum belongs to the twentieth-century modern period?
option_c: Why would anyone care what chemical minerals are contained in ancient mud?
option_d: That proves Aegean artisans never shared artistic techniques with coastal Anatolia.
option_e: Surely no ancient community ever traded pottery with neighboring regions.
explanation: Arkeolog A'nın 'Not necessarily... indicating cultural diffusion rather than direct importation' (Şart değil... doğrudan ithalattan ziyade kültürel yayılmayı gösteriyor) cevabı, B'nin 'Yani onların deniz ticaretiyle bitmiş lüks eşyalar olarak ithal edildiğini mi varsayıyorsun?' (A seçeneği) sorusuna doğrudan yanıttır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Economist: Developing nations heavily reliant on raw mineral exports face chronic fiscal volatility whenever international commodity prices fluctuate.

Journalist: What macro-prudential measures can these economies enact to insulate public budgets against such downturns?

Economist: ---

Journalist: So establishing sovereign wealth funds alongside industrial diversification provides a vital stabilization cushion.
option_a: By establishing counter-cyclical sovereign funds during boom periods and channeling capital into domestic manufacturing sectors.
option_b: They must shut down all extraction facilities immediately and sever all international commercial ties.
option_c: Relying on unregulated short-term foreign borrowing is the sole method to balance national accounts.
option_d: Eliminating all environmental regulations will automatically prevent global commodity price crashes.
option_e: Printing excessive fiat currency during recessions solves all fiscal imbalance issues without inflation.
explanation: Gazetecinin 'So establishing sovereign wealth funds alongside industrial diversification provides a vital stabilization cushion' özetine kaynaklık eden ifade Ekonomistin 'fiyatların yüksek olduğu dönemlerde döngü karşıtı varlık fonları kurmak ve yerli üretime sermaye aktarmak' önerisidir (A seçeneği).

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Curator: Some purists argue that utilizing digital reconstruction overlays on damaged Renaissance frescoes compromises their historical authenticity.

Restorer: ---

Curator: Precisely; as long as the digital modifications remain non-invasive and reversible, they foster pedagogical comprehension without endangering the physical plaster.
option_a: Historical authenticity is an obsolete concept that conservators should ignore entirely.
option_b: I agree completely; museums should discard damaged historic paintings and replace them with contemporary prints.
option_c: Yet non-contact digital projections enable viewers to appreciate the lost pigments without physically altering the delicate substrate.
option_d: Why should anyone care about Renaissance pigments when generative software can invent new art?
option_e: Damaged frescoes ought to be completely repainted with modern high-gloss acrylic paints.
explanation: Küratörün 'Precisely; as long as the digital modifications remain non-invasive and reversible...' (Kesinlikle; dijital müdahaleler invaziv olmayıp tersine çevrilebilir olduğu sürece...) onayı, Restoratörün 'Temassız dijital projeksiyonlar hassas yüzeyi fiziksel olarak değiştirmeden kayıp pigmentleri görmeyi sağlar' görüşüne (C seçeneği) onay vermektedir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Software Lead: Transitioning our monolithic backend into autonomous microservices will streamline team deployments, but it drastically expands architectural complexity.

Chief Architect: ---

Software Lead: Absolutely; without distributed tracing and automated container orchestration, diagnosing inter-service network latencies would become an intractable nightmare.
option_a: We should abandon modern computing paradigms altogether and execute all workflows on a single mainframe.
option_b: Which is why establishing end-to-end telemetry and observability infrastructure must precede any service decomposition.
option_c: Architectural complexity is purely imaginary and never causes performance degradation in cloud servers.
option_d: Why should engineers monitor network latency when consumer devices have unlimited memory?
option_e: Microservices operate flawlessly without requiring any logging or monitoring frameworks whatsoever.
explanation: Yazılım liderinin 'dağıtık izleme (distributed tracing) ve otomatik orkestrasyon olmadan gecikmeleri teşhis etmenin kabus olacağı' vurgusu, Baş Mimarın 'Hizmetleri parçalamadan önce uçtan uca telemetri ve gözlemlenebilirlik (observability) altyapısının kurulması gerektiği' uyarısını tamamlar (B seçeneği).

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: No other desert on Earth receives less annual precipitation than the Atacama Desert in northern Chile.
option_a: The Atacama Desert in northern Chile receives more rain than most other deserts on Earth.
option_b: The Atacama Desert in northern Chile is the driest desert on Earth in terms of annual precipitation.
option_c: Many deserts in the southern hemisphere are considerably drier than northern Chile's Atacama.
option_d: Annual rainfall in northern Chile is fairly distributed across all its desert territories.
option_e: The Atacama Desert was once the wettest region on Earth before recent climate shifts.
explanation: Cümle 'Dünya'daki hiçbir çöl kuzey Şili'deki Atacama Çölü'nden daha az yıllık yağış almaz' demektir. Bu da Atacama'nın yıllık yağış açısından dünyanın en kurak çölü olduğu anlamına gelir (B seçeneği).

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: Your friend accidentally closed a vital assignment document an hour before the submission deadline without saving local edits and is in tears. Knowing that their cloud word processor automatically archives previous revision histories, what reassuring and practical advice do you offer?
option_a: You should write a furious email accusing your instructor of setting an unfair deadline.
option_b: Don't panic; just open the version history tab on your cloud account, as it automatically saves previous drafts.
option_c: Accept that your academic semester is completely ruined and drop out immediately.
option_d: Why didn't you buy a typewriter instead of trusting modern computers?
option_e: You had better restart the entire thirty-page paper from scratch right now.
explanation: Arkadaşın panik içindeyken bulut kelime işlemcisinin otomatik sürüm geçmişi (version history) kaydettiğini bilerek sakinleştirici ve pratik öneri B seçeneğinde verilmiştir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: Although electric vehicles command a higher initial purchase price, their lifetime maintenance and fueling expenses are significantly lower than conventional cars.
option_a: Both electric and conventional automobiles require identical expenditure for routine mechanical servicing.
option_b: Electric vehicles are more expensive to buy upfront, but they yield substantial savings on fuel and maintenance over their lifespan.
option_c: The initial cost of an electric vehicle is so high that fuel savings never offset the initial expense.
option_d: Conventional cars cost far less to maintain and refuel throughout their lifespans than electric vehicles.
option_e: Consumers prefer conventional cars exclusively because electric vehicles have higher lifetime costs.
explanation: İlk cümlenin anlamı: Elektrikli araçlar başlangıçta daha yüksek satın alma fiyatına sahip olsa da, kullanım ömrü boyunca bakım ve yakıt giderleri geleneksel araçlara kıyasla çok daha düşüktür. B seçeneği bu anlamı tam olarak karşılar.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: Had the tech startup carried out a rigorous market viability analysis prior to releasing the wearable gadget, they would not have incurred such catastrophic financial losses.
option_a: The tech startup incurred catastrophic financial losses because they neglected to conduct a thorough market viability analysis before launching their gadget.
option_b: Even though the tech startup conducted a comprehensive market viability study, their gadget still failed commercially.
option_c: The gadget's commercial success was largely due to the rigorous market viability analysis carried out beforehand.
option_d: Conducting a market viability analysis caused the tech startup to lose immense amounts of capital.
option_e: Had the startup avoided launching any gadget, market analysts would have criticized their financial timidity.
explanation: 'Had the startup carried out... they would not have incurred...' (Type 3 conditional) cümlesi, girişimin cihazı piyasaya sürmeden önce pazar analizini yapmadığını ve bu yüzden felaket boyutunda mali kayıplar yaşadığını ifade eder (A seçeneği).

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: You are chairing an academic symposium panel, and the first speaker has overrun their allotted twenty minutes by ten minutes, encroaching on other presenters' scheduled times. How do you intervene politely yet firmly to keep the session on track?
option_a: Please stop speaking right now; your presentation is extremely boring and uninformative.
option_b: Thank you for these stimulating insights, Professor; however, to ensure our remaining panelists have adequate time, I must kindly ask you to conclude your remarks.
option_c: I will cancel all remaining presentations so you can continue lecturing for the rest of the afternoon.
option_d: Why didn't you rehearse your presentation yesterday to avoid humiliating yourself today?
option_e: The conference organizers should have chosen someone far more disciplined than you to deliver this talk.
explanation: Oturum başkanı olarak diğer konuşmacıların vaktini korumak için nezaketle ama kararlılıkla araya girmek B seçeneğindeki profesyonel üslupla mümkündür.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: The rapid dissemination of antimicrobial resistance among nosocomial pathogens underscores the imperative need to formulate novel therapeutic interventions.
option_a: Because hospital pathogens are rapidly becoming resistant to existing antimicrobials, it is vitally essential to develop innovative treatment strategies.
option_b: Nosocomial infections have decreased substantially thanks to the widespread availability of synthetic antibiotics.
option_c: Developing new antimicrobial treatments is unnecessary since hospital pathogens rarely acquire resistance.
option_d: Pathogens in healthcare settings have become completely harmless due to strict sanitation protocols.
option_e: Novel therapeutic interventions are solely responsible for accelerating antibiotic resistance in hospitals.
explanation: Hastane patojenleri arasında antimikrobiyal direncin hızla yayılması yeni tedavi müdahaleleri geliştirmenin zorunluluğunu vurgulamaktadır cümlesinin en yakın anlamı A seçeneğidir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: Rarely does a foundational scientific paradigm shift materialize through an isolated breakthrough; rather, it reflects the cumulative synthesis of incremental empirical observations across decades.
option_a: Major scientific paradigm shifts are almost always triggered by sudden, solitary discoveries rather than long-term research.
option_b: Foundational shifts in scientific paradigms seldom stem from a single discovery, emerging instead from the gradual accumulation of empirical evidence over decades.
option_c: Empirical observations gathered over decades rarely contribute to changing established scientific models.
option_d: Isolated breakthroughs are the only reliable mechanisms through which scientific paradigms undergo transformation.
option_e: Because scientific paradigms never shift, incremental observations are of little utility to researchers.
explanation: Cümle: Temel bir bilimsel paradigma değişimi nadiren tek bir izole buluşla gerçekleşir; bunun yerine onlarca yıl boyunca biriken kademeli ampirik gözlemlerin sentezini yansıtır. B seçeneği bu cümlenin birebir anlamca en yakın yeniden ifadesidir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: You are leading a mission-critical financial software deployment. On the eve of launch, your QA engineer detects a subtle flaw that could expose user banking data. Postponing the launch will draw severe ire from corporate executives, but deploying it risks catastrophic security breaches. What do you assertively communicate to the executive steering board?
option_a: Everything is running flawlessly, so let us deploy on schedule and pretend we never found any defect.
option_b: While deferring tomorrow's launch will cause inconvenience, releasing software with an active data vulnerability exposes us to unacceptable legal and security liabilities; thus, we must postpone until it is fully resolved.
option_c: I blame our QA team entirely and suggest terminating their employment contracts immediately.
option_d: Executive stakeholders do not understand technical architecture, so their input is entirely irrelevant.
option_e: Data breaches are routine in our industry, so there is no reason to delay our marketing timeline.
explanation: Lider olarak veri açığı riskinin kabul edilemez olduğunu, lansmanın ertelenmesi rahatsızlık yaratsa dahi yasal ve güvenlik sorumlulukları nedeniyle ertelemenin zorunlu olduğunu kararlı ve profesyonel bir şekilde ifade eden seçenek B'dir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text: Had international commitments to decarbonization and afforestation been instituted in the late twentieth century, the irreversible destabilization of polar cryospheric systems would not be looming with such terrifying imminence.
option_a: Even if nations had committed to afforestation decades ago, polar ice sheets would still be destabilizing at the exact same rate.
option_b: Polar cryospheric systems are currently stabilizing because twentieth-century decarbonization goals were implemented on time.
option_c: Because global efforts toward decarbonization and reforestation were delayed in the twentieth century, the irreversible collapse of polar ice sheets is now approaching with alarming speed.
option_d: The irreversible melting of polar ice is entirely unrelated to carbon emissions or twentieth-century industrial policy.
option_e: International agreements in the twentieth century succeeded in reversing all threats to polar glaciers.
explanation: Geçmişte (20. yüzyıl sonlarında) karbonsuzlaşma ve ağaçlandırma taahhütleri hayata geçirilmiş olsaydı kutup buzullarının geri dönüşsüz istikrarsızlaşması bu kadar ürkütücü bir yakınlıkla yaklaşmazdı. Yani bu adımlar geciktiği için kutup buzullarının çöküşü endişe verici bir hızla yaklaşmaktadır (C seçeneği).

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
In constitutional democracies, judicial review acts as a vital counter-majoritarian safeguard against legislative and executive overreach. By striking down statutory enactments that violate constitutional rights, apex courts insulate vulnerable minorities against the transient impulses of electoral majorities. ---. If supreme tribunals come to be regarded as partisan political actors rather than impartial arbiters of fundamental jurisprudence, the moral legitimacy of the entire constitutional order erodes.

Which of the following sentences best completes the paragraph?

explanation: Boşluktan sonraki 'If supreme tribunals come to be regarded as partisan political actors... the moral legitimacy... erodes' cümlesi, yargı denetiminin kamusal tarafsızlık algısına ve güvene dayandığını belirten A seçeneğindeki 'However, the institutional authority of judicial review depends fundamentally upon public trust in judicial impartiality...' ifadesini doğrudan tamamlar.

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
(I) Common-pool ecological resources are non-excludable yet subtractable, rendering them acutely susceptible to overexploitation by uncoordinated self-interested actors. (II) Classical resource economics long posited that without centralized governmental coercion or private property titles, the depletion of shared fisheries and pastures was mathematically unavoidable. (III) Blockchain cryptocurrencies utilize decentralized proof-of-work protocols to validate financial ledger transactions. (IV) However, political economist Elinor Ostrom challenged this pessimism by demonstrating that local communities frequently cultivate enduring, self-organized governing regimes. (V) Her empirical fieldwork revealed that clear collective boundaries, graduated sanctions, and communal trust can effectively avert resource collapse without external imposition.

Which of the numbered sentences in the passage disrupts the coherence of the text?
option_a: I
option_b: II
option_c: III
option_d: IV
option_e: V
explanation: Paragraf ortak kaynakların trajedisi (tragedy of the commons) ve Elinor Ostrom'un topluluk temelli sürdürülebilir yönetim bulgularını anlatırken, III numaralı cümle kripto para ve blokzincir madenciliğinden bahsederek metnin konusunu ve bütünlüğünü bozmaktadır.

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)

topic_name: Dilbilgisi (Grammar: Tenses, Modals, Passive, Conjunctions)

topic_name: Cloze Test ve Cümle Tamamlama (Sentence Completion)

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)

option_c: Teknolojinin iş gücü piyasalarını altüst etmesi sonucunda hükümetler yaşam boyu mesleki eğitim girişimlerini proaktif olarak başlatmıştır.
option_d: Geleneksel iş gücü piyasaları teknolojik dönüşümle sarsılırken hükümetlerin proaktif eğitim girişimleri bu değişimi belirlemektedir.
option_e: Yaşam boyu eğitimin hükümetlerce proaktif şekilde desteklenmesi, geleneksel istihdamın teknoloji karşısında korunmasını sağlayacaktır.
explanation: "The extent to which... depends largely on how proactively..." (ne ölçüde değiştireceği, büyük ölçüde ... ne kadar proaktif şekilde uyguladığına bağlıdır) yapısı A seçeneğinde kusursuz çevrilmiştir.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Antik uygarlıkların çöküşünü yalnızca iklim anomalilerine bağlamak, karmaşık sosyo-politik hiyerarşilerin ve içsel çatışmaların belirleyici rolünü göz ardı etmek anlamına gelir.

Yukarıdaki cümlenin İngilizce çevirisi aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: If historians attribute the fall of ancient civilizations solely to climatic events, socio-political dynamics will be completely forgotten.
option_b: Climatic anomalies were not the only cause of civilizational collapse, as internal political conflicts played an equally decisive role.
option_c: Ancient civilizations collapsed primarily due to climate shifts rather than complicated socio-political internal hierarchies.
option_d: Attributing internal socio-political collapse solely to ancient climatic variations overlooks the decisive role of historical civilizations.
option_e: Attributing the collapse of ancient civilizations solely to climatic anomalies amounts to disregarding the decisive role of complex socio-political hierarchies and internal conflicts.
explanation: "Attributing ... solely to ... amounts to disregarding ..." (bağlamak, ... göz ardı etmek anlamına gelir) tam eşleşmedir.

topic_name: İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce Çeviri (Translation)
question_text:
Far from being an isolated artistic phenomenon, Renaissance humanism emerged as the intellectual culmination of centuries of cross-cultural Mediterranean trade and scholarly exchange.

Yukarıdaki cümlenin Türkçe çevirisi aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Rönesans hümanizmi münferit bir sanat hareketi olmak yerine, Akdeniz ticaretinin yüzyıllar boyu süren akademik etkileşiminden doğmuştur.
option_b: Akdeniz'deki kültürlerarası ticaret ve bilimsel alışveriş, Rönesans hümanizmini izole bir sanatsal olay olmaktan çıkarmıştır.
option_c: Rönesans hümanizmi, yalıtılmış bir sanatsal olgu olmak şöyle dursun, yüzyıllar süren kültürlerarası Akdeniz ticaretinin ve ilmi alışverişinin entelektüel zirvesi olarak ortaya çıkmıştır.
option_d: Yüzyıllarca süren Akdeniz ticareti ve ilmi etkileşimi olmasaydı, Rönesans hümanizmi münferit bir sanatsal hareket olarak kalırdı.
option_e: Entelektüel bir doruk noktası olan Rönesans hümanizmi, Akdeniz ticaret havzasındaki sanatsal etkileşimlerin bir ürünüdür.
explanation: "Far from being..." (yalıtılmış bir sanatsal olgu olmak şöyle dursun...), "intellectual culmination..." (entelektüel zirvesi olarak ortaya çıkmıştır) çevirisi C'de tastamam yansıtılmıştır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Honeybees communicate the location of rich nectar sources through a sophisticated movement pattern known as the 'waggle dance'. By adjusting the angle and duration of the dance relative to the sun, a returning forager bee precisely informs her nestmates about the direction and distance of the food patch. This remarkable behavior allows the colony to exploit floral resources across several square kilometers with exceptional collective efficiency.

According to the passage, the waggle dance performed by honeybees -----.
option_a: is primarily used to defend the hive against invasive predatory insects
option_b: causes significant confusion among young bees about where nectar is located
option_c: can only be performed during overcast days when the sun is not visible
option_d: conveys accurate data regarding both the direction and distance of nectar sources
option_e: is an aggressive behavior intended to establish dominance within the colony
explanation: Metinde "precisely informs her nestmates about the direction and distance of the food patch" ifadesi D seçeneğindeki bilgiyi doğrudan doğrulamaktadır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Sleep deprivation exerts profound detrimental effects on the human brain, particularly impairing the prefrontal cortex, which governs executive function, decision-making, and emotional regulation. When individuals fail to obtain seven to eight hours of restorative sleep, their cognitive reaction times slow down dramatically, and their susceptibility to mood swings increases substantially.

It is clearly stated in the passage that insufficient sleep -----.
option_a: improves cognitive reaction speeds by stimulating adrenaline release
option_b: negatively impacts the brain region responsible for executive functions and emotional balance
option_c: has no measurable effect on emotional regulation or daily decision-making
option_d: is recommended by physicians to strengthen the prefrontal cortex
option_e: only affects elderly people who suffer from chronic memory loss
explanation: Metinde uykusuzluğun yönetici işlevler ve duygu kontrolünü yöneten prefrontal korteksi bozduğu ("impairing the prefrontal cortex, which governs executive function... and emotional regulation") açıkça belirtilmiştir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Before the invention of Johannes Gutenberg's movable type printing press in the mid-15th century, books in Europe were painstakingly copied by hand by scribes and monks. Consequently, books were luxury items accessible only to wealthy aristocrats and high-ranking ecclesiastical officials. Gutenberg's breakthrough democratized knowledge by making book production drastically faster and far more economical.

One can infer from the passage that prior to Gutenberg's invention, -----.
option_a: printing machinery was already widely accessible across ordinary European households
option_b: monks and scribes refused to produce any religious or philosophical manuscripts
option_c: literary and scholarly texts were prohibitively expensive and scarce for ordinary citizens
option_d: aristocrats preferred oral storytelling over handwritten luxury manuscripts
option_e: knowledge was freely and equally distributed among all social classes
explanation: Metne göre Gutenberg öncesinde kitaplar elle kopyalandığı için yalnızca zengin aristokrat ve din adamlarının erişebildiği lüks eşyalardı; yani sıradan insanlar için son derece pahalı ve kıttı.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Deep beneath the ocean surface, hydrothermal vents support unique biological ecosystems completely independent of solar energy. Instead of relying on sunlight for photosynthesis, primary producers in these abyss environments—chemosynthetic bacteria—oxidize hydrogen sulfide emitted by geothermal fissures to generate organic compounds. These bacteria form the trophic foundation for bizarre endemic organisms, such as giant tube worms and vent crabs.

Which of the following can be concluded about hydrothermal vent ecosystems?
option_a: They rely directly on solar energy penetrating through deep oceanic layers.
option_b: Endemic species like tube worms synthesize their own food without bacterial symbiosis.
option_c: Their food webs are fundamentally sustained by chemical synthesis rather than sunlight.
option_d: Rising sea temperatures have completely extinguished all chemosynthetic bacteria around vents.
option_e: Photosynthetic marine plants dominate the bottom tier of their energy pyramids.
explanation: Metinde kemosentetik bakterilerin güneş ışığı yerine hidrojen sülfürü oksitleyerek organik madde ürettiği, yani besin zincirinin fotosentez yerine kemosenteze dayandığı vurgulanmıştır.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The psychological phenomenon known as the 'bystander effect' demonstrates that an individual's likelihood of intervening in an emergency decreases significantly when other passive onlookers are present. Psychologists attribute this inhibition primarily to diffusion of responsibility: each bystander assumes that someone else will take corrective action, resulting in collective paralysis.

According to the passage, the bystander effect occurs because onlookers -----.
option_a: are genetically predisposed to hostility toward injured strangers
option_b: genuinely enjoy witnessing public catastrophes without intervening
option_c: are strictly forbidden by civil legislation from helping victims
option_d: lack the physical strength required to render any basic assistance
option_e: believe that the moral obligation to assist is shared among all observers present
explanation: "diffusion of responsibility: each bystander assumes that someone else will take corrective action" ifadesi, sorumluluğun diğerlerine dağıldığı inancını (E seçeneği) açıklar.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
While urban vertical farming offers alluring promises—such as ninety percent less water consumption and year-round pesticide-free crop cultivation—critics emphasize substantial economic obstacles. The exorbitant capital expenditure required for artificial LED lighting systems and specialized climate-controlled facilities often renders vertically produced vegetables far more expensive than conventionally farmed produce.

The author of the passage points out that vertical farming -----.
option_a: requires significantly more water than traditional open-field agriculture
option_b: has failed to produce any edible vegetables under laboratory conditions
option_c: is fully subsidized by all municipal governments to lower retail prices
option_d: faces notable financial hurdles due to elevated infrastructure and lighting costs
option_e: poses grave environmental dangers due to excessive pesticide contamination
explanation: Metinde dikey tarımın LED aydınlatma ve iklimlendirme tesisleri sebebiyle yüksek sermaye harcamaları ve ekonomik engellerle karşılaştığı belirtilmektedir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
Epigenetic research has dismantled the simplistic dichotomy of nature versus nurture by demonstrating that environmental factors—such as dietary habits, toxic pollutant exposure, and chronic psychosocial trauma—can alter gene expression without modifying the underlying genomic nucleotide sequence. Chemical tags added to DNA molecules can effectively silence or activate specific loci, and some evidence even suggests that certain induced epigenetic alterations can be transgenerationally transmitted to progeny.

It can be inferred from the passage that epigenetics -----.
option_a: bridges the divide between genetics and environment by showing how external stimuli regulate gene activation without mutating DNA codes
option_b: proves that environmental exposures have zero impact on how genes function in living organisms
option_c: requires complete irreversible alterations of the fundamental nucleotide base sequences of DNA
option_d: has invalidated all prior evolutionary discoveries made by classical Mendelian genetics
option_e: demonstrates that psychological trauma is exclusively inherited through mitochondrial DNA
explanation: Metin, epigenetiğin doğa-çevre ikiliğini yıkarak çevresel faktörlerin DNA dizilimini değiştirmeden gen ifadesini nasıl düzenlediğini ve hatta sonraki nesillere aktarılabileceğini ortaya koyduğunu vurgular.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
In linguistic anthropology, the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis posits that the structural architecture of a particular language fundamentally constrains and shapes the cognitive perception and world-view of its native speakers. While radical linguistic determinism—the assertion that language strictly imprisons thought—has been largely discredited by cognitive scientists, a moderate version termed linguistic relativity remains robustly defended, showing that grammatical categorizations subtly influence how individuals memorize spatial relations and classify color spectra.

The passage suggests that contemporary cognitive scientists -----.
option_a: generally reject absolute linguistic determinism while acknowledging that language subtly steers perceptual habits
option_b: unanimously endorse the strict view that thought is completely impossible without articulate speech
option_c: have completely discarded both the strong and weak formulations of the Sapir-Whorf hypothesis
option_d: argue that color perception is identical across all human languages regardless of cultural vocabulary
option_e: claim that spatial memorization is purely determined by genetic factors rather than linguistic frameworks
explanation: Metinde radikal dilsel determinizmin (dil düşünceyi hapseder iddiası) çürütüldüğü, ancak ılımlı göreliliğin (dilin algısal alışkanlıkları ince biçimde etkilemesi) kabul gördüğü belirtilmektedir.

topic_name: Okuma Parçaları ve Anlam Çıkarma (Reading Comprehension)
question_text:
The concept of 'creative destruction', popularized by economist Joseph Schumpeter, conceptualizes capitalism as an inherently restless evolutionary process wherein innovative breakthroughs continually mutate the economic structure from within, relentlessly destroying outdated enterprises and birthing novel industries. Thus, according to Schumpeterian dynamics, periodic corporate failures and macroeconomic volatility are not pathologies to be entirely eradicated, but rather the essential price paid for long-term technological and standard-of-living advancement.

According to Schumpeter's theory of creative destruction, business insolvencies and economic disruption -----.
option_a: represent catastrophic institutional failures that governments must prevent at all costs
option_b: stem exclusively from malicious monopolistic practices orchestrated by foreign cartels
option_c: prevent innovative technologies from entering domestic commercial markets
option_d: serve as an indispensable byproduct of the innovation that drives long-term prosperity
option_e: are the primary indicators of irreversible civilizational decay and moral decline
explanation: Metinde batışların ve dalgalanmaların yok edilmesi gereken bir hastalık değil, uzun vadeli teknolojik ilerleme ve refahın zorunlu bedeli (vazgeçilmez yan ürünü) olduğu ifade edilmektedir.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Elena: Have you decided which university department you want to apply to for your undergraduate studies?
Liam: I am torn between Environmental Engineering and Marine Biology. Both sound fascinating to me.
Elena: ----- 
Liam: You're right. Reviewing the course syllabus and career prospects for each will definitely give me clarity.
option_a: I don't think you should bother attending university at all.
option_b: My brother graduated from law school and makes a lot of money.
option_c: Neither of those subjects has anything to do with scientific research.
option_d: You should immediately drop out of high school and start working.
option_e: Why don't you examine the detailed curriculum and alumni employment rates of both fields?
explanation: Liam'ın "Ders müfredatını ve kariyer olanaklarını incelemek kesinlikle netlik kazandıracaktır" cevabı Elena'nın E seçeneğindeki önerisiyle mükemmel uyum sağlar.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Doctor: Your blood tests look generally healthy, but your vitamin D level is significantly below normal.
Patient: Really? I try to eat a balanced diet with lots of vegetables and dairy products.
Doctor: ----- 
Patient: I see. Since I work long hours in a windowless office, I rarely get any direct sunlight during weekdays.
option_a: Dairy products completely block your body from absorbing calcium.
option_b: You need to immediately undergo extensive emergency heart surgery.
option_c: Diet alone is often insufficient, as our primary source of vitamin D is direct sun exposure on the skin.
option_d: Drinking plenty of tap water will instantly cure all vitamin deficiencies.
option_e: You should never walk outside during daytime hours to avoid allergies.
explanation: Hastanın penceresiz ofiste çalıştığı için güneş ışığı alamadığını belirtmesi, doktorun D vitamininin ana kaynağının güneş ışığı olduğunu söylemesine (C seçeneği) doğrudan cevaptır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Sophie: Our neighborhood community garden project is struggling because very few residents have volunteered to water the plants during weekends.
Mark: ----- 
Sophie: That's a great idea! Setting up a simple online shared schedule will ensure everyone takes turns fairly.
option_a: We should pour concrete over the entire garden and turn it into a parking lot.
option_b: Plants don't actually need water during weekends if it rains once a year.
option_c: I don't care about the community garden because I don't live here.
option_d: You should punish anyone who refuses to work twelve hours every Sunday.
option_e: What if we create a rotating digital roster so each family is responsible for just one weekend a month?
explanation: Sophie'nin paylaşılan online çizelge fikrini övmesi, Mark'ın ailelerin sırayla nöbetleşeceği dijital bir nöbet çizelgesi önermesiyle (E seçeneği) tam örtüşür.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Professor Davis: I noticed you didn't include any primary historical sources in your term paper on the Industrial Revolution.
Student: Well, I found several recent textbooks and peer-reviewed journal articles that synthesized the era quite well.
Professor Davis: ----- 
Student: Point taken. I will visit the university archives tomorrow to examine the original factory inspection records and parliamentary testimonies.
option_a: Textbooks are always superior to archival manuscripts because they have colored illustrations.
option_b: You must completely delete your paper and choose an entirely different century to write about.
option_c: While secondary analyses are helpful, engaging with original archival documents is essential for authentic historical scholarship.
option_d: I never assign primary sources because students cannot read nineteenth-century handwriting.
option_e: Your grade is already finalized, so there is no point in revising your bibliography.
explanation: Öğrencinin arşivdeki orijinal fabrika denetim kayıtlarını inceleyeceğini söylemesi, profesörün birincil kaynakların vazgeçilmezliğini vurgulamasıyla (C seçeneği) uyumludur.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Arthur: Did you see the latest report on consumer habits? E-commerce sales grew by another thirty percent this quarter.
Claire: Yes, but physical brick-and-mortar stores aren't disappearing entirely; they're evolving.
Arthur: In what way do you think they're adapting?
Claire: -----
option_a: They have simply stopped selling goods and locked their doors permanently.
option_b: They are demanding that the government prohibit all online commercial transactions.
option_c: By firing all staff and converting stores into automated postal warehouses.
option_d: Online shopping will completely vanish within the next three months anyway.
option_e: By offering experiential retail, such as interactive showrooms and personalized customer workshops that the internet cannot replicate.
explanation: Fiziksel mağazaların internetin sunamayacağı etkileşimli showroomlar ve kişisel atölyeler gibi deneyimsel perakendeciliğe evrilmesi mantıksal açıklamadır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Journalist: Some critics argue that self-driving autonomous vehicles will never be completely foolproof.
Tech Executive: No technology is infallible, but human drivers currently cause millions of preventable fatalities annually due to distraction and impairment.
Journalist: ----- 
Tech Executive: Exactly. The ultimate goal isn't miraculous perfection, but drastically reducing preventable human carnage on highways.
option_a: So you admit that autonomous technology has completely failed to demonstrate any safety benefits?
option_b: So your contention is that even an imperfect autonomous system can still be significantly safer than an error-prone human?
option_c: Why don't we immediately outlaw all motorized vehicles and return to horse-drawn carriages?
option_d: Distracted driving has never been proven to correlate with vehicular collision statistics.
option_e: Governments have already decided to ban artificial intelligence from transportation systems.
explanation: Yöneticinin "Aynen öyle. Nihai hedef mucizevi mükemmellik değil, önlenebilir ölümleri çarpıcı biçimde azaltmaktır" onayı, B seçeneğindeki soruya doğrudan karşılıktır.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Dr. Vance: I'm concerned about our team's proposal to rely exclusively on large language models for synthesising biomedical clinical trials.
Dr. Aris: But the automated models process thousands of oncology papers in seconds, whereas human meta-analysis takes months.
Dr. Vance: ----- 
Dr. Aris: True. A synthetic hallucination in a clinical dosage recommendation could have catastrophic patient safety repercussions.
option_a: I agree completely, so let's disband our research laboratory immediately.
option_b: Speed is always vastly superior to scientific accuracy when dealing with human pharmacology.
option_c: Speed is meaningless if the model invents plausible-sounding citations or glosses over contradictory statistical anomalies.
option_d: Oncology studies rarely contain complex statistical data that require human discernment.
option_e: Language models have achieved divine omniscient understanding across all medical domains.
explanation: Dr. Aris'in "Doğru. Klinik dozaj tavsiyesinde yapay bir halüsinasyon vahim sonuçlar doğurabilir" cevabı, Dr. Vance'in modelin inandırıcı uydurmalar (hallucination) yapabileceği uyarısına (C seçeneği) işaret eder.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Curator: Our museum board is deliberating whether to repatriate several bronzes acquired during colonial punitive expeditions in the late nineteenth century.
Historian: Many European institutions fear that returning looted artefacts will set an uncontainable precedent that empties Western galleries.
Curator: ----- 
Historian: Precisely. Restitution isn't about cultural self-depletion; it's about establishing ethical reciprocity and collaborative provenance research.
option_a: We should hide the bronzes in a secret subterranean vault so nobody discovers their origins.
option_b: Colonial conquests were completely lawful under ancient codes, so ethics shouldn't matter.
option_c: Public museums have no moral obligations toward source communities whatsoever.
option_d: Every single ancient sculpture in Europe was acquired through military plunder.
option_e: Yet that slippery-slope argument ignores that moral legitimacy in the modern era requires acknowledging and rectifying historical expropriation.
explanation: Tarihçinin "Precisely. Restitution isn't about cultural self-depletion; it's about establishing ethical reciprocity..." onayı, küratörün 'kaygan zemin' argümanının modern ahlaki meşruiyeti ve tarihi haksızlıkları düzeltmeyi göz ardı ettiğini belirtmesiyle (E seçeneği) birebir örtüşür.

topic_name: Karşılıklı Konuşma / Diyalog Tamamlama (Dialogue)
question_text:
Economist A: The central bank should swiftly tighten monetary policy and raise interest rates to suppress lingering inflationary expectations.
Economist B: Doing so prematurely might push an already sluggish industrial sector into an outright balance-sheet recession.
Economist A: ----- 
Economist B: I acknowledge the danger of entrenched price spirals, but an overly hawkish overshoot carries equal risks of protracted unemployment.
option_a: Manufacturing output always increases dramatically whenever central banks hike interest rates.
option_b: Interest rates have zero correlation with macroeconomic inflation or industrial output.
option_c: You clearly don't understand the basic definitions of fiscal deficit and monetary supply.
option_d: The central bank has already decided to abolish all interest rates permanently next week.
option_e: However, if inflation becomes entrenched in wage negotiations, unseating it later will require far more draconian and painful contractions.
explanation: Ekonomist B'nin "Fiyat sarmalının kemikleşmesi tehlikesini kabul ediyorum fakat..." demesi, Ekonomist A'nın enflasyonun ücret pazarlıklarına yerleşmesi durumunda daha sert tedbirler gerektireceğini savunmasıyla (E seçeneği) tam uyumludur.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"No other artist of the Renaissance influenced European landscape painting as profoundly as Leonardo da Vinci did with his atmospheric perspective techniques."

Yukarıdaki cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Leonardo da Vinci was influenced by many Renaissance painters who utilized atmospheric perspective.
option_b: Atmospheric perspective was invented by various European artists long before Leonardo da Vinci was born.
option_c: Leonardo da Vinci had a greater impact on European landscape painting than any other Renaissance artist through his atmospheric perspective techniques.
option_d: European landscape painting rejected Leonardo da Vinci's innovative atmospheric perspective methods.
option_e: Renaissance artists agreed that landscape painting was the least significant genre of visual art.
explanation: Cümle Leonardo da Vinci'nin hiçbir sanatçının yapamadığı ölçüde derin bir etki yarattığını ifade eder; C seçeneği bu anlamı birebir karşılar.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
You are organizing a team meeting at work, but one colleague consistently arrives fifteen minutes late, disrupting the opening announcements. You want to address the issue politely but firmly without embarrassing them in front of the entire group. Privately, you say:

Duruma en uygun ifade hangisidir?
option_a: "You are the most unprofessional person in this company, and I will make sure you are fired immediately!"
option_b: "It doesn't matter when you show up because nobody listens to the meeting announcements anyway."
option_c: "I have decided to cancel all future meetings because you clearly hate waking up in the morning."
option_d: "Could you please yell loudly whenever you enter the room so everyone knows you are late?"
option_e: "I've noticed you've had trouble making it on time recently. Our opening updates are critical, so I'd really appreciate it if you could arrive promptly."
explanation: Durumda geç kalan bir meslektaşa, onu başkalarının önünde utandırmadan ama kararlı bir şekilde sorun anlatılacaktır. Uygun cümle gözlemi nazikçe belirtir ("I've noticed you've had trouble making it on time"), önemi gerekçelendirir ve rica eder. Diğer seçenekler hakaret, ilgisizlik, ceza veya alay içerir; yapıcı ve saygılı değildir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"Had the rescue team not arrived with specialized thermal equipment within an hour, the stranded mountaineers would certainly have succumbed to hypothermia."

Yukarıdaki cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: The stranded mountaineers survived hypothermia even though the rescue team took several days to locate them.
option_b: The prompt arrival of the rescue team with specialized thermal gear within an hour prevented the mountaineers from dying of hypothermia.
option_c: The rescue team forgot their thermal equipment, so the mountaineers unfortunately suffered fatal frostbite.
option_d: Mountaineers rarely experience hypothermia when stranded for less than an hour in sub-zero blizzards.
option_e: Although the rescue team arrived immediately, the specialized thermal equipment proved completely defective.
explanation: Kurtarma ekibinin termal ekipmanla bir saat içinde ulaşması dağcıların hipotermiden ölmesini engellemiştir (B seçeneği).

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"It was not until quantum mechanics emerged in the early twentieth century that physicists began to comprehend the dual wave-particle nature of subatomic radiation."

Yukarıdaki cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Physicists had already fully mastered the wave-particle duality of radiation long before the birth of quantum mechanics.
option_b: The emergence of quantum mechanics in the twentieth century disproved the wave-particle nature of subatomic particles.
option_c: Twentieth-century physicists refused to accept quantum mechanics because subatomic radiation behaved strictly as particles.
option_d: Early twentieth-century physicists comprehended subatomic radiation without relying on quantum mechanical principles.
option_e: Only after the development of quantum mechanics in the early twentieth century did physicists start understanding that subatomic radiation exhibits both wave and particle characteristics.
explanation: "It was not until ... that ..." (ancak ... sonra ... başladı) kalıbının eş anlamlısı "Only after ... did physicists start understanding ..." ifadesidir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
Your close friend has been invited to give a keynote presentation at a major academic symposium. She is experiencing severe stage fright and doubts her expertise. To bolster her self-confidence while acknowledging her genuine achievements, you say:

Duruma en uygun ifade hangisidir?
option_a: "You should definitely cancel your speech immediately before you humiliate yourself in front of international scholars."
option_b: "Why did you accept the invitation if you knew you couldn't handle public pressure?"
option_c: "I agree that you are unqualified, but maybe everyone in the audience will fall asleep anyway."
option_d: "Public speaking is terrifying, and most presenters end up fainting on stage."
option_e: "Remember how much groundbreaking work you've put into this research; you are genuinely an authority in this field, and the audience will be lucky to hear you."
explanation: Arkadaş büyük bir akademik toplantıda konuşma yapacak ve sahne korkusuyla kendi yetkinliğinden şüphe ediyor. Güven verici cevap, emeğini ve uzmanlığını teslim eden ve dinleyicilerin onu dinlemekten memnun olacağını söyleyen cümledir. Diğerleri konuşmayı iptal etmeyi önerir, onu suçlar, korkutur veya yetersiz olduğunu söyler; destekleyici değildir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"Despite having vastly fewer financial resources than its competitors, the small biotech startup successfully patented an effective mRNA malaria vaccine candidate first."

Yukarıdaki cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: The biotech startup failed to secure the patent because rival corporations invested billions in mRNA research.
option_b: Financial resources are the sole determining factor in whether a pharmaceutical enterprise can patent an mRNA vaccine.
option_c: Because it possessed superior capital, the small biotech firm easily outpaced other corporations in vaccine development.
option_d: Although operating with considerably less capital than its rivals, the small biotech company managed to be the first to patent a viable mRNA malaria vaccine candidate.
option_e: The small biotech firm merged with wealthier competitors before developing its mRNA malaria vaccine.
explanation: "Despite having vastly fewer financial resources..." karşıtlığı D seçeneğindeki "Although operating with considerably less capital... managed to be the first..." ile tam olarak örtüşür.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"Seldom do legislative reforms achieve their intended socioeconomic outcomes unless supported by rigorous institutional enforcement and broad civic compliance."

Yukarıdaki cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Institutional enforcement and civic compliance are rarely necessary once a legislative reform is officially passed into statutory law.
option_b: Without robust institutional enforcement and widespread public adherence, statutory reforms rarely produce the socioeconomic results they were designed to deliver.
option_c: Civic compliance invariably guarantees that legislative reforms will meet all socioeconomic targets even when law enforcement institutions fail.
option_d: Legislative reforms are almost always successful regardless of whether public citizens cooperate with governing institutions.
option_e: Broad civic compliance tends to undermine the socioeconomic effectiveness of rigorous institutional reforms.
explanation: "Seldom do reforms achieve their intended outcomes unless supported by..." (kurumsal yaptırım ve sivil uyum olmadıkça yasal reformlar nadiren hedeflenen sonucu verir) ifadesi B seçeneğinde tam olarak verilmiştir.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
You are a university dean speaking to an academic committee. A wealthy donor has offered a substantial endowment to build a state-of-the-art laboratory, but the agreement includes an unacceptable clause requiring the donor's personal veto over scientific research topics. To articulate the university's principled rejection diplomatically yet unyieldingly, you state:

Duruma en uygun ifade hangisidir?
option_a: "We desperately need money, so we must surrender all academic freedoms to whatever stipulations the donor demands."
option_b: "Tell the donor that we despise their donation and hope their company goes bankrupt!"
option_c: "While we are immensely grateful for the donor's generous vision, institutional integrity and academic freedom are non-negotiable principles that we cannot compromise under any contractual terms."
option_d: "Let us accept the money quietly, sign the contract, and hope the donor forgets to read our published research papers."
option_e: "The committee will allow the donor to dictate scientific discoveries because laboratories are expensive."
explanation: C seçeneği diplomatik bir teşekkürün ardından akademik özgürlük ve kurumsal bütünlüğün asla taviz verilemez ilkeler olduğunu kararlılıkla ortaya koyar.

topic_name: Anlamca En Yakın Cümle ve Duruma Uygun İfade (Restatement & Situation)
question_text:
"The contention that economic globalisation inevitably homogenises indigenous cultures overlooks the complex ways local communities actively indigenise and recontextualise foreign influences."

Yukarıdaki cümleye anlamca en yakın ifade aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
option_a: Arguing that global economic integration unavoidably eradicates cultural diversity fails to recognize how indigenous populations creatively adapt and reshape external cultural inputs.
option_b: Indigenous cultures have completely surrendered their traditional customs in the face of unstoppable economic globalisation.
option_c: Economic globalisation has universally strengthened indigenous traditions without introducing any foreign ideas.
option_d: Local communities are completely incapable of adapting to or resisting foreign macroeconomic influences.
option_e: Cultural homogenisation is the primary goal pursued by indigenous communities seeking foreign economic investment.
explanation: "contention that globalisation homogenises indigenous cultures overlooks the complex ways local communities indigenise..." fikri A seçeneğinde eksiksiz yeniden ifade edilmiştir.

option_a: Coral reefs thrive most vibrantly when exposed to boiling hydrothermal volcanic vents

topic_name: Paragraf Tamamlama ve Anlam Bütünlüğünü Bozan Cümle (Irrelevant Sentence)
question_text:
